title: 托业通勤听力词库（原创）
disclaimer: 本词库与录音均为原创托业/商务英语学习材料，不是新东方或其他商业词书的原文或录音。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提交，呈递
entries.spelling: S, U, B, M, I, T
entries.en: Please submit your timesheet before noon.
entries.zh: 请在中午前提交工时表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，批准，同意
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, O, V, E
entries.en: The manager approved the travel request yesterday.
entries.zh: 经理昨天批准了出差申请。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，预算，做预算
entries.spelling: B, U, D, G, E, T
entries.en: We need to stay within the marketing budget this quarter.
entries.zh: 本季度市场营销开支需控制在预算内。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，货运，一批货物
entries.spelling: S, H, I, P, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The shipment of office supplies will arrive on Monday.
entries.zh: 这批办公用品将于周一到货。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，询问，查询（英enquiry）
entries.spelling: I, N, Q, U, I, R, Y
entries.en: We received several inquiries about the new software.
entries.zh: 我们收到多起关于新软件的咨询。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，退款，退还（钱）
entries.spelling: R, E, F, U, N, D
entries.en: Customers may request a refund within 30 days.
entries.zh: 顾客可在 30 天内申请退款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或副词，加班（时间），加班地
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, T, I, M, E
entries.en: Staff will be paid overtime for weekend shifts.
entries.zh: 周末班次员工可拿加班费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，宣传册，小册子
entries.spelling: B, R, O, C, H, U, R, E
entries.en: Take a brochure from the reception desk for hotel details.
entries.zh: 可在前台取一份宣传册了解酒店信息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，库存，存货清单
entries.spelling: I, N, V, E, N, T, O, R, Y
entries.en: The warehouse will take inventory next Friday.
entries.zh: 仓库下周五将盘点库存。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，预订，预约
entries.spelling: R, E, S, E, R, V, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: I'd like to make a reservation for three under the name Lee.
entries.zh: 我想以 Lee 的名字预订三人桌/房间。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，授权，批准
entries.spelling: A, U, T, H, O, R, I, Z, E
entries.en: Only the director can authorize overtime pay.
entries.zh: 只有主管可以批准加班费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，出席，参加
entries.spelling: A, T, T, E, N, D
entries.en: All managers are expected to attend the briefing.
entries.zh: 所有经理都应出席简报会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，折扣，打折
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, O, U, N, T
entries.en: Bulk orders qualify for a 15% discount.
entries.zh: 大宗订单可享 15% 折扣。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，出发，启程，离开
entries.spelling: D, E, P, A, R, T, U, R, E
entries.en: Please arrive two hours before your departure.
entries.zh: 请于起飞前两小时到达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，费用，开支
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, N, S, E
entries.en: Submit your expense report by the end of the month.
entries.zh: 请在月底前提交费用报销单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，推出，发布，启动
entries.spelling: L, A, U, N, C, H
entries.en: The company will launch the new app next week.
entries.zh: 公司将于下周推出新应用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，备忘录，内部通知
entries.spelling: M, E, M, O
entries.en: A memo about the holiday schedule was emailed this morning.
entries.zh: 今早已邮件发送放假安排备忘录。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，续订，更新，延期
entries.spelling: R, E, N, E, W
entries.en: Please renew your membership before it expires.
entries.zh: 请在会员到期前续订。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，供应商，供货商
entries.spelling: S, U, P, P, L, I, E, R
entries.en: We switched to a local supplier to cut shipping costs.
entries.zh: 我们改用本地供应商以降低运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，调职，转账，换乘
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, F, E, R
entries.en: She requested a transfer to the Taipei office.
entries.zh: 她申请调职到台北办事处。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，合同，签约，收缩
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, R, A, C, T
entries.en: Please review the contract before the closing date.
entries.zh: 请在截止日期前审阅这份合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，指派，分配
entries.spelling: A, S, S, I, G, N
entries.en: The supervisor will assign each trainee a mentor.
entries.zh: 主管会给每位学员指派一位导师。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，通勤，上下班路程
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, U, T, E
entries.en: Many staff prefer to commute rather than relocate.
entries.zh: 许多员工宁愿通勤，也不愿搬家。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，估计，估价单
entries.spelling: E, S, T, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: Please send a written estimate for the renovation work.
entries.zh: 请寄一份装修工程的书面估价。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，晋升，推广
entries.spelling: P, R, O, M, O, T, E
entries.en: She was promoted to senior analyst last month.
entries.zh: 她上个月晋升为高级分析师。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，场地，会场
entries.spelling: V, E, N, U, E
entries.en: The venue for the annual meeting has been changed.
entries.zh: 年会场地已更改。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，工资单，在册员工
entries.spelling: P, A, Y, R, O, L, L
entries.en: New hires will be added to the payroll next week.
entries.zh: 新员工下周会进入工资名册。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，随函附上，围住
entries.spelling: E, N, C, L, O, S, E
entries.en: I enclose a copy of the receipt for your records.
entries.zh: 随信附上收据复印件，供您存档。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，符合资格的，有资格的
entries.spelling: E, L, I, G, I, B, L, E
entries.en: Only full-time staff are eligible for the bonus plan.
entries.zh: 只有全职员工有资格参加奖金计划。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，租约，租赁
entries.spelling: L, E, A, S, E
entries.en: The company plans to lease additional warehouse space.
entries.zh: 公司计划再租用一些仓库空间。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，合并，融合
entries.spelling: M, E, R, G, E
entries.en: The two departments will merge next quarter to cut costs.
entries.zh: 两部门将于下季度合并以削减成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，收购，收购，学得
entries.spelling: A, C, Q, U, I, R, E
entries.en: Our firm plans to acquire a regional logistics company.
entries.zh: 本公司计划收购一家区域物流公司。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，辞职，放弃
entries.spelling: R, E, S, I, G, N
entries.en: She decided to resign from her post effective Friday.
entries.zh: 她决定于周五起辞去现职。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，盈余，过剩的
entries.spelling: S, U, R, P, L, U, S
entries.en: The division reported a surplus after cutting travel expenses.
entries.zh: 该部门削减差旅费后出现盈余。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，赤字，不足额
entries.spelling: D, E, F, I, C, I, T
entries.en: The project is facing a deficit due to unexpected shipping fees.
entries.zh: 因意外运费，该项目出现赤字。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，保修，质保
entries.spelling: W, A, R, R, A, N, T, Y
entries.en: This laptop is still under warranty for another six months.
entries.zh: 这台笔记本电脑保修期还有六个月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，维护，保养，维持
entries.spelling: M, A, I, N, T, E, N, A, N, C, E
entries.en: The elevators will be out of service during weekend maintenance.
entries.zh: 周末维护期间电梯将暂停使用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，总部，总公司
entries.spelling: H, E, A, D, Q, U, A, R, T, E, R, S
entries.en: The company moved its headquarters to Singapore last year.
entries.zh: 该公司去年将总部迁至新加坡。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词或形容词，零售，以零售方式卖
entries.spelling: R, E, T, A, I, L
entries.en: The product is available at major retail outlets nationwide.
entries.zh: 该产品在全国主要零售门店有售。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词或副词，批发，批发的
entries.spelling: W, H, O, L, E, S, A, L, E
entries.en: Restaurants often purchase ingredients at wholesale prices.
entries.zh: 餐厅常以批发价采购食材。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，货运，运费，装运
entries.spelling: F, R, E, I, G, H, T
entries.en: Please confirm whether freight is included in the quote.
entries.zh: 请确认报价是否含运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，入住率，占用，占有
entries.spelling: O, C, C, U, P, A, N, C, Y
entries.en: Hotel occupancy rose sharply during the conference week.
entries.zh: 会议周酒店入住率大幅上升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，申请人，求职者
entries.spelling: A, P, P, L, I, C, A, N, T
entries.en: All applicants must submit a résumé by Friday.
entries.zh: 所有申请人须于周五前提交简历。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，入职培训，迎新，方向
entries.spelling: O, R, I, E, N, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: New employees must attend orientation on Monday morning.
entries.zh: 新员工须于周一上午参加入职培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，报销，偿付
entries.spelling: R, E, I, M, B, U, R, S, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Submit your receipts to receive reimbursement within 10 days.
entries.zh: 请提交收据，以便在 10 天内获得报销。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，配额，定额，指标
entries.spelling: Q, U, O, T, A
entries.en: The sales team exceeded its quarterly quota by 12%.
entries.zh: 销售团队超额完成季度指标 12%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，调查，问卷，测量
entries.spelling: S, U, R, V, E, Y
entries.en: Please complete the customer satisfaction survey online.
entries.zh: 请在线完成客户满意度调查。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，反馈，意见回馈
entries.spelling: F, E, E, D, B, A, C, K
entries.en: Managers are asked to give written feedback after each review.
entries.zh: 经理须在每次评估后给出书面反馈。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，翻新，整修
entries.spelling: R, E, N, O, V, A, T, E
entries.en: The lobby will close next month while we renovate the floors.
entries.zh: 下月大厅将关闭以便翻新地板。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，实施，执行，工具（n.）
entries.spelling: I, M, P, L, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: IT will implement the new booking system next Monday.
entries.zh: IT 部门将于下周一启用新的预订系统。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，分配，划拨（资源/资金）
entries.spelling: A, L, L, O, C, A, T, E
entries.en: The board will allocate additional funds to the marketing team.
entries.zh: 董事会将向市场团队划拨额外资金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，审计，查账
entries.spelling: A, U, D, I, T
entries.en: An external firm will audit our expense reports next month.
entries.zh: 下月一家外部公司将审计我们的报销报表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，福利，益处，受益
entries.spelling: B, E, N, E, F, I, T
entries.en: Full-time staff receive medical and dental benefits.
entries.zh: 全职员工享有医疗和牙科福利。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，佣金，委员会，委托
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, I, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Sales representatives earn a 5% commission on each deal.
entries.zh: 销售代表每笔成交可获 5% 佣金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，遵守，遵从（法规/要求）
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, L, Y
entries.en: All vendors must comply with the new safety regulations.
entries.zh: 所有供应商必须遵守新的安全规定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，共识，一致意见
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, E, N, S, U, S
entries.en: The committee finally reached a consensus on the budget cut.
entries.zh: 委员会终于就预算削减达成共识。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，咨询，请教，商议
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, U, L, T
entries.en: Please consult with Legal before signing the agreement.
entries.zh: 签署协议前请先咨询法务部门。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，协调，配合，坐标
entries.spelling: C, O, O, R, D, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: She will coordinate the launch event with the PR team.
entries.zh: 她将与公关团队协调发布会事宜。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，标准，准则（复数）
entries.spelling: C, R, I, T, E, R, I, A
entries.en: Applicants must meet all the selection criteria listed below.
entries.zh: 申请人必须符合下列全部选拔标准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，扣除，减除
entries.spelling: D, E, D, U, C, T
entries.en: The company will deduct insurance premiums from your paycheck.
entries.zh: 公司将从你的工资中扣除保险费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，押金，存款，存放
entries.spelling: D, E, P, O, S, I, T
entries.en: A security deposit of $500 is required to reserve the suite.
entries.zh: 预订套房需支付 500 美元押金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，披露，公开（信息）
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, L, O, S, E
entries.en: Companies must disclose material risks to investors.
entries.zh: 公司必须向投资者披露重大风险。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，差异，不符，出入
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, R, E, P, A, N, C, Y
entries.en: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the delivery note.
entries.zh: 发票与送货单之间存在出入。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，解雇，驳回，解散
entries.spelling: D, I, S, M, I, S, S
entries.en: The manager decided to dismiss two underperforming staff members.
entries.zh: 经理决定解雇两名表现不佳的员工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，争议，争论，质疑
entries.spelling: D, I, S, P, U, T, E
entries.en: The two firms are trying to settle the contract dispute amicably.
entries.zh: 两家公司正设法友好地解决合同争议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，草稿，起草，汇票
entries.spelling: D, R, A, F, T
entries.en: Please draft a proposal and send it to me by Friday.
entries.zh: 请起草一份提案并于周五前发给我。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，持续时间，期间
entries.spelling: D, U, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The warranty covers repairs for the duration of three years.
entries.zh: 保修涵盖为期三年的维修。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，促进，使便利，促成
entries.spelling: F, A, C, I, L, I, T, A, T, E
entries.en: The new software will facilitate communication across departments.
entries.zh: 新软件将促进跨部门沟通。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，波动，起伏
entries.spelling: F, L, U, C, T, U, A, T, E
entries.en: Oil prices tend to fluctuate during the holiday season.
entries.zh: 油价在节日期间往往会出现波动。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，激励，奖励，诱因
entries.spelling: I, N, C, E, N, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The company offers a bonus as an incentive for early completion.
entries.zh: 公司提供奖金作为提前完工的激励。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，通知，告知
entries.spelling: N, O, T, I, F, Y
entries.en: Please notify HR of any change in your contact information.
entries.zh: 联系方式如有变更，请通知人事部。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，未结清的，杰出的
entries.spelling: O, U, T, S, T, A, N, D, I, N, G
entries.en: Please settle the outstanding balance by the end of this month.
entries.zh: 请于本月底前结清未付余额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，人事，全体员工
entries.spelling: P, E, R, S, O, N, N, E, L
entries.en: All new personnel must complete orientation within the first week.
entries.zh: 所有新员工须在第一周内完成入职培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，采购，获得
entries.spelling: P, R, O, C, U, R, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Our procurement team is negotiating better rates with suppliers.
entries.zh: 我们的采购团队正与供应商协商更优惠的价格。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，提案，建议书
entries.spelling: P, R, O, P, O, S, A, L
entries.en: The client asked us to submit a detailed proposal by Monday.
entries.zh: 客户要求我们周一前提交详细提案。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，回扣，部分退款
entries.spelling: R, E, B, A, T, E
entries.en: Customers who pay early will receive a 3% rebate.
entries.zh: 提前付款的客户可获 3% 回扣。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，法规，规章，管理
entries.spelling: R, E, G, U, L, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: New environmental regulations will affect manufacturing costs.
entries.zh: 新的环保法规将影响制造成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，搬迁，调动（工作地点）
entries.spelling: R, E, L, O, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The firm offers a relocation package for staff moving overseas.
entries.zh: 公司为外派员工提供搬迁福利包。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，留存，保留，员工留任
entries.spelling: R, E, T, E, N, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Improving benefits is key to higher employee retention.
entries.zh: 改善福利是提高员工留任率的关键。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，日程，时间表，安排
entries.spelling: S, C, H, E, D, U, L, E
entries.en: The shipment is expected to arrive on schedule tomorrow.
entries.zh: 货物预计明天按时到达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，休会，延期
entries.spelling: A, D, J, O, U, R, N
entries.en: The chair decided to adjourn the meeting until next week.
entries.zh: 主席决定将会议延期至下周。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，预期，提前准备
entries.spelling: A, N, T, I, C, I, P, A, T, E
entries.en: We anticipate a surge in orders after the product launch.
entries.zh: 我们预计产品发布后订单会激增。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，学徒，见习生
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, E, N, T, I, C, E
entries.en: The firm hired three apprentices for the design team.
entries.zh: 公司为设计团队招了三名学徒。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，安排，整理
entries.spelling: A, R, R, A, N, G, E
entries.en: Please arrange a conference room for Friday morning.
entries.zh: 请为周五上午安排一间会议室。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，评估，评定
entries.spelling: A, S, S, E, S, S
entries.en: Managers will assess each candidate's communication skills.
entries.zh: 经理将评估每位候选人的沟通能力。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，积压（工作/订单）
entries.spelling: B, A, C, K, L, O, G
entries.en: The warehouse is working overtime to clear the shipment backlog.
entries.zh: 仓库正在加班清理货运积压。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，便宜货，讨价还价
entries.spelling: B, A, R, G, A, I, N
entries.en: We struck a bargain with the supplier for bulk discounts.
entries.zh: 我们与供应商谈成了大宗折扣协议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，候选人，应聘者
entries.spelling: C, A, N, D, I, D, A, T, E
entries.en: Three candidates will be interviewed for the sales manager role.
entries.zh: 销售经理一职将面试三位候选人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，产能，容量，能力
entries.spelling: C, A, P, A, C, I, T, Y
entries.en: The factory is operating at full capacity this quarter.
entries.zh: 本季度工厂正满负荷运转。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，（产品）目录，编入目录
entries.spelling: C, A, T, A, L, O, G
entries.en: Please update the spring product catalog before printing.
entries.zh: 请在印刷前更新春季产品目录。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，客户，委托人
entries.spelling: C, L, I, E, N, T
entries.en: Our key clients expect weekly progress updates.
entries.zh: 我们的重要客户期望每周收到进度更新。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，合作，协作
entries.spelling: C, O, L, L, A, B, O, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Marketing will collaborate with engineering on the launch plan.
entries.zh: 市场部将与工程部协作制定发布计划。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，补偿，赔偿，报酬
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, E, N, S, A, T, E
entries.en: The airline will compensate passengers for the delayed flight.
entries.zh: 航空公司将就航班延误向乘客作出补偿。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，竞争对手
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, E, T, I, T, O, R
entries.en: Our main competitor launched a similar product last month.
entries.zh: 我们的主要竞争对手上个月推出了类似产品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，会议，研讨会
entries.spelling: C, O, N, F, E, R, E, N, C, E
entries.en: She will attend an industry conference in Singapore next month.
entries.zh: 她下月将赴新加坡参加行业会议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，托运货物，寄售
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, I, G, N, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The bookstore sells these titles on consignment from local authors.
entries.zh: 这家书店以寄售方式销售本地作者的图书。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，公司，法人企业
entries.spelling: C, O, R, P, O, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The multinational corporation announced a restructuring plan.
entries.zh: 这家跨国公司宣布了重组计划。

entries.meaning: 资质证明；证件；登录凭据
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资质证明，证件，登录凭据
entries.spelling: C, R, E, D, E, N, T, I, A, L, S
entries.en: Please verify the applicant's professional credentials before hiring.
entries.zh: 录用前请核实应聘者的专业资质。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，恶化，变坏
entries.spelling: D, E, T, E, R, I, O, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Customer satisfaction may deteriorate if delays continue.
entries.zh: 若延误持续，客户满意度可能下滑。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，分发，经销，分配
entries.spelling: D, I, S, T, R, I, B, U, T, E
entries.en: We distribute our products through regional warehouses.
entries.zh: 我们通过区域仓库经销产品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，高效的，有成效的
entries.spelling: E, F, F, I, C, I, E, N, T
entries.en: The new software makes inventory tracking more efficient.
entries.zh: 新软件使库存追踪更高效。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，背书，赞同，代言
entries.spelling: E, N, D, O, R, S, E
entries.en: Several industry leaders endorsed the new safety standards.
entries.zh: 多位行业领袖支持了新的安全标准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，扩张，扩大
entries.spelling: E, X, P, A, N, D
entries.en: The company plans to expand into Southeast Asian markets.
entries.zh: 公司计划向东南亚市场扩张。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，预测，预报
entries.spelling: F, O, R, E, C, A, S, T
entries.en: The sales forecast for Q4 looks stronger than expected.
entries.zh: 第四季度销售预测好于预期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，款待，酒店服务业
entries.spelling: H, O, S, P, I, T, A, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: She has ten years of experience in the hospitality industry.
entries.zh: 她在酒店服务业有十年经验。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，打断，中断
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, R, R, U, P, T
entries.en: Please do not interrupt the speaker during the presentation.
entries.zh: 演示期间请勿打断发言人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，商品，推销商品
entries.spelling: M, E, R, C, H, A, N, D, I, S, E
entries.en: Seasonal merchandise will be displayed near the store entrance.
entries.zh: 季节性商品将陈列在店门口附近。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，生产力，效率
entries.spelling: P, R, O, D, U, C, T, I, V, I, T, Y
entries.en: Remote tools helped boost team productivity last year.
entries.zh: 远程工具去年帮助提升了团队效率。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，股东
entries.spelling: S, H, A, R, E, H, O, L, D, E, R
entries.en: Shareholders will vote on the merger at next week's meeting.
entries.zh: 股东将在下周会议上就合并案投票。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，营业额，人员流动率
entries.spelling: T, U, R, N, O, V, E, R
entries.en: High staff turnover has increased our recruitment costs.
entries.zh: 高人员流动率推高了我们的招聘成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，承认，确认收到，致谢
entries.spelling: A, C, K, N, O, W, L, E, D, G, E
entries.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email within 24 hours.
entries.zh: 请在24小时内确认收到此邮件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，修改，修订（合同/条款）
entries.spelling: A, M, E, N, D
entries.en: Both parties agreed to amend the payment terms.
entries.zh: 双方同意修改付款条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，宣布，公布
entries.spelling: A, N, N, O, U, N, C, E
entries.en: The CEO will announce the merger at tomorrow's press conference.
entries.zh: 首席执行官将在明天的新闻发布会上宣布合并事宜。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，组装，集合，召集
entries.spelling: A, S, S, E, M, B, L, E
entries.en: Workers assemble the components before final inspection.
entries.zh: 工人在最终检验前组装零部件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，达到，获得（目标/水平）
entries.spelling: A, T, T, A, I, N
entries.en: The division expects to attain its revenue target this quarter.
entries.zh: 该部门预计本季度将达成营收目标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，澄清，阐明
entries.spelling: C, L, A, R, I, F, Y
entries.en: Could you clarify the deadline for the revised proposal?
entries.zh: 能否澄清修订提案的截止日期？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，开始，着手
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Construction will commence as soon as permits are approved.
entries.zh: 许可证获批后施工将立即开始。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，合并，巩固
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, O, L, I, D, A, T, E
entries.en: The firm plans to consolidate its regional offices next year.
entries.zh: 公司计划明年合并各区域办事处。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，贡献，促成，投稿
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, R, I, B, U, T, E
entries.en: Her research contributed significantly to the product redesign.
entries.zh: 她的研究对产品重新设计贡献很大。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，召集（会议），召开
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, E, N, E
entries.en: The chair will convene an emergency meeting this afternoon.
entries.zh: 主席将于今天下午召开紧急会议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，通信，相符，对应
entries.spelling: C, O, R, R, E, S, P, O, N, D
entries.en: Please correspond with the supplier regarding the delayed shipment.
entries.zh: 请就延误的货件与供应商通信联系。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，下降，婉拒
entries.spelling: D, E, C, L, I, N, E
entries.en: We regretfully decline the invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
entries.zh: 因行程冲突，我们遗憾地婉拒此次邀请。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，递送，交付，发表（演讲）
entries.spelling: D, E, L, I, V, E, R
entries.en: The courier will deliver the package by Friday afternoon.
entries.zh: 快递员将于周五下午前送达包裹。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，演示，证明，展示
entries.spelling: D, E, M, O, N, S, T, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The sales team will demonstrate the prototype to potential buyers.
entries.zh: 销售团队将向潜在买家演示该原型。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，指定，任命，标明
entries.spelling: D, E, S, I, G, N, A, T, E
entries.en: Management designated Ms. Lee as the project coordinator.
entries.zh: 管理层指定李女士为项目协调人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提高，增强，改进
entries.spelling: E, N, H, A, N, C, E
entries.en: The update is designed to enhance system security.
entries.zh: 此次更新旨在增强系统安全性。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，评估，评价
entries.spelling: E, V, A, L, U, A, T, E
entries.en: The committee will evaluate all proposals by next Friday.
entries.zh: 委员会将在下周五前评估所有提案。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，超过，超出
entries.spelling: E, X, C, E, E, D
entries.en: Monthly sales exceeded forecasts by nearly 15 percent.
entries.zh: 月销售额超出预期近15%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，执行，实施，签署生效
entries.spelling: E, X, E, C, U, T, E
entries.en: Both sides must execute the agreement before work begins.
entries.zh: 双方须在开工前签署并执行该协议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，到期，期满，失效
entries.spelling: E, X, P, I, R, E
entries.en: Your membership will expire at the end of this month.
entries.zh: 您的会员资格将于本月底到期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，履行，完成，满足（需求）
entries.spelling: F, U, L, F, I, L, L
entries.en: We strive to fulfill every customer order within two days.
entries.zh: 我们力求两天内履行每一笔客户订单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，产生，创造，发电
entries.spelling: G, E, N, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The campaign is expected to generate significant online traffic.
entries.zh: 该活动预计将带来大量线上流量。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，突出，强调，亮点
entries.spelling: H, I, G, H, L, I, G, H, T
entries.en: The speaker highlighted three risks in the expansion plan.
entries.zh: 演讲者强调了扩张计划中的三个风险。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，发起，开始，启动
entries.spelling: I, N, I, T, I, A, T, E
entries.en: HR will initiate a company-wide skills assessment next month.
entries.zh: 人力资源部将于下月启动全公司技能评估。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，检查，视察
entries.spelling: I, N, S, P, E, C, T
entries.en: Quality control will inspect every batch before shipment.
entries.zh: 质检部门将在发货前检查每一批次。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，获得，取得
entries.spelling: O, B, T, A, I, N
entries.en: You must obtain written approval before changing the budget.
entries.zh: 更改预算前必须获得书面批准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，参加，参与
entries.spelling: P, A, R, T, I, C, I, P, A, T, E
entries.en: All managers are required to participate in the safety training.
entries.zh: 所有经理都必须参加安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，说服，劝说
entries.spelling: P, E, R, S, U, A, D, E
entries.en: It took weeks to persuade investors to fund the expansion.
entries.zh: 花了数周才说服投资者为扩张提供资金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，继续进行，着手
entries.spelling: P, R, O, C, E, E, D
entries.en: Once funding is secured, we will proceed with hiring.
entries.zh: 资金到位后，我们将着手招聘。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，终止，解雇，结束
entries.spelling: T, E, R, M, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: Either party may terminate the agreement with 30 days' notice.
entries.zh: 任何一方可提前30天通知终止协议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，容纳，提供住宿，迁就
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, M, M, O, D, A, T, E
entries.en: The conference hall can accommodate up to 300 attendees.
entries.zh: 会议厅最多可容纳 300 名与会者。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，附属机构，使加盟
entries.spelling: A, F, F, I, L, I, A, T, E
entries.en: Our local office is an affiliate of a global consulting firm.
entries.zh: 我们本地办事处是一家全球咨询公司的附属机构。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，评估，绩效考核，估价
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, A, I, S, A, L
entries.en: Employees receive a written performance appraisal each December.
entries.zh: 员工每年十二月会收到书面绩效考核。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，归因于，品质，属性
entries.spelling: A, T, T, R, I, B, U, T, E
entries.en: Analysts attribute the sales surge to the new marketing campaign.
entries.zh: 分析师将销售激增归因于新的营销活动。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，取消，作废
entries.spelling: C, A, N, C, E, L
entries.en: Please cancel my flight and rebook me on tomorrow’s departure.
entries.zh: 请取消我的航班，并改订明天的出发班次。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，货物，船货
entries.spelling: C, A, R, G, O
entries.en: The cargo will arrive at the port by Friday afternoon.
entries.zh: 这批货物将于周五下午抵达港口。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，传阅，流通，循环
entries.spelling: C, I, R, C, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: Please circulate the revised agenda to all department heads.
entries.zh: 请将修订后的议程传阅给各部门主管。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，商业的，广告片
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, E, R, C, I, A, L
entries.en: The building is zoned for commercial use only.
entries.zh: 该建筑仅划定为商业用途。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，承诺，投入，犯（罪）
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, I, T
entries.en: The vendor has committed to delivering the parts by Monday.
entries.zh: 供应商已承诺周一前交付零件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，兼容的，合得来的
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, A, T, I, B, L, E
entries.en: The new software is compatible with most operating systems.
entries.zh: 该新软件与大多数操作系统兼容。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，全面的，综合的
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, R, E, H, E, N, S, I, V, E
entries.en: The consultant prepared a comprehensive market analysis.
entries.zh: 顾问准备了一份全面的市场分析。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，进行，实施，行为
entries.spelling: C, O, N, D, U, C, T
entries.en: HR will conduct interviews with the shortlisted candidates.
entries.zh: 人事部将对入围候选人进行面试。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，连续的，连贯的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, E, C, U, T, I, V, E
entries.en: Sales rose for the fifth consecutive quarter.
entries.zh: 销售额连续第五个季度上升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，相当大的，可观的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, I, D, E, R, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The upgrade required a considerable investment in new equipment.
entries.zh: 这次升级需要在新设备上投入相当大的资金。

entries.meaning: 视……而定的；代表团；应急的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，视……而定的，代表团，应急的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, I, N, G, E, N, T
entries.en: The bonus is contingent on meeting the annual sales target.
entries.zh: 奖金视是否达到年度销售目标而定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，方便的，便利的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, E, N, I, E, N, T
entries.en: The hotel’s convenient location saves guests commuting time.
entries.zh: 酒店便利的位置为客人节省了通勤时间。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，说服，使信服
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, I, N, C, E
entries.en: She managed to convince the board to approve the budget.
entries.zh: 她成功说服董事会批准了该预算。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，快递，信使
entries.spelling: C, O, U, R, I, E, R
entries.en: Please send the signed contract by overnight courier.
entries.zh: 请用隔夜快递寄出已签署的合同。

entries.meaning: 覆盖范围；保险保障；报道
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，覆盖范围，保险保障，报道
entries.spelling: C, O, V, E, R, A, G, E
entries.en: Does your health plan provide dental coverage for dependents?
entries.zh: 你的健康保险是否为家属提供牙科保障？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，定制，使个性化
entries.spelling: C, U, S, T, O, M, I, Z, E
entries.en: We can customize the software package to fit your workflow.
entries.zh: 我们可以按贵司工作流程定制该软件包。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，延误，推迟
entries.spelling: D, E, L, A, Y
entries.en: Due to weather, the shipment was delayed by two days.
entries.zh: 因天气原因，货物延误了两天。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，部署，调配，上线
entries.spelling: D, E, P, L, O, Y
entries.en: The IT team will deploy the update over the weekend.
entries.zh: IT 团队将在周末部署此次更新。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，转移，改道，使转向
entries.spelling: D, I, V, E, R, T
entries.en: The airline had to divert the flight to a nearby airport.
entries.zh: 航空公司不得不将航班改降到附近机场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，缺点，不利之处
entries.spelling: D, R, A, W, B, A, C, K
entries.en: The main drawback of remote work is reduced face-to-face collaboration.
entries.zh: 远程办公的主要缺点是面对面协作减少。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，努力，尽力，事业
entries.spelling: E, N, D, E, A, V, O, R
entries.en: We will endeavor to resolve the complaint within five business days.
entries.zh: 我们将尽力在五个工作日内解决该投诉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，企业，事业，进取心
entries.spelling: E, N, T, E, R, P, R, I, S, E
entries.en: The award recognizes outstanding medium-sized enterprises in the region.
entries.zh: 该奖项表彰本地区杰出的中型企业。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，装备，使具备
entries.spelling: E, Q, U, I, P
entries.en: All meeting rooms are equipped with video conferencing tools.
entries.zh: 所有会议室都配备了视频会议设备。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，建立，确立，证实
entries.spelling: E, S, T, A, B, L, I, S, H
entries.en: The company plans to establish a regional office in Singapore.
entries.zh: 该公司计划在新加坡设立区域办事处。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，免除的，豁免
entries.spelling: E, X, E, M, P, T
entries.en: Nonprofit organizations are often exempt from certain local taxes.
entries.zh: 非营利组织通常可免除某些地方税。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，延长，扩展，伸出
entries.spelling: E, X, T, E, N, D
entries.en: Management agreed to extend the project deadline by two weeks.
entries.zh: 管理层同意将项目截止日期延长两周。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，任命，指定，约定
entries.spelling: A, P, P, O, I, N, T
entries.en: The board will appoint Ms. Chen as the new CFO next week.
entries.zh: 董事会将于下周任命陈女士为新任首席财务官。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，假定，承担（责任/职务）
entries.spelling: A, S, S, U, M, E
entries.en: She will assume responsibility for the regional sales team in October.
entries.zh: 她将于十月起承担区域销售团队的职责。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，计算，估算，打算
entries.spelling: C, A, L, C, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: Please calculate the total shipping cost before we confirm the order.
entries.zh: 请在确认订单前先计算总运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，证书，证明文件
entries.spelling: C, E, R, T, I, F, I, C, A, T, E
entries.en: Employees receive a certificate of completion after the safety training.
entries.zh: 员工完成安全培训后会获得结业证书。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，收费，负责，充电
entries.spelling: C, H, A, R, G, E
entries.en: Delivery is free of charge for orders over $100.
entries.zh: 满 100 美元的订单免运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，声称，索赔，主张
entries.spelling: C, L, A, I, M
entries.en: Customers must file a claim within 30 days of receiving damaged goods.
entries.zh: 客户须在收到损坏商品后 30 天内提出索赔。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，商品，大宗商品，日用品
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, O, D, I, T, Y
entries.en: Rising commodity prices have increased production costs this quarter.
entries.zh: 大宗商品价格上涨推高了本季度的生产成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，补充，补足，互补物
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, L, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The new accessories complement our existing product line perfectly.
entries.zh: 新配件与我们现有产品线完美互补。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，结束，得出结论，缔结
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, L, U, D, E
entries.en: We will conclude the meeting after reviewing the action items.
entries.zh: 审阅完行动事项后我们将结束会议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，节约，保护（资源/能源）
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, E, R, V, E
entries.en: The company installed LED lighting to conserve energy in all offices.
entries.zh: 公司在所有办公室安装 LED 照明以节约能源。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，消耗，消费，吃喝
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, U, M, E
entries.en: The new servers consume less electricity than the previous models.
entries.zh: 新服务器比旧型号耗电更少。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，转换，兑换，改建
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, E, R, T
entries.en: Please convert all figures into US dollars before submitting the report.
entries.zh: 提交报告前请将所有数字换算成美元。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，传达，运送，表达
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, E, Y
entries.en: Please convey our apologies to the client for the delayed shipment.
entries.zh: 请向客户转达我们对延误发货的歉意。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，合作，配合
entries.spelling: C, O, O, P, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: All departments must cooperate with the auditors during the review.
entries.zh: 审查期间各部门必须配合审计人员。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，礼貌，优待，礼节性举动
entries.spelling: C, O, U, R, T, E, S, Y
entries.en: As a courtesy, we will extend the warranty by an additional year.
entries.zh: 作为一项礼遇，我们将保修期再延长一年。

entries.meaning: 信用；赊购；赞扬；记入贷方
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，信用，赊购，赞扬
entries.spelling: C, R, E, D, I, T
entries.en: Suppliers may allow established clients to purchase goods on credit.
entries.zh: 供应商可允许老客户赊购商品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，关键的，批评的，危急的
entries.spelling: C, R, I, T, I, C, A, L
entries.en: Timely delivery is critical to maintaining customer satisfaction.
entries.zh: 准时交货对维持客户满意度至关重要。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，货币，流通，通用
entries.spelling: C, U, R, R, E, N, C, Y
entries.en: Travelers should exchange foreign currency at the airport bank.
entries.zh: 旅客应在机场银行兑换外币。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，申报，宣布，声明
entries.spelling: D, E, C, L, A, R, E
entries.en: Passengers must declare all items purchased overseas at customs.
entries.zh: 旅客必须在海关申报所有海外购买的物品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，减少，降低
entries.spelling: D, E, C, R, E, A, S, E
entries.en: Operating costs decreased by 12% after the process upgrade.
entries.zh: 流程升级后运营成本下降了 12%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，推迟，延期，遵从
entries.spelling: D, E, F, E, R
entries.en: Management decided to defer the product launch until next quarter.
entries.zh: 管理层决定将产品发布推迟到下个季度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，需求，要求，查问
entries.spelling: D, E, M, A, N, D
entries.en: Strong demand for electric vehicles boosted sales last month.
entries.zh: 电动车的强劲需求推动了上个月的销售。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，确定，决定，测定
entries.spelling: D, E, T, E, R, M, I, N, E
entries.en: Investigators are still trying to determine the cause of the outage.
entries.zh: 调查人员仍在设法确定停电原因。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，扰乱，中断，颠覆
entries.spelling: D, I, S, R, U, P, T
entries.en: The storm disrupted flights and delayed thousands of passengers.
entries.zh: 暴风雨扰乱了航班，延误了数千名旅客。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，解散，溶解，解除
entries.spelling: D, I, S, S, O, L, V, E
entries.en: The two founders agreed to dissolve the partnership amicably.
entries.zh: 两位创始人同意友好地解散合伙关系。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，多样的，不同的
entries.spelling: D, I, V, E, R, S, E
entries.en: We seek candidates from diverse professional backgrounds.
entries.zh: 我们寻求来自不同专业背景的候选人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，文件，文档，记录在案
entries.spelling: D, O, C, U, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Please attach all supporting documents to your expense report.
entries.zh: 请将所有证明文件附在报销单上。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，国内的，家用的，本国的
entries.spelling: D, O, M, E, S, T, I, C
entries.en: Domestic sales grew faster than exports this fiscal year.
entries.zh: 本财年国内销售增速快于出口。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，主导，支配，占优势
entries.spelling: D, O, M, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: Three major brands still dominate the smartphone market.
entries.zh: 三大品牌仍主导智能手机市场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，裁员缩编，缩小规模
entries.spelling: D, O, W, N, S, I, Z, E
entries.en: The firm plans to downsize its workforce by 8% next year.
entries.zh: 该公司计划明年将员工编制缩减 8%。

entries.meaning: 强制执行；实施（法规/政策）
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，强制执行，实施（法规/政策）
entries.spelling: E, N, F, O, R, C, E
entries.en: The security team will enforce the new visitor policy starting Monday.
entries.zh: 安保团队将从周一开始强制执行新的访客政策。

entries.meaning: 升级；逐步扩大（冲突/问题）
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，升级，逐步扩大（冲突/问题）
entries.spelling: E, S, C, A, L, A, T, E
entries.en: If the error continues, please escalate the issue to technical support.
entries.zh: 若错误持续出现，请将问题升级给技术支持。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，独家的，排他的，专用的
entries.spelling: E, X, C, L, U, S, I, V, E
entries.en: Members receive an exclusive offer on early-bird tickets.
entries.zh: 会员可获得早鸟票的独家优惠。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，展览，展品，展示
entries.spelling: E, X, H, I, B, I, T
entries.en: Our company will exhibit new software at the industry fair.
entries.zh: 我们公司将在行业展会上展出新软件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，支出，开支，经费
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, N, D, I, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The finance team plans to reduce expenditure on overseas travel.
entries.zh: 财务团队计划削减海外差旅支出。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，专业知识，专长
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, R, T, I, S, E
entries.en: We hired a consultant with expertise in supply-chain logistics.
entries.zh: 我们聘请了一位擅长供应链物流的顾问。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，设施，场所，（复数）设备
entries.spelling: F, A, C, I, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: The new research facility will open near the airport next spring.
entries.zh: 新的研究设施将于明年春天在机场附近启用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可行的，行得通的
entries.spelling: F, E, A, S, I, B, L, E
entries.en: Moving the warehouse downtown is not financially feasible this year.
entries.zh: 今年把仓库迁到市中心在财务上并不可行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，灵活的，可变通的
entries.spelling: F, L, E, X, I, B, L, E
entries.en: The company offers flexible working hours for remote staff.
entries.zh: 公司为远程员工提供灵活的工作时间。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，基础，基金会，创立
entries.spelling: F, O, U, N, D, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Strong training lays the foundation for long-term customer service.
entries.zh: 扎实的培训为长期客户服务打下基础。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，保证，担保
entries.spelling: G, U, A, R, A, N, T, E, E
entries.en: All laptops come with a two-year money-back guarantee.
entries.zh: 所有笔记本电脑均享有两年退款保证。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，处理，应付，把手
entries.spelling: H, A, N, D, L, E
entries.en: Our support team is trained to handle complaints politely.
entries.zh: 我们的客服团队受过礼貌处理投诉的培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，雇用，聘用，新员工
entries.spelling: H, I, R, E
entries.en: The department plans to hire three analysts before the peak season.
entries.zh: 该部门计划在旺季前聘用三名分析师。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，识别，确认，找出
entries.spelling: I, D, E, N, T, I, F, Y
entries.en: Please identify the cause of the shipping delay by Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五前找出货运延误的原因。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，影响，冲击
entries.spelling: I, M, P, A, C, T
entries.en: Higher fuel prices will have an impact on delivery costs.
entries.zh: 燃油价格上涨将对配送成本产生影响。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，征收，强加，推行
entries.spelling: I, M, P, O, S, E
entries.en: The city may impose a tax on short-term rental bookings.
entries.zh: 该市可能对短租预订征收税款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，招致，产生（费用/损失）
entries.spelling: I, N, C, U, R
entries.en: Rush orders may incur additional shipping costs.
entries.zh: 加急订单可能会产生额外运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，表明，指示，显示
entries.spelling: I, N, D, I, C, A, T, E
entries.en: Early surveys indicate that customers prefer the lighter packaging.
entries.zh: 初步调查显示客户更喜欢更轻的包装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，创新，革新
entries.spelling: I, N, N, O, V, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The lab focuses on product innovation for the mobile market.
entries.zh: 该实验室专注于移动市场的产品创新。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，安装，正式就任
entries.spelling: I, N, S, T, A, L, L
entries.en: Technicians will install the new security cameras this weekend.
entries.zh: 技术人员将于本周末安装新的安防摄像头。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，投资，投入（时间/精力）
entries.spelling: I, N, V, E, S, T
entries.en: The firm decided to invest in renewable-energy startups.
entries.zh: 该公司决定投资可再生能源初创企业。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，涉及，使参与，包含
entries.spelling: I, N, V, O, L, V, E
entries.en: The redesign will involve several departments across the company.
entries.zh: 这次改版将涉及公司多个部门。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，证明合理，为…辩护
entries.spelling: J, U, S, T, I, F, Y
entries.en: Managers must justify the cost before approving large purchases.
entries.zh: 经理须在批准大额采购前证明费用合理。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有法律责任的，易于…的
entries.spelling: L, I, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The contractor is liable for any damage caused during renovation.
entries.zh: 承包商对装修期间造成的任何损坏负有责任。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，制造，生产，制造业
entries.spelling: M, A, N, U, F, A, C, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The factory will manufacture electric motors for export markets.
entries.zh: 该工厂将生产出口市场的电动机。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，利润率，页边空白，余地
entries.spelling: M, A, R, G, I, N
entries.en: Rising material costs have reduced our profit margin this quarter.
entries.zh: 原材料成本上升已压缩了本季度的利润率。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，监控，监视器，班长
entries.spelling: M, O, N, I, T, O, R
entries.en: Supervisors monitor performance with weekly dashboard reports.
entries.zh: 主管通过每周仪表盘报告监控业绩。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，激励，促使
entries.spelling: M, O, T, I, V, A, T, E
entries.en: Bonuses help motivate employees to meet quarterly targets.
entries.zh: 奖金有助于激励员工完成季度目标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，目标，客观的
entries.spelling: O, B, J, E, C, T, I, V, E
entries.en: Our main objective this year is to expand into two new markets.
entries.zh: 我们今年的主要目标是拓展进入两个新市场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，过时的，废弃的
entries.spelling: O, B, S, O, L, E, T, E
entries.en: Older printers will become obsolete after the software upgrade.
entries.zh: 软件升级后，旧打印机将变得过时。

entries.meaning: 占用；占据（职位/空间）；使忙碌
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，占用，占据（职位/空间），使忙碌
entries.spelling: O, C, C, U, P, Y
entries.en: She will occupy the regional manager position starting next month.
entries.zh: 她将从下个月起担任区域经理一职。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，省略，遗漏，删除
entries.spelling: O, M, I, T
entries.en: Please do not omit any contact details from the registration form.
entries.zh: 请勿在登记表中遗漏任何联系方式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，运营，操作，运转
entries.spelling: O, P, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The firm plans to operate distribution centers in three cities.
entries.zh: 该公司计划在三个城市运营配送中心。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，机会，时机
entries.spelling: O, P, P, O, R, T, U, N, I, T, Y
entries.en: This internship is an excellent opportunity to gain industry experience.
entries.zh: 这份实习是获得行业经验的绝佳机会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，选项，选择权，期权
entries.spelling: O, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Employees have the option to work from home two days a week.
entries.zh: 员工可以选择每周在家办公两天。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，组织，安排，筹办
entries.spelling: O, R, G, A, N, I, Z, E
entries.en: HR will organize a welcome session for new hires on Monday.
entries.zh: 人力资源部将在周一为新员工组织迎新会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，大纲，概要，概述
entries.spelling: O, U, T, L, I, N, E
entries.en: Please outline the main risks before we approve the budget.
entries.zh: 在我们批准预算之前，请概述主要风险。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，克服，战胜（困难）
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, C, O, M, E
entries.en: The team worked hard to overcome supply shortages last quarter.
entries.zh: 团队上个季度努力克服了供应短缺问题。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，忽略，overlook（俯瞰），宽恕小错
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, L, O, O, K
entries.en: Please review the contract carefully so we do not overlook any clauses.
entries.zh: 请仔细审阅合同，以免遗漏任何条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或副词，海外的，在国外
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, S, E, A, S
entries.en: Our overseas sales grew by 12 percent this year.
entries.zh: 我们的海外销售额今年增长了百分之十二。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，包裹，套餐，包装
entries.spelling: P, A, C, K, A, G, E
entries.en: The new hire received a competitive compensation package.
entries.zh: 这位新员工获得了有竞争力的薪酬福利套餐。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，专利，取得专利
entries.spelling: P, A, T, E, N, T
entries.en: The company filed a patent for its new battery technology.
entries.zh: 该公司为其新电池技术申请了专利。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，罚款，处罚，违约金
entries.spelling: P, E, N, A, L, T, Y
entries.en: A late-payment penalty will be charged after the due date.
entries.zh: 逾期后将收取滞纳金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，执行，履行，表现
entries.spelling: P, E, R, F, O, R, M
entries.en: All staff must perform their duties according to company policy.
entries.zh: 所有员工必须按照公司政策履行职责。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，永久的，长期的，固定的
entries.spelling: P, E, R, M, A, N, E, N, T
entries.en: After six months, the temporary role may become a permanent position.
entries.zh: 六个月后，这个临时岗位可能转为正式职位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，允许，许可证
entries.spelling: P, E, R, M, I, T
entries.en: Foreign specialists need a work permit before starting the project.
entries.zh: 外籍专家在开始项目前需要工作许可证。

entries.meaning: 持续的；坚持不懈的；顽固的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，持续的，坚持不懈的，顽固的
entries.spelling: P, E, R, S, I, S, T, E, N, T
entries.en: Despite persistent delays, the supplier kept customers informed.
entries.zh: 尽管延误持续不断，供应商仍保持向客户通报情况。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，阶段，时期，分阶段进行
entries.spelling: P, H, A, S, E
entries.en: The renovation will enter its final phase next week.
entries.zh: 翻新工程将于下周进入最后阶段。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，政策，方针，保险单
entries.spelling: P, O, L, I, C, Y
entries.en: According to company policy, all visitors must register at the front desk.
entries.zh: 根据公司政策，所有访客必须在前台登记。

entries.meaning: 投资组合；作品集；公文包
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，投资组合，作品集，公文包
entries.spelling: P, O, R, T, F, O, L, I, O
entries.en: The manager reviewed the client's investment portfolio carefully.
entries.zh: 经理仔细审阅了客户的投资组合。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，潜力，潜在的，可能的
entries.spelling: P, O, T, E, N, T, I, A, L
entries.en: We identified several potential customers at the trade fair.
entries.zh: 我们在交易会上发现了几位潜在客户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，初步的，预备的
entries.spelling: P, R, E, L, I, M, I, N, A, R, Y
entries.en: The team shared preliminary results before the final audit.
entries.zh: 团队在最终审计前分享了初步结果。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，保险费，溢价，优质的
entries.spelling: P, R, E, M, I, U, M
entries.en: The annual insurance premium must be paid by March 31.
entries.zh: 年度保险费须在3月31日前缴清。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，以前的，先前的
entries.spelling: P, R, E, V, I, O, U, S
entries.en: Her previous experience in logistics made her a strong candidate.
entries.zh: 她以往的物流经验使她成为有力的候选人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，优先事项，优先权
entries.spelling: P, R, I, O, R, I, T, Y
entries.en: Customer satisfaction remains our top priority this year.
entries.zh: 客户满意度仍是我们今年的首要任务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，程序，手续，步骤
entries.spelling: P, R, O, C, E, D, U, R, E
entries.en: Please follow the standard procedure when submitting expense claims.
entries.zh: 提交报销时请遵循标准程序。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，熟练的，精通的
entries.spelling: P, R, O, F, I, C, I, E, N, T
entries.en: Candidates must be proficient in spreadsheet software.
entries.zh: 应聘者必须熟练使用电子表格软件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，利润，盈利，获益
entries.spelling: P, R, O, F, I, T
entries.en: The store expects to make a profit in the fourth quarter.
entries.zh: 该门店预计在第四季度实现盈利。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，迅速的，及时的，促使
entries.spelling: P, R, O, M, P, T
entries.en: We appreciate your prompt reply to our customer survey.
entries.zh: 感谢您对我们客户调查的及时回复。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，前景，可能性，潜在客户
entries.spelling: P, R, O, S, P, E, C, T
entries.en: The sales team contacted several new prospects this morning.
entries.zh: 销售团队今天上午联系了几位新的潜在客户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提供，供给，规定
entries.spelling: P, R, O, V, I, D, E
entries.en: The company will provide all new staff with laptops and training.
entries.zh: 公司将为所有新员工提供笔记本电脑和培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，供应，条款，预备
entries.spelling: P, R, O, V, I, S, I, O, N
entries.en: The lease includes a provision that allows early termination.
entries.zh: 租约包含允许提前终止的条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，购买，采购，购得物
entries.spelling: P, U, R, C, H, A, S, E
entries.en: Please submit a purchase order before ordering office supplies.
entries.zh: 订购办公用品前请提交采购单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，追求，从事，继续追查
entries.spelling: P, U, R, S, U, E
entries.en: She decided to pursue a career in international marketing.
entries.zh: 她决定从事国际营销方面的职业。

entries.meaning: 使具备资格；限定；取得资格
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使具备资格，限定，取得资格
entries.spelling: Q, U, A, L, I, F, Y
entries.en: Candidates must qualify for the role by passing the certification exam.
entries.zh: 应聘者须通过认证考试才有资格担任该职位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，质量，品质，特性
entries.spelling: Q, U, A, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: Our factory has improved product quality through stricter inspections.
entries.zh: 我们的工厂通过更严格的检验提升了产品质量。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，数量，量
entries.spelling: Q, U, A, N, T, I, T, Y
entries.en: We ordered a large quantity of envelopes for the mailing campaign.
entries.zh: 我们为邮寄活动订购了大量信封。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或副词，季度的，每季度地
entries.spelling: Q, U, A, R, T, E, R, L, Y
entries.en: The CFO will present the quarterly report on Friday morning.
entries.zh: 财务总监将在周五上午汇报季度报告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，调查问卷，调查表
entries.spelling: Q, U, E, S, T, I, O, N, N, A, I, R, E
entries.en: Please fill out this short questionnaire after the training session.
entries.zh: 培训结束后请填写这份简短问卷。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，报价，引用，引述
entries.spelling: Q, U, O, T, E
entries.en: Could you please send us a quote for 500 units by tomorrow?
entries.zh: 请您明天前给我们发送五百件产品的报价好吗？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，提高，筹措，加薪
entries.spelling: R, A, I, S, E
entries.en: Management decided to raise salaries for customer service staff.
entries.zh: 管理层决定提高客服人员的工资。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，范围，系列，变化幅度
entries.spelling: R, A, N, G, E
entries.en: Our product range now includes eco-friendly packaging options.
entries.zh: 我们的产品系列现在包含环保包装选项。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，等级，排名，列为
entries.spelling: R, A, N, K
entries.en: The brand ranks among the top three in customer satisfaction.
entries.zh: 该品牌在客户满意度方面位列前三。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，比率，费率，评价
entries.spelling: R, A, T, E
entries.en: The bank lowered the interest rate on small business loans.
entries.zh: 银行下调了小企业贷款的利率。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，比率，比例
entries.spelling: R, A, T, I, O
entries.en: The debt-to-equity ratio remains within the board's target range.
entries.zh: 资产负债比率仍保持在董事会的目标范围内。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，到达，达到，影响范围
entries.spelling: R, E, A, C, H
entries.en: After long talks, both sides finally reached an agreement.
entries.zh: 经过长时间谈判，双方终于达成协议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，召回（产品），回想，撤销
entries.spelling: R, E, C, A, L, L
entries.en: The manufacturer issued a recall of the defective chargers.
entries.zh: 制造商对有缺陷的充电器发出了召回通知。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，收据，收到，接收
entries.spelling: R, E, C, E, I, P, T
entries.en: Please keep the receipt for your travel expense claim.
entries.zh: 请保留收据以便报销差旅费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，收到，接待，接受
entries.spelling: R, E, C, E, I, V, E
entries.en: We expect to receive the shipment by the end of this week.
entries.zh: 我们预计本周末前收到这批货物。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，接收者，收件人，获奖者
entries.spelling: R, E, C, I, P, I, E, N, T
entries.en: Please confirm that the email recipient list is up to date.
entries.zh: 请确认邮件收件人列表是最新的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，推荐，建议
entries.spelling: R, E, C, O, M, M, E, N, D
entries.en: I highly recommend that we postpone the launch until next month.
entries.zh: 我强烈建议把发布推迟到下个月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，对账，和解，使一致
entries.spelling: R, E, C, O, N, C, I, L, E
entries.en: Accounting needs to reconcile the bank statement with our records.
entries.zh: 会计需要将银行对账单与我们的记录核对一致。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，恢复，收回，康复
entries.spelling: R, E, C, O, V, E, R
entries.en: Sales began to recover after the new marketing campaign launched.
entries.zh: 新营销活动启动后，销售额开始回升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，减少，降低，缩小
entries.spelling: R, E, D, U, C, E
entries.en: The new process will reduce shipping costs by about fifteen percent.
entries.zh: 新流程将使运费大约降低百分之十五。

entries.meaning: 多余的；被裁员的；冗余的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，多余的，被裁员的，冗余的
entries.spelling: R, E, D, U, N, D, A, N, T
entries.en: Several warehouse positions were made redundant after automation.
entries.zh: 自动化之后，若干仓库岗位被裁撤。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提及，参考，转介
entries.spelling: R, E, F, E, R
entries.en: Please refer to the employee handbook for the leave policy.
entries.zh: 请假政策请参阅员工手册。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，参考，推荐信，提及
entries.spelling: R, E, F, E, R, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Please attach two professional references to your application.
entries.zh: 请在申请材料中附上两份职业推荐信。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，改进，精炼，使更完善
entries.spelling: R, E, F, I, N, E
entries.en: The design team will refine the prototype based on user feedback.
entries.zh: 设计团队将根据用户反馈完善原型。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，看待，尊重，方面
entries.spelling: R, E, G, A, R, D
entries.en: With regard to the delay, we will issue a full refund.
entries.zh: 关于这次延误，我们将全额退款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，登记，注册，登记簿
entries.spelling: R, E, G, I, S, T, E, R
entries.en: Employees must register for the safety workshop by Friday.
entries.zh: 员工须在周五前报名参加安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，监管，调控，规范
entries.spelling: R, E, G, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: The agency will regulate online advertising to protect consumers.
entries.zh: 该机构将监管网络广告以保护消费者。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，加强，强化，加固
entries.spelling: R, E, I, N, F, O, R, C, E
entries.en: Managers should reinforce safety rules during every shift briefing.
entries.zh: 经理应在每次班前会上再次强调安全规定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，拒绝，驳回，拒收
entries.spelling: R, E, J, E, C, T
entries.en: The board voted to reject the merger proposal unanimously.
entries.zh: 董事会一致投票否决了该合并提案。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，发布，释放，发行
entries.spelling: R, E, L, E, A, S, E
entries.en: The company will release a new software update next Monday.
entries.zh: 公司将在下周一发布新的软件更新。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，相关的，切题的
entries.spelling: R, E, L, E, V, A, N, T
entries.en: Please attach only documents that are relevant to the application.
entries.zh: 请只附上与申请相关的文件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，依靠，信赖
entries.spelling: R, E, L, Y
entries.en: Small shops often rely on weekend traffic for most of their sales.
entries.zh: 小店常常依赖周末客流来完成大部分销售。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，保持，仍然是，留下
entries.spelling: R, E, M, A, I, N
entries.en: Customer satisfaction scores remain high despite the price increase.
entries.zh: 尽管涨价，客户满意度得分仍然很高。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，补救办法，纠正，治疗
entries.spelling: R, E, M, E, D, Y
entries.en: We are working with the vendor to remedy the billing error quickly.
entries.zh: 我们正与供应商合作，尽快纠正账单错误。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，汇款，汇付金额
entries.spelling: R, E, M, I, T, T, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Please confirm that the remittance has reached our bank account.
entries.zh: 请确认汇款已到我们的银行账户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，移除，开除，去掉
entries.spelling: R, E, M, O, V, E
entries.en: Please remove outdated prices from the online catalog tonight.
entries.zh: 请今晚把过时价格从在线目录中删除。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，租金，租用，出租
entries.spelling: R, E, N, T
entries.en: The startup decided to rent a smaller office to cut costs.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司决定租用更小的办公室以削减成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，替换，取代，更换
entries.spelling: R, E, P, L, A, C, E
entries.en: IT will replace all outdated laptops before the end of the quarter.
entries.zh: IT 部门将在本季度结束前更换所有过时的笔记本电脑。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，代表，表现，象征
entries.spelling: R, E, P, R, E, S, E, N, T
entries.en: Our sales team will represent the company at the trade fair.
entries.zh: 我们的销售团队将在交易会上代表公司。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，请求，要求，申请
entries.spelling: R, E, Q, U, E, S, T
entries.en: Please submit your leave request at least three days in advance.
entries.zh: 请至少提前三天提交请假申请。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，要求，需要，规定必须
entries.spelling: R, E, Q, U, I, R, E
entries.en: All visitors are required to wear a badge inside the building.
entries.zh: 所有访客进入大楼时都必须佩戴证件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，研究，调研，调查
entries.spelling: R, E, S, E, A, R, C, H
entries.en: Market research shows strong demand for flexible work schedules.
entries.zh: 市场调研显示人们对弹性工作时间需求强劲。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，预订，保留，储备
entries.spelling: R, E, S, E, R, V, E
entries.en: Could you reserve a conference room for Thursday afternoon?
entries.zh: 您能预订周四下午的会议室吗？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，解决，决心，决议
entries.spelling: R, E, S, O, L, V, E
entries.en: Customer service aims to resolve every complaint within 48 hours.
entries.zh: 客服力求在四十八小时内解决每一宗投诉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资源，财力，资料
entries.spelling: R, E, S, O, U, R, C, E
entries.en: The project was delayed because of limited staff resources.
entries.zh: 由于人手资源有限，项目被推迟了。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，回应，答复，作出反应
entries.spelling: R, E, S, P, O, N, D
entries.en: Please respond to the client's inquiry by the end of the day.
entries.zh: 请在今天结束前回复客户的问询。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，恢复，修复，归还
entries.spelling: R, E, S, T, O, R, E
entries.en: Engineers worked overnight to restore the payment system.
entries.zh: 工程师通宵工作以恢复支付系统。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，限制，约束，限定
entries.spelling: R, E, S, T, R, I, C, T
entries.en: The company will restrict access to confidential client files.
entries.zh: 公司将限制对机密客户文件的访问。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，恢复，继续，重新开始
entries.spelling: R, E, S, U, M, E
entries.en: We will resume the meeting after a ten-minute break.
entries.zh: 休息十分钟后我们将继续开会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，留住，保留，保持
entries.spelling: R, E, T, A, I, N
entries.en: Better benefits help the firm retain experienced engineers.
entries.zh: 更好的福利有助于公司留住经验丰富的工程师。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，退休，退役，撤回
entries.spelling: R, E, T, I, R, E
entries.en: The director will retire from the company at the end of this year.
entries.zh: 该总监将于今年年底从公司退休。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，取回，检索，挽回
entries.spelling: R, E, T, R, I, E, V, E
entries.en: Staff can retrieve archived invoices from the cloud database.
entries.zh: 员工可以从云端数据库检索已归档的发票。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，审查，回顾，评论
entries.spelling: R, E, V, I, E, W
entries.en: Please review the contract carefully before signing it.
entries.zh: 签字前请仔细审阅合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，修订，修改，复习
entries.spelling: R, E, V, I, S, E
entries.en: The team needs to revise the budget before Friday's meeting.
entries.zh: 团队需要在周五会议前修订预算。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，撤销，取消，废止
entries.spelling: R, E, V, O, K, E
entries.en: The board may revoke the vendor's contract for repeated delays.
entries.zh: 因多次延误，董事会可能撤销该供应商的合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，奖励，报酬，奖赏
entries.spelling: R, E, W, A, R, D
entries.en: The company will reward employees who exceed their sales targets.
entries.zh: 公司将奖励超额完成销售目标的员工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，薪资，月薪
entries.spelling: S, A, L, A, R, Y
entries.en: The offer includes a competitive base salary plus performance bonuses.
entries.zh: 该录用通知包含有竞争力的基本薪资以及绩效奖金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使满意，满足（需求/条件）
entries.spelling: S, A, T, I, S, F, Y
entries.en: Our goal is to satisfy clients without delaying the project timeline.
entries.zh: 我们的目标是在不延误项目进度的前提下让客户满意。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或形容词，获得，确保，安全的
entries.spelling: S, E, C, U, R, E
entries.en: The sales team managed to secure a three-year supply contract.
entries.zh: 销售团队成功拿下了一份三年期的供应合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或形容词，选择，精选的
entries.spelling: S, E, L, E, C, T
entries.en: Please select the payment method that works best for your department.
entries.zh: 请选择最适合贵部门的支付方式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，研讨会，专题讲座
entries.spelling: S, E, M, I, N, A, R
entries.en: All new hires must attend the compliance seminar next Thursday.
entries.zh: 所有新员工下周四必须参加合规研讨会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，资深的，高级的，年长者
entries.spelling: S, E, N, I, O, R
entries.en: Please escalate urgent issues to a senior manager immediately.
entries.zh: 请立即将紧急问题上报给资深经理。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或形容词，分开，单独的，分离的
entries.spelling: S, E, P, A, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Travel expenses should be listed on a separate invoice.
entries.zh: 差旅费用应列在单独的发票上。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，顺序，序列，一系列
entries.spelling: S, E, Q, U, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Complete the safety checks in the correct sequence before starting.
entries.zh: 启动前请按正确顺序完成安全检查。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，解决，结算，定居
entries.spelling: S, E, T, T, L, E
entries.en: Both parties agreed to settle the dispute through mediation.
entries.zh: 双方同意通过调解解决争议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，严重的，严厉的
entries.spelling: S, E, V, E, R, E
entries.en: The storm caused severe damage to the warehouse roof.
entries.zh: 暴风雨对仓库屋顶造成了严重损坏。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，轮班，转变，转移
entries.spelling: S, H, I, F, T
entries.en: Please confirm whether you can cover the night shift this Friday.
entries.zh: 请确认本周五你是否能顶夜班。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，短缺，不足
entries.spelling: S, H, O, R, T, A, G, E
entries.en: Production was delayed because of a shortage of key components.
entries.zh: 由于关键零部件短缺，生产被延误了。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，重要的，显著的
entries.spelling: S, I, G, N, I, F, I, C, A, N, T
entries.en: There has been a significant increase in online orders this quarter.
entries.zh: 本季度线上订单有显著增长。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，简化，使简易
entries.spelling: S, I, M, P, L, I, F, Y
entries.en: We redesigned the app to simplify the checkout process.
entries.zh: 我们重新设计了应用，以简化结账流程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，熟练的，有技能的
entries.spelling: S, K, I, L, L, E, D
entries.en: The factory is hiring skilled technicians for the night shift.
entries.zh: 工厂正在招聘熟练技术员上夜班。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，征求，请求，招揽
entries.spelling: S, O, L, I, C, I, T
entries.en: The purchasing team will solicit bids from three approved vendors.
entries.zh: 采购团队将向三家核准供应商征求投标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，明确说明，具体指定
entries.spelling: S, P, E, C, I, F, Y
entries.en: Please specify the delivery date in the purchase order.
entries.zh: 请在采购订单中明确交货日期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，赞助商，赞助，主办
entries.spelling: S, P, O, N, S, O, R
entries.en: A local bank agreed to sponsor the annual career fair.
entries.zh: 一家本地银行同意赞助年度招聘会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，稳定，稳定性
entries.spelling: S, T, A, B, I, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: Investors value the company's long-term financial stability.
entries.zh: 投资者看重该公司的长期财务稳定性。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，全体员工，配备人员
entries.spelling: S, T, A, F, F
entries.en: All staff must complete the online safety training by Friday.
entries.zh: 全体员工须在周五前完成线上安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使标准化，统一规范
entries.spelling: S, T, A, N, D, A, R, D, I, Z, E
entries.en: The HQ plans to standardize reporting formats across all branches.
entries.zh: 总部计划统一各分公司的报告格式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，声明，报表，陈述
entries.spelling: S, T, A, T, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Please review your monthly bank statement for any unauthorized charges.
entries.zh: 请核对月度银行对账单，查看是否有未授权扣款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，状态，地位，进展情况
entries.spelling: S, T, A, T, U, S
entries.en: Could you send a brief status update on the renovation project?
entries.zh: 能否发一份关于装修项目的简短进度更新？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，刺激，激励，促进
entries.spelling: S, T, I, M, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: The discount campaign is designed to stimulate weekend sales.
entries.zh: 这次折扣活动旨在刺激周末销售。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，库存，股票，备货
entries.spelling: S, T, O, C, K
entries.en: The item is currently out of stock and will ship next week.
entries.zh: 该商品目前缺货，将于下周发货。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，策略，战略
entries.spelling: S, T, R, A, T, E, G, Y
entries.en: The board approved a new marketing strategy for overseas markets.
entries.zh: 董事会批准了针对海外市场的新营销策略。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，加强，巩固，增强
entries.spelling: S, T, R, E, N, G, T, H, E, N
entries.en: We hope to strengthen our partnership with regional distributors.
entries.zh: 我们希望加强与区域经销商的合作关系。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，严格的，严厉的
entries.spelling: S, T, R, I, C, T
entries.en: The company has a strict policy against sharing confidential data.
entries.zh: 公司对共享机密数据有严格规定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，结构，体系，组织安排
entries.spelling: S, T, R, U, C, T, U, R, E
entries.en: HR is reviewing the fee structure for the employee wellness plan.
entries.zh: 人力资源部正在审查员工健康计划的费用结构。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，大量的，实质的，可观的
entries.spelling: S, U, B, S, T, A, N, T, I, A, L
entries.en: The renovation will require a substantial investment this fiscal year.
entries.zh: 此次翻新将需要本财年一笔可观的投资。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，代替，替代品，替补
entries.spelling: S, U, B, S, T, I, T, U, T, E
entries.en: Please substitute the recycled packaging for the plastic wraps.
entries.zh: 请用可回收包装替代塑料包装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，成功，继任，接替
entries.spelling: S, U, C, C, E, E, D
entries.en: She hopes to succeed in expanding our presence overseas.
entries.zh: 她希望成功拓展我们在海外的业务布局。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，连续的，接连的
entries.spelling: S, U, C, C, E, S, S, I, V, E
entries.en: Sales rose for the fifth successive quarter.
entries.zh: 销售额连续第五个季度上升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，足够的，充足的
entries.spelling: S, U, F, F, I, C, I, E, N, T
entries.en: Please ensure there are sufficient copies for all attendees.
entries.zh: 请确保为所有与会者准备足够的复印件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，建议，表明，暗示
entries.spelling: S, U, G, G, E, S, T
entries.en: I suggest that we postpone the product launch until next month.
entries.zh: 我建议把产品发布推迟到下个月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，合适的，适宜的
entries.spelling: S, U, I, T, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The conference room is suitable for up to forty participants.
entries.zh: 该会议室适合最多四十位与会者。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，总结，概括
entries.spelling: S, U, M, M, A, R, I, Z, E
entries.en: Could you summarize the key points before we adjourn?
entries.zh: 休会前你能否把要点总结一下？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，监督，管理，指导
entries.spelling: S, U, P, E, R, V, I, S, E
entries.en: She will supervise the installation of the new equipment.
entries.zh: 她将监督新设备的安装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，补充，增补，补充物
entries.spelling: S, U, P, P, L, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The appendix will supplement the main findings in the report.
entries.zh: 附录将补充报告中的主要发现。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，支持，支撑，客服支持
entries.spelling: S, U, P, P, O, R, T
entries.en: Our team provides 24-hour technical support for enterprise clients.
entries.zh: 我们的团队为企业客户提供全天候技术支持。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，假定，认为，猜想
entries.spelling: S, U, P, P, O, S, E
entries.en: Suppose we increase the budget by ten percent—what happens next?
entries.zh: 假定我们把预算提高百分之十——接下来会怎样？

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，附加费，加收费用
entries.spelling: S, U, R, C, H, A, R, G, E
entries.en: A fuel surcharge will be added to all overseas shipments.
entries.zh: 所有海外货运都将加收燃油附加费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，维持，承受，支撑
entries.spelling: S, U, S, T, A, I, N
entries.en: The company cannot sustain this level of spending indefinitely.
entries.zh: 公司无法无限期地维持这种开支水平。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，临时的，暂时的
entries.spelling: T, E, M, P, O, R, A, R, Y
entries.en: We hired temporary staff to cover the holiday peak season.
entries.zh: 我们招聘了临时员工以应对节日旺季。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，承租人，租户
entries.spelling: T, E, N, A, N, T
entries.en: Each tenant must sign a twelve-month lease for the office space.
entries.zh: 每位租户必须为办公空间签署为期十二个月的租约。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词或形容词，投标，提出（报价），温柔的
entries.spelling: T, E, N, D, E, R
entries.en: Three vendors submitted a tender for the catering contract.
entries.zh: 三家供应商就餐饮合同递交了标书。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，暂定的，试探性的
entries.spelling: T, E, N, T, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: Please hold Monday afternoon as a tentative meeting time.
entries.zh: 请暂定周一下午作为会议时间。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，地区，销售区域，领地
entries.spelling: T, E, R, R, I, T, O, R, Y
entries.en: He was assigned a new sales territory in the Midwest.
entries.zh: 他被分配到中西部一个新的销售区域。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，彻底的，详尽的
entries.spelling: T, H, O, R, O, U, G, H
entries.en: Please conduct a thorough review of the safety procedures.
entries.zh: 请对安全流程进行一次全面审核。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，威胁，危及，有…危险
entries.spelling: T, H, R, E, A, T, E, N
entries.en: Rising costs threaten our ability to meet the delivery deadline.
entries.zh: 成本上升危及我们按期交货的能力。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，繁荣，茁壮成长，兴旺
entries.spelling: T, H, R, I, V, E
entries.en: Small retailers can thrive in niche markets with loyal customers.
entries.zh: 小型零售商可以在拥有忠实客户的细分市场中兴旺发展。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，容忍，容许，耐受
entries.spelling: T, O, L, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The company will not tolerate any violation of safety rules.
entries.zh: 公司不会容忍任何违反安全规定的行为。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，商标，标志性特征
entries.spelling: T, R, A, D, E, M, A, R, K
entries.en: Legal counsel advised us to register the trademark overseas.
entries.zh: 法律顾问建议我们在海外注册该商标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，交易，业务往来
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, A, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: All online transactions are protected by encryption.
entries.zh: 所有在线交易都受到加密保护。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，转变，改造，使改观
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, F, O, R, M
entries.en: Automation will transform how we process customer orders.
entries.zh: 自动化将改变我们处理客户订单的方式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，运输，过境，中转
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, I, T
entries.en: The shipment is currently in transit and should arrive Friday.
entries.zh: 货物目前正在运输途中，预计周五到达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，传送，传输，传达
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, M, I, T
entries.en: Please transmit the signed contract to our legal department.
entries.zh: 请将已签署的合同传送给我们的法务部门。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，运输，运送，交通工具
entries.spelling: T, R, A, N, S, P, O, R, T
entries.en: We need a reliable firm to transport goods across the region.
entries.zh: 我们需要一家可靠的公司在该地区运送货物。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，趋势，潮流，倾向
entries.spelling: T, R, E, N, D
entries.en: The latest report shows an upward trend in online bookings.
entries.zh: 最新报告显示在线预订呈上升趋势。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，试用，试验，审判
entries.spelling: T, R, I, A, L
entries.en: New hires complete a three-month trial period before confirmation.
entries.zh: 新员工在转正前需完成三个月的试用期。

entries.meaning: 最终的；终极的；最终结果
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，最终的，终极的，最终结果
entries.spelling: U, L, T, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: Our ultimate goal is to expand into three new markets this year.
entries.zh: 我们的最终目标是今年拓展到三个新市场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，一致同意的，无异议的
entries.spelling: U, N, A, N, I, M, O, U, S
entries.en: The board reached a unanimous decision to approve the merger.
entries.zh: 董事会一致决定批准这项并购。

entries.meaning: 经历；接受（检查/手术/改造等）
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，经历，接受（检查/手术/改造等）
entries.spelling: U, N, D, E, R, G, O
entries.en: The warehouse will undergo renovations throughout October.
entries.zh: 仓库将在整个十月进行翻修。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，低估，估计不足
entries.spelling: U, N, D, E, R, E, S, T, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: We should not underestimate the demand for remote support.
entries.zh: 我们不应低估对远程支持的需求。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，承担，着手做，承诺
entries.spelling: U, N, D, E, R, T, A, K, E
entries.en: Our team will undertake a full review of the supplier contracts.
entries.zh: 我们团队将全面审查供应商合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，失业，失业率
entries.spelling: U, N, E, M, P, L, O, Y, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The report shows a slight decline in the regional unemployment rate.
entries.zh: 报告显示该地区失业率略有下降。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，意外的，出乎意料的
entries.spelling: U, N, E, X, P, E, C, T, E, D
entries.en: An unexpected delay in customs held up the shipment.
entries.zh: 海关的意外延误耽误了这批货物。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，统一的，一致的，制服
entries.spelling: U, N, I, F, O, R, M
entries.en: All branches must follow uniform safety standards.
entries.zh: 所有分支机构必须遵循统一的安全标准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，独特的，独一无二的
entries.spelling: U, N, I, Q, U, E
entries.en: The app's unique feature is real-time expense tracking.
entries.zh: 这款应用的独特功能是实时费用追踪。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，更新，最新信息
entries.spelling: U, P, D, A, T, E
entries.en: Please update the client database before Friday's meeting.
entries.zh: 请在周五会议前更新客户数据库。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，升级，提升，改进
entries.spelling: U, P, G, R, A, D, E
entries.en: We plan to upgrade the reservation system next quarter.
entries.zh: 我们计划下个季度升级预订系统。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，紧急的，急迫的
entries.spelling: U, R, G, E, N, T
entries.en: This is an urgent matter that requires your immediate attention.
entries.zh: 这是需要您立即关注的紧急事项。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，利用，使用
entries.spelling: U, T, I, L, I, Z, E
entries.en: The warehouse will utilize available space for seasonal inventory.
entries.zh: 仓库将利用可用空间存放季节性库存。

entries.meaning: 空的；空缺的；无人占用的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，空的，空缺的，无人占用的
entries.spelling: V, A, C, A, N, T
entries.en: HR is advertising a vacant position in the accounting department.
entries.zh: 人事部正在招聘会计部门的一个空缺职位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有效的，合理的，正当的
entries.spelling: V, A, L, I, D
entries.en: Please ensure your passport is valid for at least six months.
entries.zh: 请确保您的护照有效期至少还有六个月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，验证，确认有效，证实
entries.spelling: V, A, L, I, D, A, T, E
entries.en: Please validate the customer data before generating invoices.
entries.zh: 生成发票前请先验证客户数据。

entries.meaning: 有价值的；宝贵的；贵重的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有价值的，宝贵的，贵重的
entries.spelling: V, A, L, U, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Customer surveys provide valuable feedback for product design.
entries.zh: 客户调查为产品设计提供宝贵反馈。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，估价，估值，评估
entries.spelling: V, A, L, U, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The investor requested an independent valuation of the startup.
entries.zh: 投资者要求对这家初创公司进行独立估值。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，变化，变异，差异
entries.spelling: V, A, R, I, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: There is little variation in shipping rates this quarter.
entries.zh: 本季度运费几乎没有什么变化。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，多样性，种类，品种
entries.spelling: V, A, R, I, E, T, Y
entries.en: The catalog offers a wide variety of office supplies.
entries.zh: 产品目录提供种类繁多的办公用品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，变化，不同，使多样化
entries.spelling: V, A, R, Y
entries.en: Delivery times vary depending on the destination.
entries.zh: 交货时间视目的地而定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，车辆，交通工具，媒介
entries.spelling: V, E, H, I, C, L, E
entries.en: All company vehicles must undergo annual safety inspections.
entries.zh: 所有公司车辆必须接受年度安全检查。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，供应商，卖主，摊贩
entries.spelling: V, E, N, D, O, R
entries.en: We are evaluating three vendors for the catering service.
entries.zh: 我们正在评估三家餐饮服务供应商。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，核实，查证，确认
entries.spelling: V, E, R, I, F, Y
entries.en: Please verify the account details before processing the payment.
entries.zh: 处理付款前请核实账户信息。

entries.meaning: 多才多艺的；用途广泛的；灵活的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，多才多艺的，用途广泛的，灵活的
entries.spelling: V, E, R, S, A, T, I, L, E
entries.en: We need a versatile designer who can handle print and digital work.
entries.zh: 我们需要一位能兼顾印刷与数字设计的多面手设计师。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，版本，说法，改编本
entries.spelling: V, E, R, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Please download the latest version of the presentation slides.
entries.zh: 请下载演示文稿的最新版本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 介词，对，与……相对，对比
entries.spelling: V, E, R, S, U, S
entries.en: The memo compares remote work versus office-based schedules.
entries.zh: 这份备忘录比较了远程办公与坐班制的安排。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可行的，能独立发展的
entries.spelling: V, I, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Outsourcing logistics may be a more viable option this year.
entries.zh: 今年把物流外包可能是更可行的选择。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，违反，侵犯，违背
entries.spelling: V, I, O, L, A, T, E
entries.en: Employees who violate the code of conduct face disciplinary action.
entries.zh: 违反行为准则的员工将面临纪律处分。

entries.meaning: 志愿者；自愿做；主动提出
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，志愿者，自愿做，主动提出
entries.spelling: V, O, L, U, N, T, E, E, R
entries.en: Several staff members volunteered to help at the charity fair.
entries.zh: 几位员工自愿在慈善集市上帮忙。

entries.meaning: 工资；报酬；发动（战争/运动）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，工资，报酬，发动（战争/运动）
entries.spelling: W, A, G, E
entries.en: The company announced a five percent wage increase for all staff.
entries.zh: 公司宣布全体员工加薪百分之五。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，仓库，货仓，把……存入仓库
entries.spelling: W, A, R, E, H, O, U, S, E
entries.en: The new warehouse facility will cut delivery times by two days.
entries.zh: 新仓储设施将使交货时间缩短两天。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提取，撤回，退出
entries.spelling: W, I, T, H, D, R, A, W
entries.en: Clients can withdraw cash from any branch without a fee.
entries.zh: 客户可在任一分行免手续费取现。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，劳动力，全体员工
entries.spelling: W, O, R, K, F, O, R, C, E
entries.en: Investing in training helps retain a skilled workforce.
entries.zh: 投资培训有助于留住熟练劳动力。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，研讨会，工作坊，车间
entries.spelling: W, O, R, K, S, H, O, P
entries.en: All new hires must attend a safety workshop next Monday.
entries.zh: 所有新员工必须参加下周一的安全研讨会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，值得的，有价值的
entries.spelling: W, O, R, T, H, W, H, I, L, E
entries.en: The pilot program proved to be a worthwhile investment.
entries.zh: 该试点项目被证明是一项值得的投资。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，产生，屈服，产量
entries.spelling: Y, I, E, L, D
entries.en: The revised marketing plan is expected to yield better results.
entries.zh: 修订后的营销计划有望产生更好的结果。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，扣留，拒绝给予，隐瞒
entries.spelling: W, I, T, H, H, O, L, D
entries.en: The payroll office will withhold tax from each paycheck.
entries.zh: 薪资部门将从每笔工资中代扣税款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，电汇，电线，拍电报
entries.spelling: W, I, R, E
entries.en: Please wire the payment to our account by Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五前将款项电汇至我们的账户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，广泛的，普遍的
entries.spelling: W, I, D, E, S, P, R, E, A, D
entries.en: There is widespread support for the flexible work policy.
entries.zh: 弹性工作政策获得了广泛支持。

entries.meaning: 每年的；一年一度；按年地
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或副词，每年的，一年一度，按年地
entries.spelling: Y, E, A, R, L, Y
entries.en: The board reviews the yearly budget every December.
entries.zh: 董事会每年十二月审议年度预算。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，进入，使用权，访问
entries.spelling: A, C, C, E, S, S
entries.en: Only authorized staff have access to the client database.
entries.zh: 只有授权员工可以访问客户数据库。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，一致，符合，依据
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, R, D, A, N, C, E
entries.en: All shipments must be packed in accordance with safety guidelines.
entries.zh: 所有货物必须按照安全指南进行包装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 副词，相应地，因此，于是
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, R, D, I, N, G, L, Y
entries.en: Demand has risen, so we will increase production accordingly.
entries.zh: 需求上升了，因此我们将相应增加产量。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，账户，说明，解释
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, U, N, T
entries.en: Please transfer the deposit to our corporate bank account.
entries.zh: 请将定金转入我们的公司银行账户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，准确的，精确的
entries.spelling: A, C, C, U, R, A, T, E
entries.en: We need accurate information before signing the contract.
entries.zh: 签署合同前我们需要准确的信息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，实现，达到，取得
entries.spelling: A, C, H, I, E, V, E
entries.en: The sales team hopes to achieve its quarterly target early.
entries.zh: 销售团队希望尽早完成季度目标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，收购，收购，获得
entries.spelling: A, C, Q, U, I, S, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The acquisition of the local chain expanded our market share.
entries.zh: 收购这家本地连锁店扩大了我们的市场份额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，适应，改编，使适合
entries.spelling: A, D, A, P, T
entries.en: Employees must adapt to the new scheduling software.
entries.zh: 员工必须适应新的排班软件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，足够的，适当的，胜任的
entries.spelling: A, D, E, Q, U, A, T, E
entries.en: We lack adequate funding to open a second branch this year.
entries.zh: 我们缺乏今年开设第二家分店的充足资金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，津贴，限额，允许
entries.spelling: A, L, L, O, W, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Staff on business trips receive a fixed daily allowance.
entries.zh: 出差员工可领取固定的日津贴。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，替代方案，可供选择的
entries.spelling: A, L, T, E, R, N, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: If the flight is canceled, we will book an alternative route.
entries.zh: 如果航班取消，我们将预订替代航线。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，分析，解析
entries.spelling: A, N, A, L, Y, Z, E
entries.en: The research team will analyze customer feedback this week.
entries.zh: 研究团队本周将分析客户反馈。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，每年的，年度的
entries.spelling: A, N, N, U, A, L
entries.en: The annual meeting will be held at the downtown conference center.
entries.zh: 年会将在市中心会议中心举行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，申请，申请表，应用
entries.spelling: A, P, P, L, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Please complete the application form and return it by Friday.
entries.zh: 请填写申请表并于周五前交回。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，感谢，欣赏，领会
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, E, C, I, A, T, E
entries.en: We greatly appreciate your prompt reply to our inquiry.
entries.zh: 我们非常感谢您对我们询问的及时回复。

entries.meaning: 方法；途径；接近；着手处理
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，方法，途径，接近
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, O, A, C, H
entries.en: The manager suggested a more systematic approach to inventory control.
entries.zh: 经理建议采用更系统的库存控制方法。

entries.meaning: 适当的；合适的；拨出（款项）
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，适当的，合适的，拨出（款项）
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, O, P, R, I, A, T, E
entries.en: Please wear appropriate attire for the client presentation.
entries.zh: 请为客户演示穿着得体的服装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 副词，大约，近似地
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, O, X, I, M, A, T, E, L, Y
entries.en: The renovation will take approximately six weeks to complete.
entries.zh: 翻修大约需要六周才能完成。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，协助，帮助
