entries.spelling: A, S, S, I, S, T
entries.en: Our support team is available around the clock to assist customers.
entries.zh: 我们的支持团队全天候为客户提供协助。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，联系，联想，同事
entries.spelling: A, S, S, O, C, I, A, T, E
entries.en: Please do not associate this delay with our usual service quality.
entries.zh: 请勿将此次延误与我们一贯的服务质量联系起来。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，协会，关联，交往
entries.spelling: A, S, S, O, C, I, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The trade association issued new guidelines for member firms.
entries.zh: 该行业协会向会员企业发布了新指南。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，向……保证，使确信
entries.spelling: A, S, S, U, R, E
entries.en: We assure you that the shipment will arrive by Friday.
entries.zh: 我们向您保证货物将于周五前送达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，附上，贴上，使附属
entries.spelling: A, T, T, A, C, H
entries.en: Please attach the signed contract to your reply.
entries.zh: 请在回复中附上已签署的合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，出席，出勤，到场人数
entries.spelling: A, T, T, E, N, D, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Your attendance at tomorrow’s briefing is required.
entries.zh: 明日简报会要求您必须出席。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，律师，代理人
entries.spelling: A, T, T, O, R, N, E, Y
entries.en: Our corporate attorney reviewed the merger agreement.
entries.zh: 公司法律顾问审阅了并购协议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，拍卖，以拍卖方式出售
entries.spelling: A, U, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Surplus equipment will be sold at an online auction next month.
entries.zh: 多余设备将于下月在网上拍卖出售。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，权威，权力，当局
entries.spelling: A, U, T, H, O, R, I, T, Y
entries.en: Only the CFO has authority to approve expenses over $10,000.
entries.zh: 只有首席财务官有权批准超过一万美元的开支。

entries.meaning: 可获得的；有空的；可用的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可获得的，有空的，可用的
entries.spelling: A, V, A, I, L, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The conference room is available for booking after 3 p.m.
entries.zh: 该会议室下午三点后可供预订。

entries.meaning: 平均；平均数；普通的；平均为
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词或动词，平均，平均数，普通的
entries.spelling: A, V, E, R, A, G, E
entries.en: On average, response time fell by twenty percent this quarter.
entries.zh: 本季度平均响应时间下降了百分之二十。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，避免，避开
entries.spelling: A, V, O, I, D
entries.en: Submit forms early to avoid unnecessary delay.
entries.zh: 请尽早提交表格，以免不必要的延误。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，奖项，授予，裁决给予
entries.spelling: A, W, A, R, D
entries.en: The board will award the construction contract next week.
entries.zh: 董事会将于下周授予该施工合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，意识到的，知道的
entries.spelling: A, W, A, R, E
entries.en: Please be aware of the updated privacy policy.
entries.zh: 请留意更新后的隐私政策。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，余额，平衡，使平衡
entries.spelling: B, A, L, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Please check your account balance before placing the order.
entries.zh: 下单前请先核对账户余额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词或动词，破产的，破产者，使破产
entries.spelling: B, A, N, K, R, U, P, T
entries.en: Several suppliers went bankrupt during the downturn.
entries.zh: 几家供应商在经济低迷期间破产。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，障碍，壁垒，屏障
entries.spelling: B, A, R, R, I, E, R
entries.en: High tariffs remain a major trade barrier for exporters.
entries.zh: 高关税仍是出口商面临的主要贸易壁垒。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，基础，依据，基准
entries.spelling: B, A, S, I, S
entries.en: Staff reviews are conducted on a regular basis.
entries.zh: 员工考核定期进行。

entries.meaning: 利益；方面（多用于 on behalf of）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，利益，方面（多用于onbehalfof）
entries.spelling: B, E, H, A, L, F
entries.en: I am writing on behalf of the marketing department.
entries.zh: 我谨代表市场部致函。

entries.meaning: 基准；标杆；以……为基准比较
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，基准，标杆，以……为基准比较
entries.spelling: B, E, N, C, H, M, A, R, K
entries.en: We benchmark our delivery times against industry leaders.
entries.zh: 我们将交货时间与行业领先者进行对标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，受益人，受惠者
entries.spelling: B, E, N, E, F, I, C, I, A, R, Y
entries.en: Please update the primary beneficiary on your policy.
entries.zh: 请更新保单上的主要受益人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，投标，出价，竞标
entries.spelling: B, I, D
entries.en: Three vendors submitted a bid for the renovation project.
entries.zh: 三家供应商为翻新项目提交了投标。

entries.meaning: 账单；票据；给……开账单；法案
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，账单，票据，给……开账单
entries.spelling: B, I, L, L
entries.en: Accounts payable will bill the client at the end of the month.
entries.zh: 应付账款部门将在月底向客户开具账单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，董事会，板，登机/上船
entries.spelling: B, O, A, R, D
entries.en: The board of directors approved the annual budget.
entries.zh: 董事会批准了年度预算。

entries.meaning: 债券；纽带；保证金；使结合
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，债券，纽带，保证金
entries.spelling: B, O, N, D
entries.en: The firm invested surplus cash in corporate bonds.
entries.zh: 该公司将闲置资金投资于公司债。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，奖金，红利，额外好处
entries.spelling: B, O, N, U, S
entries.en: Eligible staff will receive a performance bonus in March.
entries.zh: 符合条件的员工将在三月获得绩效奖金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，预订，预约，登记
entries.spelling: B, O, O, K, I, N, G
entries.en: Please confirm your hotel booking before Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五前确认酒店预订。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，借入，借用
entries.spelling: B, O, R, R, O, W
entries.en: Start-ups often borrow funds from commercial banks.
entries.zh: 初创公司常常向商业银行借入资金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，品牌，商标，打上烙印
entries.spelling: B, R, A, N, D
entries.en: The campaign aims to raise brand awareness among young buyers.
entries.zh: 该活动旨在提升年轻买家中的品牌认知度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，突破，重大进展
entries.spelling: B, R, E, A, K, T, H, R, O, U, G, H
entries.en: The lab reported a major breakthrough in battery research.
entries.zh: 实验室报告了电池研究方面的重大突破。

entries.meaning: 简短的；简报；向……简要说明
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词或动词，简短的，简报，向……简要说明
entries.spelling: B, R, I, E, F
entries.en: Please brief the team on the client’s new requirements.
entries.zh: 请就客户的新要求向团队作简要说明。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，浏览，随意翻看，逛
entries.spelling: B, R, O, W, S, E
entries.en: Customers can browse the catalog before placing an order.
entries.zh: 客户下单前可先浏览产品目录。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，大量，散装，主体
entries.spelling: B, U, L, K
entries.en: Ordering in bulk can significantly reduce unit costs.
entries.zh: 大批量订购可显著降低单位成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，活动，战役，开展运动
entries.spelling: C, A, M, P, A, I, G, N
entries.en: The company launched a new marketing campaign last Monday.
entries.zh: 该公司上周一发起了新的营销活动。

entries.meaning: 承办宴席；迎合；提供餐饮
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，承办宴席，迎合，提供餐饮
entries.spelling: C, A, T, E, R
entries.en: The hotel can cater for conferences of up to 200 people.
entries.zh: 该酒店可为多达 200 人的会议提供餐饮。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，谨慎，警告，提醒注意
entries.spelling: C, A, U, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Please exercise caution when handling confidential files.
entries.zh: 处理机密文件时请务必谨慎。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，停止，终止，结束
entries.spelling: C, E, A, S, E
entries.en: The factory will cease operations at the end of this month.
entries.zh: 该工厂将于本月底停止运营。

entries.meaning: 主席；董事长；会议主持人
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，主席，董事长，会议主持人
entries.spelling: C, H, A, I, R, M, A, N
entries.en: The chairman of the board opened the annual meeting.
entries.zh: 董事长宣布年度会议开始。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，挑战，质疑，难题
entries.spelling: C, H, A, L, L, E, N, G, E
entries.en: Meeting the new deadline will be a major challenge.
entries.zh: 赶上下一个截止日期将是一项重大挑战。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，特许状，章程，包租
entries.spelling: C, H, A, R, T, E, R
entries.en: The sales team will charter a flight to the trade show.
entries.zh: 销售团队将包机前往展会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，条款，从句，条文
entries.spelling: C, L, A, U, S, E
entries.en: Please review the confidentiality clause before signing.
entries.zh: 签署前请审阅保密条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，商业，贸易，商务
entries.spelling: C, O, M, M, E, R, C, E
entries.en: E-commerce has transformed the way small firms sell products.
entries.zh: 电子商务改变了小企业销售产品的方式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，竞争，参赛，争夺
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, E, T, E
entries.en: Local stores must compete with large online retailers.
entries.zh: 本地商店必须与大型线上零售商竞争。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，投诉，抱怨，控告
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, L, A, I, N, T
entries.en: The service desk received several complaints about delayed deliveries.
entries.zh: 客服台收到若干关于延误交货的投诉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，组成，撰写，作曲
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, O, S, E
entries.en: Please compose a brief reply to the client’s inquiry.
entries.zh: 请就客户的询问撰写一封简短回复。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，包含，由……组成，构成
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, R, I, S, E
entries.en: The new division will comprise five regional offices.
entries.zh: 新事业部将包含五个区域办事处。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，妥协，和解，损害
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, R, O, M, I, S, E
entries.en: Both parties finally reached a compromise on the delivery schedule.
entries.zh: 双方最终就交货时间表达成妥协。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，强制的，义务的，必修的
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, U, L, S, O, R, Y
entries.en: Safety training is compulsory for all new employees.
entries.zh: 所有新员工都必须参加安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，集中，专注，浓缩
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, E, N, T, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Please concentrate on completing the quarterly report first.
entries.zh: 请先专注于完成季度报告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，概念，观念，构思
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, E, P, T
entries.en: The design team presented a new product concept yesterday.
entries.zh: 设计团队昨天展示了一个新的产品概念。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，关心，担忧，涉及
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, E, R, N
entries.en: Our primary concern is meeting the client’s quality standards.
entries.zh: 我们的首要关切是达到客户的质量标准。

entries.meaning: 让步；特许；concession stand 摊位
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，让步，特许，concessionstand摊位
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, E, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: The supplier offered a small price concession on the bulk order.
entries.zh: 供应商对大宗订单给出了小幅价格让步。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，简洁的，简明的，精练的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, I, S, E
entries.en: Please keep your presentation clear and concise.
entries.zh: 请保持演示清晰简洁。

entries.meaning: 自信的；有把握的；确信的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，自信的，有把握的，确信的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, F, I, D, E, N, T
entries.en: We are confident that sales will improve next quarter.
entries.zh: 我们确信下季度销售额会有所提升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，机密的，保密的，亲信的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, F, I, D, E, N, T, I, A, L
entries.en: Please treat this document as strictly confidential.
entries.zh: 请将此文件视为严格保密。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，联系，接触，联络人
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, A, C, T
entries.en: Please contact our sales team for a customized quote.
entries.zh: 如需定制报价，请联系我们的销售团队。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，公司的，法人的，团体的
entries.spelling: C, O, R, P, O, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The firm is revising its corporate culture guidelines.
entries.zh: 该公司正在修订企业文化准则。

entries.meaning: 通信；往来信件；对应关系
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，通信，往来信件，对应关系
entries.spelling: C, O, R, R, E, S, P, O, N, D, E, N, C, E
entries.en: All business correspondence should be filed by date.
entries.zh: 所有商务信函应按日期归档。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，标准，准则，尺度（复criteria）
entries.spelling: C, R, I, T, E, R, I, O, N
entries.en: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a supplier.
entries.zh: 价格并非选择供应商的唯一标准。

entries.meaning: 至关重要的；关键的；决定性的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，至关重要的，关键的，决定性的
entries.spelling: C, R, U, C, I, A, L
entries.en: Timely communication is crucial to project success.
entries.zh: 及时沟通对项目成功至关重要。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，顾客，客户，主顾
entries.spelling: C, U, S, T, O, M, E, R
entries.en: Customer satisfaction remains our top performance metric.
entries.zh: 客户满意度仍是我们的首要业绩指标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，损坏，损害，损失
entries.spelling: D, A, M, A, G, E
entries.en: Please report any items that were damaged in transit within 48 hours.
entries.zh: 运输途中受损的物品请在 48 小时内报告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，债务，欠款
entries.spelling: D, E, B, T
entries.en: The company used the proceeds from the sale to pay off its debt.
entries.zh: 公司用出售所得款项还清了债务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，缺陷，瑕疵
entries.spelling: D, E, F, E, C, T
entries.en: The warranty covers any manufacturing defect for two years.
entries.zh: 保修涵盖两年内的任何制造缺陷。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，委派，授权，代表
entries.spelling: D, E, L, E, G, A, T, E
entries.en: Good managers know how to delegate tasks to their team members.
entries.zh: 好的经理懂得把任务委派给团队成员。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可靠的，可信赖的
entries.spelling: D, E, P, E, N, D, A, B, L, E
entries.en: We chose the vendor because of its dependable delivery record.
entries.zh: 我们选择这家供应商是因为其交货记录可靠。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，折旧，贬值
entries.spelling: D, E, P, R, E, C, I, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The accountant calculated the depreciation of the company's vehicles.
entries.zh: 会计计算了公司车辆的折旧。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，副手，代理人，副的
entries.spelling: D, E, P, U, T, Y
entries.en: The deputy manager will chair the meeting in Ms. Chen's absence.
entries.zh: 陈女士不在时，由副经理主持会议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，描述，说明
entries.spelling: D, E, S, C, R, I, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Please read the job description carefully before applying.
entries.zh: 申请前请仔细阅读职位描述。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，目的地，终点
entries.spelling: D, E, S, T, I, N, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Your luggage will be checked through to your final destination.
entries.zh: 您的行李将直接托运至最终目的地。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，拆下，分离，撕下
entries.spelling: D, E, T, A, C, H
entries.en: Please detach the bottom portion and return it with your payment.
entries.zh: 请撕下底部回执，连同付款一并寄回。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，细节，详述
entries.spelling: D, E, T, A, I, L
entries.en: For further details, please contact our customer service team.
entries.zh: 欲知详情，请联系我们的客服团队。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，发现，察觉，检测
entries.spelling: D, E, T, E, C, T
entries.en: The new software can detect errors in invoices automatically.
entries.zh: 新软件能自动检测发票中的错误。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，设计，想出（方案）
entries.spelling: D, E, V, I, S, E
entries.en: The team devised a new strategy to reduce shipping costs.
entries.zh: 团队制定了一项降低运费的新策略。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，减少，降低，削弱
entries.spelling: D, I, M, I, N, I, S, H
entries.en: Demand for the older model has diminished since the launch.
entries.zh: 新品上市后，旧款的需求已经减少。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或形容词，指引，指导，直接的
entries.spelling: D, I, R, E, C, T
entries.en: Please direct all questions about payroll to the HR department.
entries.zh: 所有工资相关问题请咨询人力资源部。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，名录，通讯录，目录
entries.spelling: D, I, R, E, C, T, O, R, Y
entries.en: You can find her extension number in the staff directory.
entries.zh: 你可以在员工通讯录里找到她的分机号。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，停止，停产，中止
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, O, N, T, I, N, U, E
entries.en: This printer model has been discontinued, but parts are still available.
entries.zh: 这款打印机已停产，但零件仍有供应。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，自行决定权，谨慎
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, R, E, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Bonuses are awarded at the discretion of the department head.
entries.zh: 奖金由部门主管酌情发放。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，发送，派遣，发货
entries.spelling: D, I, S, P, A, T, C, H
entries.en: All orders placed before noon are dispatched the same day.
entries.zh: 中午前下的订单均于当天发货。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，展示，陈列，显示
entries.spelling: D, I, S, P, L, A, Y
entries.en: The new product line will be on display at the trade fair.
entries.zh: 新产品系列将在贸易展上展出。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，处理，丢弃
entries.spelling: D, I, S, P, O, S, E
entries.en: Please dispose of used batteries in the designated container.
entries.zh: 请将废旧电池丢进指定的回收箱。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，区分，使与众不同
entries.spelling: D, I, S, T, I, N, G, U, I, S, H
entries.en: Excellent service distinguishes our hotel from its competitors.
entries.zh: 优质服务让我们的酒店在竞争对手中脱颖而出。

entries.meaning: 使多样化；扩大经营范围
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使多样化，扩大经营范围
entries.spelling: D, I, V, E, R, S, I, F, Y
entries.en: The firm plans to diversify into renewable energy.
entries.zh: 公司计划向可再生能源领域拓展业务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，股息，红利
entries.spelling: D, I, V, I, D, E, N, D
entries.en: The board announced a higher dividend for shareholders this year.
entries.zh: 董事会宣布今年向股东派发更高的股息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，捐赠，捐款
entries.spelling: D, O, N, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The company made a donation to the local children's hospital.
entries.zh: 公司向当地儿童医院捐了款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，耐用的，持久的
entries.spelling: D, U, R, A, B, L, E
entries.en: These office chairs are made of durable, easy-to-clean materials.
entries.zh: 这些办公椅由耐用且易清洁的材料制成。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词或形容词，副本，复制，重复的
entries.spelling: D, U, P, L, I, C, A, T, E
entries.en: Please submit the signed contract in duplicate.
entries.zh: 请提交一式两份已签署的合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，职责，值班，关税
entries.spelling: D, U, T, Y
entries.en: Her main duties include scheduling meetings and handling client calls.
entries.zh: 她的主要职责包括安排会议和处理客户来电。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，经济实惠的，节约的
entries.spelling: E, C, O, N, O, M, I, C, A, L
entries.en: Taking the train is the most economical way to get to the conference.
entries.zh: 坐火车是去会议最经济实惠的方式。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有效的，（政策）生效的
entries.spelling: E, F, F, E, C, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The new dress code is effective as of November 1.
entries.zh: 新着装规定自 11 月 1 日起生效。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，消除，淘汰，排除
entries.spelling: E, L, I, M, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: The new online system will eliminate the need for paper timesheets.
entries.zh: 新的线上系统将省去纸质工时表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，出现，浮现，脱颖而出
entries.spelling: E, M, E, R, G, E
entries.en: The company has emerged as a leader in renewable energy.
entries.zh: 该公司已成为可再生能源领域的领军企业。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，强调，着重
entries.spelling: E, M, P, H, A, S, I, Z, E
entries.en: The manager emphasized the importance of meeting the deadline.
entries.zh: 经理强调了按期完成的重要性。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，雇用，使用（方法）
entries.spelling: E, M, P, L, O, Y
entries.en: The factory employs more than 500 local workers.
entries.zh: 这家工厂雇用了 500 多名本地工人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，雇员，员工
entries.spelling: E, M, P, L, O, Y, E, E
entries.en: All employees must complete the safety training by Friday.
entries.zh: 所有员工须在周五前完成安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，遇到（困难），遭遇
entries.spelling: E, N, C, O, U, N, T, E, R
entries.en: Please contact IT if you encounter any problems logging in.
entries.zh: 如果登录时遇到任何问题，请联系 IT 部门。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，从事，参与，吸引
entries.spelling: E, N, G, A, G, E
entries.en: The two firms are currently engaged in merger negotiations.
entries.zh: 两家公司目前正在进行合并谈判。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，登记，注册，报名
entries.spelling: E, N, R, O, L, L
entries.en: Staff may enroll in the leadership course through the HR portal.
entries.zh: 员工可通过人力资源门户报名领导力课程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，确保，保证
entries.spelling: E, N, S, U, R, E
entries.en: Please double-check the figures to ensure accuracy.
entries.zh: 请仔细核对数字以确保准确。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使有权，给…命名
entries.spelling: E, N, T, I, T, L, E
entries.en: Members are entitled to a 15 percent discount on all purchases.
entries.zh: 会员所有消费均可享受八五折优惠。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，进入，参赛作品，条目
entries.spelling: E, N, T, R, Y
entries.en: All contest entries must be submitted by March 31.
entries.zh: 所有参赛作品须在 3 月 31 日前提交。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，设备，器材
entries.spelling: E, Q, U, I, P, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The new equipment will be installed in the lab next week.
entries.zh: 新设备将于下周安装在实验室。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，相等的，等价物
entries.spelling: E, Q, U, I, V, A, L, E, N, T
entries.en: Applicants need a bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
entries.zh: 申请人须具备学士学位或同等工作经验。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，差事，跑腿
entries.spelling: E, R, R, A, N, D
entries.en: I need to run a few errands during my lunch break.
entries.zh: 午休时我得去办几件杂事。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，必不可少的，基本的
entries.spelling: E, S, S, E, N, T, I, A, L
entries.en: Strong communication skills are essential for this position.
entries.zh: 良好的沟通能力是该职位的必备条件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，评估，评价
entries.spelling: E, V, A, L, U, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Annual performance evaluations will take place in December.
entries.zh: 年度绩效考评将于 12 月进行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，超过，过量（的）
entries.spelling: E, X, C, E, S, S
entries.en: Passengers must pay a fee for excess baggage.
entries.zh: 乘客须为超重行李支付费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，主管，高管，执行的
entries.spelling: E, X, E, C, U, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The executive committee will meet to approve the budget.
entries.zh: 执行委员会将开会审批预算。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，扩张，扩展
entries.spelling: E, X, P, A, N, S, I, O, N
entries.en: The expansion of the factory will create 200 new jobs.
entries.zh: 工厂扩建将创造 200 个新岗位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，加快，促进（处理）
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, D, I, T, E
entries.en: For an additional fee, we can expedite your order.
entries.zh: 支付额外费用后，我们可加急处理您的订单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，延期，分机，扩建
entries.spelling: E, X, T, E, N, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Please call me at extension 214 if you have any questions.
entries.zh: 如有疑问，请拨打分机 214 联系我。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，曝光，接触，风险暴露
entries.spelling: E, X, P, O, S, U, R, E
entries.en: The trade fair gave our brand valuable exposure.
entries.zh: 这次商展为我们的品牌带来了宝贵的曝光。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（交通）票价，车费
entries.spelling: F, A, R, E
entries.en: Train fares will increase by 3 percent next month.
entries.zh: 下个月火车票价将上涨 3%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，费用，酬金
entries.spelling: F, E, E
entries.en: The registration fee includes lunch and conference materials.
entries.zh: 报名费包含午餐和会议资料。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，数字，人物，认为
entries.spelling: F, I, G, U, R, E
entries.en: Third-quarter sales figures exceeded our expectations.
entries.zh: 第三季度的销售数据超出了我们的预期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，财务，金融，为…提供资金
entries.spelling: F, I, N, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Please submit your expense reports to the finance department.
entries.zh: 请将报销单提交至财务部。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，财政的，会计年度的
entries.spelling: F, I, S, C, A, L
entries.en: Profits rose sharply in the last fiscal year.
entries.zh: 上一财年利润大幅增长。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，易碎的，脆弱的
entries.spelling: F, R, A, G, I, L, E
entries.en: Fragile items should be wrapped carefully before shipping.
entries.zh: 易碎物品在寄送前应仔细包装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，资金，基金，为…提供资金
entries.spelling: F, U, N, D
entries.en: The research project is funded by a government grant.
entries.zh: 这项研究由政府补助金资助。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，授予，准许，补助金
entries.spelling: G, R, A, N, T
entries.en: The city granted the company permission to build a new store.
entries.zh: 市政府批准该公司新建一家门店。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，收集，聚集，推断
entries.spelling: G, A, T, H, E, R
entries.en: Please gather in the main lobby at 8:30 A.M. for the factory tour.
entries.zh: 请于上午 8:30 在主大厅集合参加工厂参观。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，估计，衡量，量具
entries.spelling: G, A, U, G, E
entries.en: The survey was designed to gauge employee interest in a flexible schedule.
entries.zh: 这项调查旨在了解员工对弹性工作时间的兴趣。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，小费，（离职）赏金
entries.spelling: G, R, A, T, U, I, T, Y
entries.en: A 15 percent gratuity will be added to bills for groups of eight or more.
entries.zh: 八人及以上的团体账单将加收 15% 的小费。

entries.meaning: 总的；毛的（未扣除的）；获得…毛收入
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，总的，毛的（未扣除的），获得…毛收入
entries.spelling: G, R, O, S, S
entries.en: The firm's gross revenue rose by 12 percent in the third quarter.
entries.zh: 公司第三季度的总营收增长了 12%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，指导方针，准则
entries.spelling: G, U, I, D, E, L, I, N, E
entries.en: All staff must follow the updated guidelines for submitting expense reports.
entries.zh: 全体员工必须遵守提交报销单的新规定。

entries.meaning: 讲义；发放的资料；救济品
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，讲义，发放的资料，救济品
entries.spelling: H, A, N, D, O, U, T
entries.en: Copies of the handout will be distributed at the start of the seminar.
entries.zh: 讲义将在研讨会开始时分发。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，危险，危害，冒险提出
entries.spelling: H, A, Z, A, R, D
entries.en: Boxes left in the hallway pose a fire hazard and must be removed.
entries.zh: 堆在走廊的箱子构成火灾隐患，必须移走。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，犹豫，迟疑
entries.spelling: H, E, S, I, T, A, T, E
entries.en: If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our help desk.
entries.zh: 如有任何问题，请随时联系我们的服务台。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，阻碍，妨碍
entries.spelling: H, I, N, D, E, R
entries.en: Frequent system outages have hindered the team's progress on the project.
entries.zh: 频繁的系统故障阻碍了团队的项目进展。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，主办，主持，主人
entries.spelling: H, O, S, T
entries.en: Our branch will host the regional sales conference next spring.
entries.zh: 我们分公司将于明年春季主办区域销售会议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，说明，阐明，配插图
entries.spelling: I, L, L, U, S, T, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The chart illustrates how sales have changed over the past five years.
entries.zh: 这张图表说明了过去五年的销售变化。

entries.meaning: 立即的；直接的；最接近的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，立即的，直接的，最接近的
entries.spelling: I, M, M, E, D, I, A, T, E
entries.en: Report any equipment malfunction to your immediate supervisor.
entries.zh: 任何设备故障请报告给你的直属上司。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，暗示，意味着
entries.spelling: I, M, P, L, Y
entries.en: What is implied about the new branch office?
entries.zh: 关于新分公司，文中暗示了什么？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，进口，输入，进口商品
entries.spelling: I, M, P, O, R, T
entries.en: The company imports most of its raw materials from Southeast Asia.
entries.zh: 公司大部分原材料从东南亚进口。

entries.meaning: 为…举行开幕/就职典礼；开创
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，为…举行开幕/就职典礼，开创
entries.spelling: I, N, A, U, G, U, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The mayor will inaugurate the new convention center on Friday.
entries.zh: 市长将于周五为新会展中心揭幕。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，收入，所得
entries.spelling: I, N, C, O, M, E
entries.en: Rental properties provide the firm with a steady source of income.
entries.zh: 出租物业为公司提供了稳定的收入来源。

entries.meaning: 包含；纳入；注册成立公司
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，包含，纳入，注册成立公司
entries.spelling: I, N, C, O, R, P, O, R, A, T, E
entries.en: We have incorporated customer suggestions into the new product design.
entries.zh: 我们已将客户建议融入新产品设计中。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，增量，（薪水的）定期增加
entries.spelling: I, N, C, R, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Employees receive an annual salary increment based on performance.
entries.zh: 员工每年根据绩效获得加薪。

entries.meaning: 不可或缺的；必不可少的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，不可或缺的，必不可少的
entries.spelling: I, N, D, I, S, P, E, N, S, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Her experience with overseas clients has made her indispensable to the team.
entries.zh: 她与海外客户打交道的经验使她成为团队中不可或缺的一员。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，通货膨胀，膨胀
entries.spelling: I, N, F, L, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Wages have not kept pace with inflation over the past two years.
entries.zh: 过去两年工资增长没有跟上通货膨胀。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，基础设施，基础架构
entries.spelling: I, N, F, R, A, S, T, R, U, C, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The city plans to invest heavily in public transportation infrastructure.
entries.zh: 该市计划大力投资公共交通基础设施。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，成分，原料，（成功的）要素
entries.spelling: I, N, G, R, E, D, I, E, N, T
entries.en: The restaurant uses only locally sourced ingredients.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅只使用本地采购的食材。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，询问，打听
entries.spelling: I, N, Q, U, I, R, E
entries.en: I am writing to inquire about the marketing position advertised on your website.
entries.zh: 我写信是想询问贵公司网站上发布的市场职位。

entries.meaning: 分期付款（的一期）；（连载的）一集
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分期付款（的一期），（连载的）一集
entries.spelling: I, N, S, T, A, L, L, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Customers can pay for the furniture in twelve monthly installments.
entries.zh: 顾客可以分十二个月分期支付家具款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，指示，命令，教授
entries.spelling: I, N, S, T, R, U, C, T
entries.en: The manager instructed all employees to back up their files before Friday.
entries.zh: 经理指示所有员工在周五前备份文件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，保险，保险费
entries.spelling: I, N, S, U, R, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Full-time employees are eligible for health insurance after three months.
entries.zh: 全职员工三个月后可享有医疗保险。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，整合，使融入
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, G, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The new app integrates seamlessly with our existing accounting software.
entries.zh: 这款新应用能与我们现有的会计软件无缝整合。

entries.meaning: 临时的；过渡期的；过渡期间
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，临时的，过渡期的，过渡期间
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, R, I, M
entries.en: Ms. Patel will serve as interim director until a replacement is hired.
entries.zh: 在聘到接任者之前，Patel 女士将担任代理主管。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，中场休息，间歇
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, R, M, I, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Refreshments will be available in the lobby during the intermission.
entries.zh: 中场休息时大厅将提供茶点。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，调查，研究
entries.spelling: I, N, V, E, S, T, I, G, A, T, E
entries.en: Technicians are investigating the cause of the power outage.
entries.zh: 技术人员正在调查停电的原因。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，投资，投入
entries.spelling: I, N, V, E, S, T, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The new software was a worthwhile investment because it cut processing time in half.
entries.zh: 这套新软件是一项值得的投资，因为它把处理时间缩短了一半。

entries.meaning: 问题；（期刊）期号；发布，发放
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，问题，（期刊）期号，发布，发放
entries.spelling: I, S, S, U, E
entries.en: Visitor badges will be issued at the front desk upon arrival.
entries.zh: 访客抵达后将在前台领取访客证。

entries.meaning: 联合的，共同的；关节；接合处
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，联合的，共同的，关节，接合处
entries.spelling: J, O, I, N, T
entries.en: The two firms announced a joint venture to develop electric delivery vans.
entries.zh: 两家公司宣布成立合资企业，共同研发电动送货车。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，危及，使陷入险境
entries.spelling: J, E, O, P, A, R, D, I, Z, E
entries.en: Further delays in shipping could jeopardize our contract with the retailer.
entries.zh: 运输若再延误，可能会危及我们和零售商的合同。

entries.meaning: 热衷的，渴望的；敏锐的；激烈的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，热衷的，渴望的，敏锐的，激烈的
entries.spelling: K, E, E, N
entries.en: Ms. Patel is keen to hire candidates with a keen eye for detail.
entries.zh: 帕特尔女士很想招聘对细节观察敏锐的候选人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，主旨，主题演讲的
entries.spelling: K, E, Y, N, O, T, E
entries.en: The CEO of Arlo Tech will deliver the keynote address on the first day of the conference.
entries.zh: Arlo 科技的首席执行官将在会议第一天发表主题演讲。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，标签，（唱片）品牌，贴标签
entries.spelling: L, A, B, E, L
entries.en: Please make sure every box is clearly labeled before it leaves the warehouse.
entries.zh: 请确保每个箱子出仓前都贴有清楚的标签。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，劳动，劳工，人工（费）
entries.spelling: L, A, B, O, R
entries.en: The repair estimate covers both parts and labor.
entries.zh: 这份维修报价包含零件费和人工费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，房东，业主
entries.spelling: L, A, N, D, L, O, R, D
entries.en: We need the landlord's approval before we can renovate the office.
entries.zh: 我们得先获得房东批准，才能装修办公室。

entries.meaning: （合同、会员等）失效，过期；疏忽；（时间）流逝
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，（合同、会员等）失效，过期，疏忽，（时间）流逝
entries.spelling: L, A, P, S, E
entries.en: Renew your parking permit online so that it does not lapse at the end of the month.
entries.zh: 请在线续办停车证，以免月底失效。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，裁员，解雇
entries.spelling: L, A, Y, O, F, F
entries.en: Management assured staff that the merger would not result in layoffs.
entries.zh: 管理层向员工保证，这次合并不会导致裁员。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分类账，总账
entries.spelling: L, E, D, G, E, R
entries.en: All expenses must be recorded in the ledger by the end of each quarter.
entries.zh: 所有开支必须在每季度末之前记入分类账。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，立法，法规
entries.spelling: L, E, G, I, S, L, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The factory upgraded its filters to comply with new environmental legislation.
entries.zh: 工厂升级了过滤设备，以符合新的环保法规。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（法律）责任，负债
entries.spelling: L, I, A, B, I, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: The hotel accepts no liability for items left in guest rooms.
entries.zh: 酒店对客人遗留在客房内的物品不承担责任。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，执照，许可证，授权
entries.spelling: L, I, C, E, N, S, E
entries.en: Only licensed electricians may perform repairs in the building.
entries.zh: 只有持证电工才能在大楼内进行维修。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，清算，变卖（资产），清偿
entries.spelling: L, I, Q, U, I, D, A, T, E
entries.en: The store plans to liquidate its remaining stock before relocating.
entries.zh: 这家店计划在搬迁前清空剩余库存。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，贷款，借出
entries.spelling: L, O, A, N
entries.en: The bakery applied for a small-business loan to buy new ovens.
entries.zh: 这家面包店申请了一笔小企业贷款来购买新烤箱。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，找到…的位置，使坐落于
entries.spelling: L, O, C, A, T, E
entries.en: Our new branch is conveniently located near the central train station.
entries.zh: 我们的新分店位置便利，就在中央火车站附近。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，住宿，寄宿处
entries.spelling: L, O, D, G, I, N, G
entries.en: The company will reimburse lodging and meals for all conference attendees.
entries.zh: 公司将为所有与会者报销住宿和餐费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，物流，（活动的）后勤安排
entries.spelling: L, O, G, I, S, T, I, C, S
entries.en: Ms. Kim will handle the logistics for next month's sales retreat.
entries.zh: 金女士将负责下个月销售团建的后勤安排。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，忠诚，（顾客的）忠诚度
entries.spelling: L, O, Y, A, L, T, Y
entries.en: Members of our loyalty program earn points on every purchase.
entries.zh: 会员积分计划的成员每次购物都能获得积分。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，赚钱的，有利可图的
entries.spelling: L, U, C, R, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The firm won a lucrative contract to supply uniforms to the airline.
entries.zh: 该公司赢得了一份为航空公司供应制服的丰厚合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，行李
entries.spelling: L, U, G, G, A, G, E
entries.en: Each passenger may bring one piece of carry-on luggage.
entries.zh: 每位乘客可携带一件随身行李。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，维持，保持，维护，坚称
entries.spelling: M, A, I, N, T, A, I, N
entries.en: Technicians maintain the printers every Friday afternoon.
entries.zh: 技术人员每周五下午维护打印机。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，故障，出故障
entries.spelling: M, A, L, F, U, N, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Due to a projector malfunction, the presentation was moved to Room 204.
entries.zh: 由于投影仪故障，演示改到 204 室进行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，强制的，必须的
entries.spelling: M, A, N, D, A, T, O, R, Y
entries.en: Attendance at Thursday's safety workshop is mandatory for all warehouse staff.
entries.zh: 所有仓库员工都必须参加周四的安全研讨会。

entries.meaning: 手册，说明书；手工的，体力的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，手册，说明书，手工的，体力的
entries.spelling: M, A, N, U, A, L
entries.en: Please refer to the user manual before contacting technical support.
entries.zh: 联系技术支持前，请先查阅用户手册。

entries.meaning: 加价，加成（售价高于成本的部分）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，加价，加成（售价高于成本的部分）
entries.spelling: M, A, R, K, U, P
entries.en: Most retailers apply a markup of about 50 percent on clothing.
entries.zh: 大多数零售商对服装的加价约为 50%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（公司的）合并
entries.spelling: M, E, R, G, E, R
entries.en: The merger between the two banks is expected to be completed in March.
entries.zh: 两家银行的合并预计将于三月完成。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，里程碑，重大事件
entries.spelling: M, I, L, E, S, T, O, N, E
entries.en: Reaching one million customers was an important milestone for the company.
entries.zh: 客户数达到一百万是公司的一个重要里程碑。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，调解，斡旋
entries.spelling: M, E, D, I, A, T, E
entries.en: An outside consultant was hired to mediate the dispute between management and the union.
entries.zh: 公司聘请了一位外部顾问来调解管理层与工会之间的纠纷。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，备忘录，（公司内部）通知
entries.spelling: M, E, M, O, R, A, N, D, U, M
entries.en: According to the memorandum, all staff must complete safety training by Friday.
entries.zh: 根据这份备忘录，全体员工必须在周五前完成安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，导师，指导（新人）
entries.spelling: M, E, N, T, O, R
entries.en: Each new hire is paired with a senior employee who will mentor them for six months.
entries.zh: 每位新员工都会与一位资深员工配对，由其指导六个月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，把…减到最少，最小化
entries.spelling: M, I, N, I, M, I, Z, E
entries.en: To minimize delays, passengers are asked to have their boarding passes ready.
entries.zh: 为尽量减少延误，请乘客提前准备好登机牌。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，会议记录，会议纪要
entries.spelling: M, I, N, U, T, E, S
entries.en: Ms. Ortiz will take the minutes and circulate them to everyone after the meeting.
entries.zh: 奥尔蒂斯女士会做会议记录，并在会后分发给每个人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，修改，调整
entries.spelling: M, O, D, I, F, Y
entries.en: The engineers modified the design so the device would be easier to assemble.
entries.zh: 工程师修改了设计，使这款设备更容易组装。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，士气，（员工的）精神面貌
entries.spelling: M, O, R, A, L, E
entries.en: The flexible work policy has significantly improved employee morale.
entries.zh: 弹性工作制度显著改善了员工士气。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，抵押贷款，房贷，抵押
entries.spelling: M, O, R, T, G, A, G, E
entries.en: The bank offers lower mortgage rates to first-time home buyers.
entries.zh: 银行为首次购房者提供更低的房贷利率。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，净的（扣除后），净赚
entries.spelling: N, E, T
entries.en: The company's net profit rose by 12 percent in the third quarter.
entries.zh: 公司第三季度的净利润增长了12%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提名，任命
entries.spelling: N, O, M, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: Ms. Chen was nominated for the Employee of the Year award.
entries.zh: 陈女士获得了年度最佳员工奖的提名。

entries.meaning: 显著的；值得注意的；著名的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，显著的，值得注意的，著名的
entries.spelling: N, O, T, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The most notable change in the new office is the open-plan layout.
entries.zh: 新办公室最显著的变化是开放式布局。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，新手，初学者
entries.spelling: N, O, V, I, C, E
entries.en: The software tutorial is designed for novices with no programming experience.
entries.zh: 这个软件教程是为没有编程经验的新手设计的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，义务，责任
entries.spelling: O, B, L, I, G, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Customers can try the service for 30 days without obligation.
entries.zh: 顾客可以免费试用这项服务30天，无任何附带义务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，抵消，弥补
entries.spelling: O, F, F, S, E, T
entries.en: Higher fuel costs were partly offset by an increase in ticket sales.
entries.zh: 燃油成本上涨被票务销售的增长部分抵消了。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，（新员工）入职培训，使适应
entries.spelling: O, N, B, O, A, R, D
entries.en: HR will onboard the new interns on Monday morning.
entries.zh: 人力资源部将在周一上午为新实习生办理入职引导。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，进行中的，持续的
entries.spelling: O, N, G, O, I, N, G
entries.en: Due to ongoing construction, the east entrance will be closed until May.
entries.zh: 由于施工仍在进行，东侧入口将关闭至五月。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，门店，销售点，电源插座
entries.spelling: O, U, T, L, E, T
entries.en: The company plans to open five new retail outlets in the region next year.
entries.zh: 公司计划明年在该地区新开五家零售门店。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，前景，展望，观点
entries.spelling: O, U, T, L, O, O, K
entries.en: Analysts remain optimistic about the outlook for the tourism industry.
entries.zh: 分析师对旅游业的前景仍持乐观态度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，产量，产出
entries.spelling: O, U, T, P, U, T
entries.en: The factory doubled its output after installing the new assembly line.
entries.zh: 安装新生产线后，这家工厂的产量翻了一番。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，外包
entries.spelling: O, U, T, S, O, U, R, C, E
entries.en: The firm decided to outsource its payroll processing to an accounting agency.
entries.zh: 公司决定将工资核算外包给一家会计机构。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，超额预订
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, B, O, O, K
entries.en: Because the flight was overbooked, several passengers were offered vouchers to take a later one.
entries.zh: 由于航班超售，几位乘客获得代金券以改乘较晚的班次。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，逾期的，过期未付的
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, D, U, E
entries.en: Please settle the overdue balance on your account within ten days.
entries.zh: 请在十天内结清您账户上的逾期余额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，（日常）管理费用，头顶上的
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, H, E, A, D
entries.en: Moving to a smaller office helped the startup cut its overhead.
entries.zh: 搬到较小的办公室帮这家初创公司削减了运营费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，监督，主管
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, S, E, E
entries.en: Mr. Patel will oversee the renovation of the main lobby.
entries.zh: 帕特尔先生将负责监督主大厅的翻修工程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，概述，概况
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, V, I, E, W
entries.en: The director began the meeting with a brief overview of last quarter's results.
entries.zh: 总监以简要概述上季度的业绩开始了会议。

entries.meaning: 所有权；（对工作的）主人翁意识
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，所有权，（对工作的）主人翁意识
entries.spelling: O, W, N, E, R, S, H, I, P
entries.en: The restaurant reopened last month under new ownership.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅上个月在新业主经营下重新开业。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，包装，包装材料
entries.spelling: P, A, C, K, A, G, I, N, G
entries.en: The company switched to recyclable packaging to reduce waste.
entries.zh: 公司改用可回收包装以减少浪费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，专家小组，评审团，面板
entries.spelling: P, A, N, E, L
entries.en: The conference will close with a panel discussion on remote work.
entries.zh: 会议将以一场关于远程办公的小组讨论结束。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，包裹，（土地的）一块
entries.spelling: P, A, R, C, E, L
entries.en: You can track your parcel online using the number on your receipt.
entries.zh: 您可以用收据上的号码在网上追踪您的包裹。

entries.meaning: 待定的；待处理的；在…之前
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或介词，待定的，待处理的，在…之前
entries.spelling: P, E, N, D, I, N, G
entries.en: The contract has been drafted but is still pending approval from the legal department.
entries.zh: 合同已经起草好了，但仍在等待法务部的批准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，顾客，常客，赞助人
entries.spelling: P, A, T, R, O, N
entries.en: Patrons are reminded that the restaurant will close early on Friday for a private event.
entries.zh: 敬请顾客注意，本餐厅周五因私人活动将提前打烊。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，养老金，退休金
entries.spelling: P, E, N, S, I, O, N
entries.en: All full-time employees are automatically enrolled in the company pension plan.
entries.zh: 所有全职员工都会自动加入公司的养老金计划。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，易腐烂的，易变质的
entries.spelling: P, E, R, I, S, H, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Perishable items must be stored in the refrigerator immediately upon delivery.
entries.zh: 易腐物品送达后必须立即放入冰箱保存。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，额外福利，津贴
entries.spelling: P, E, R, K
entries.en: One of the perks of working here is a free gym membership.
entries.zh: 在这里工作的福利之一是免费的健身房会员资格。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，请愿（书），请求
entries.spelling: P, E, T, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Residents signed a petition asking the city to add more parking near the station.
entries.zh: 居民们签署了一份请愿书，请求市政府在车站附近增设停车位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，拥有，具备
entries.spelling: P, O, S, S, E, S, S
entries.en: Applicants must possess at least three years of experience in project management.
entries.zh: 申请人须具备至少三年的项目管理经验。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，预防措施，防范
entries.spelling: P, R, E, C, A, U, T, I, O, N
entries.en: As a precaution, all files should be backed up before the system upgrade.
entries.zh: 为以防万一，系统升级前应备份所有文件。

entries.meaning: （企业的）房屋及场地；经营场所
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（企业的）房屋及场地，经营场所
entries.spelling: P, R, E, M, I, S, E, S
entries.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the premises.
entries.zh: 场所内任何地方均严禁吸烟。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，主持，担任主席
entries.spelling: P, R, E, S, I, D, E
entries.en: Ms. Tanaka will preside over this year's annual shareholders' meeting.
entries.zh: 田中女士将主持今年的年度股东大会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有声望的，享有盛誉的
entries.spelling: P, R, E, S, T, I, G, I, O, U, S
entries.en: The architecture firm received a prestigious award for its design of the new library.
entries.zh: 这家建筑事务所因新图书馆的设计荣获一项享有盛誉的奖项。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，盛行，占上风
entries.spelling: P, R, E, V, A, I, L
entries.en: Salaries will be adjusted to reflect prevailing market rates.
entries.zh: 薪资将根据现行市场水平进行调整。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，收益，（活动）所得款项
entries.spelling: P, R, O, C, E, E, D, S
entries.en: All proceeds from the charity run will be donated to the local children's hospital.
entries.zh: 慈善跑的所有收益将捐给当地儿童医院。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有利可图的，盈利的
entries.spelling: P, R, O, F, I, T, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The new product line became profitable within its first year on the market.
entries.zh: 新产品线上市第一年就实现了盈利。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，禁止
entries.spelling: P, R, O, H, I, B, I, T
entries.en: Company policy prohibits employees from sharing client data outside the firm.
entries.zh: 公司规定禁止员工将客户数据泄露到公司以外。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，预测，预估，投影
entries.spelling: P, R, O, J, E, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Third-quarter revenue exceeded our projections by nearly ten percent.
entries.zh: 第三季度营收比我们的预测高出近百分之十。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，著名的，显眼的
entries.spelling: P, R, O, M, I, N, E, N, T
entries.en: The keynote speech will be given by a prominent economist from Harvard.
entries.zh: 主题演讲将由一位来自哈佛的知名经济学家发表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，晋升，促销
entries.spelling: P, R, O, M, O, T, I, O, N
entries.en: After five years in sales, Mr. Ortiz received a promotion to regional manager.
entries.zh: 在销售岗位工作五年后，奥尔蒂斯先生晋升为区域经理。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，校对
entries.spelling: P, R, O, O, F, R, E, A, D
entries.en: Please proofread the brochure carefully before it goes to the printer.
entries.zh: 宣传册付印前请仔细校对。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，潜在的，未来的
entries.spelling: P, R, O, S, P, E, C, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The sales team will give a product demonstration to several prospective clients next week.
entries.zh: 销售团队下周将向几位潜在客户进行产品演示。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，准时的，守时的
entries.spelling: P, U, N, C, T, U, A, L
entries.en: Employees are expected to be punctual for all client meetings.
entries.zh: 员工参加所有客户会议都应准时。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，接待处，招待会，接收
entries.spelling: R, E, C, E, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: A welcome reception for new staff will be held in the lobby at 5 P.M.
entries.zh: 新员工欢迎招待会将于下午 5 点在大堂举行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，报销，偿还
entries.spelling: R, E, I, M, B, U, R, S, E
entries.en: The company will reimburse you for all reasonable travel expenses.
entries.zh: 公司将为您报销所有合理的差旅费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，搬迁，调动（工作地点）
entries.spelling: R, E, L, O, C, A, T, E
entries.en: The firm plans to relocate its headquarters to a larger building downtown.
entries.zh: 该公司计划将总部迁往市中心一栋更大的大楼。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，汇款，汇付
entries.spelling: R, E, M, I, T
entries.en: Please remit payment within thirty days of the invoice date.
entries.zh: 请于发票开具之日起三十天内付款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，报酬，薪酬
entries.spelling: R, E, M, U, N, E, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: We offer competitive remuneration and opportunities for career growth.
entries.zh: 我们提供有竞争力的薪酬和职业发展机会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，租赁，租金，出租的
entries.spelling: R, E, N, T, A, L
entries.en: The rental fee includes insurance and unlimited mileage.
entries.zh: 租金包含保险和不限里程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，代表，销售代表
entries.spelling: R, E, P, R, E, S, E, N, T, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: A customer service representative will contact you within 24 hours.
entries.zh: 客服代表将在 24 小时内与您联系。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，（正式）申请单，请购
entries.spelling: R, E, Q, U, I, S, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Office supplies can be ordered by submitting a requisition form to the purchasing department.
entries.zh: 办公用品可通过向采购部提交申领表来订购。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，轮换，轮流，旋转
entries.spelling: R, O, T, A, T, E
entries.en: Team members rotate the responsibility of taking meeting minutes each week.
entries.zh: 团队成员每周轮流负责做会议记录。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，例行程序，常规的
entries.spelling: R, O, U, T, I, N, E
entries.en: The elevators will be out of service on Saturday for routine maintenance.
entries.zh: 电梯将于周六因例行维护停止使用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，经济衰退，萧条
entries.spelling: R, E, C, E, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Many retailers cut back on hiring during the recession.
entries.zh: 经济衰退期间，许多零售商缩减了招聘。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，茶点，点心饮料
entries.spelling: R, E, F, R, E, S, H, M, E, N, T, S
entries.en: Light refreshments will be served in the lobby after the keynote speech.
entries.zh: 主题演讲结束后，大厅将提供简单茶点。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，翻新，整修
entries.spelling: R, E, F, U, R, B, I, S, H
entries.en: The hotel will refurbish all guest rooms before the peak travel season.
entries.zh: 酒店将在旅游旺季前翻新所有客房。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，注册，登记，报名
entries.spelling: R, E, G, I, S, T, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Early registration for the conference ends on Friday.
entries.zh: 会议的提前报名将于周五截止。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可靠的，可信赖的
entries.spelling: R, E, L, I, A, B, L, E
entries.en: We chose this courier because its delivery service is fast and reliable.
entries.zh: 我们选择这家快递公司，是因为它的送货服务快速又可靠。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，剩余部分，余款
entries.spelling: R, E, M, A, I, N, D, E, R
entries.en: A deposit is required now, and the remainder is due upon delivery.
entries.zh: 现在需支付订金，余款于交货时付清。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，提醒，提示函，催款单
entries.spelling: R, E, M, I, N, D, E, R
entries.en: This is a friendly reminder that your membership expires next week.
entries.zh: 温馨提醒：您的会员资格将于下周到期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，续约，续订，更新
entries.spelling: R, E, N, E, W, A, L
entries.en: Your lease is due for renewal at the end of March.
entries.zh: 您的租约将于三月底到期需续签。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，名声，声誉
entries.spelling: R, E, P, U, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The firm has a strong reputation for excellent customer service.
entries.zh: 这家公司以卓越的客户服务享有盛誉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，重新安排时间，改期
entries.spelling: R, E, S, C, H, E, D, U, L, E
entries.en: Could we reschedule our call for Thursday afternoon?
entries.zh: 我们能把电话会议改到周四下午吗？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，保护，保障，保护措施
entries.spelling: S, A, F, E, G, U, A, R, D
entries.en: The new policy is designed to safeguard customers' personal information.
entries.zh: 新政策旨在保护客户的个人信息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，仔细审查，详查
entries.spelling: S, C, R, U, T, I, N, I, Z, E
entries.en: The auditors will scrutinize every expense report submitted this quarter.
entries.zh: 审计人员将仔细审查本季度提交的每份报销单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，签名，招牌的，标志性的
entries.spelling: S, I, G, N, A, T, U, R, E
entries.en: Please return the form with your signature by Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五前将签好名的表格交回。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，电子表格
entries.spelling: S, P, R, E, A, D, S, H, E, E, T
entries.en: I've attached a spreadsheet with this month's sales figures.
entries.zh: 我附上了一份包含本月销售数据的电子表格。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，股份，利害关系，赌注
entries.spelling: S, T, A, K, E
entries.en: The investment group acquired a minority stake in the startup.
entries.zh: 该投资集团收购了这家初创公司的少数股权。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，文具，信纸
entries.spelling: S, T, A, T, I, O, N, E, R, Y
entries.en: Please order more stationery before the supply cabinet runs out.
entries.zh: 请在储物柜用完之前再订一些文具。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，规定，明确要求
entries.spelling: S, T, I, P, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within 30 days.
entries.zh: 合同规定必须在 30 天内付款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，储存，仓储，存储空间
entries.spelling: S, T, O, R, A, G, E
entries.en: Old files have been moved to the storage room on the basement level.
entries.zh: 旧文件已移到地下层的储藏室。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，精简，使高效化
entries.spelling: S, T, R, E, A, M, L, I, N, E
entries.en: The new software will streamline the invoice approval process.
entries.zh: 新软件将简化发票审批流程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，订阅，订购，会员费
entries.spelling: S, U, B, S, C, R, I, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Your annual subscription will be renewed automatically unless you cancel it.
entries.zh: 除非您取消，否则您的年度订阅将自动续订。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，子公司，附属的
entries.spelling: S, U, B, S, I, D, I, A, R, Y
entries.en: The company plans to open a subsidiary in Singapore next year.
entries.zh: 公司计划明年在新加坡成立一家子公司。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，超过，胜过
entries.spelling: S, U, R, P, A, S, S
entries.en: Third-quarter profits surpassed analysts' expectations.
entries.zh: 第三季度利润超出了分析师的预期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，关税，价目表
entries.spelling: T, A, R, I, F, F
entries.en: The new tariffs have increased the cost of imported steel.
entries.zh: 新的关税提高了进口钢材的成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，任期，在职期间
entries.spelling: T, E, N, U, R, E
entries.en: Sales doubled during her tenure as regional manager.
entries.zh: 她担任区域经理期间，销售额翻了一番。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，客户评价，推荐信
entries.spelling: T, E, S, T, I, M, O, N, I, A, L
entries.en: Our website features testimonials from satisfied clients.
entries.zh: 我们的网站展示了满意客户的评价。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，及时的，适时的
entries.spelling: T, I, M, E, L, Y
entries.en: We appreciate your timely response to our inquiry.
entries.zh: 感谢您及时回复我们的询问。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，学费，教学
entries.spelling: T, U, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The company offers tuition reimbursement for job-related courses.
entries.zh: 公司为与工作相关的课程提供学费报销。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，推出，公布，揭幕
entries.spelling: U, N, V, E, I, L
entries.en: The company will unveil its new smartphone at next week's trade show.
entries.zh: 公司将在下周的展会上推出新款智能手机。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，代金券，凭证，优惠券
entries.spelling: V, O, U, C, H, E, R
entries.en: As an apology for the delay, we have enclosed a $20 voucher.
entries.zh: 为表示对延误的歉意，我们随信附上一张 20 美元的代金券。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，免除，放弃（权利）
entries.spelling: W, A, I, V, E
entries.en: The bank agreed to waive the annual fee for the first year.
entries.zh: 银行同意免收第一年的年费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，放弃，遗弃，中止
entries.spelling: A, B, A, N, D, O, N
entries.en: The board decided to abandon the expansion project due to rising costs.
entries.zh: 由于成本上升，董事会决定放弃扩建项目。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，废除，取消（制度、规定）
entries.spelling: A, B, O, L, I, S, H
entries.en: Management plans to abolish the outdated overtime policy next quarter.
entries.zh: 管理层计划在下季度废除过时的加班政策。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，缺席，不在，缺乏
entries.spelling: A, B, S, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Please contact the deputy manager in my absence.
entries.zh: 我不在时请联系副经理。

entries.meaning: 吸收；理解；使全神贯注；兼并
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，吸收，理解，使全神贯注
entries.spelling: A, B, S, O, R, B
entries.en: The supplier agreed to absorb the extra shipping cost.
entries.zh: 供应商同意承担额外的运费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，加速，加快，促进
entries.spelling: A, C, C, E, L, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: New software tools helped accelerate the product development cycle.
entries.zh: 新的软件工具帮助加快了产品开发周期。

entries.meaning: 可到达的；易获得的；易懂的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可到达的，易获得的，易懂的
entries.spelling: A, C, C, E, S, S, I, B, L, E
entries.en: The new branch is easily accessible by public transportation.
entries.zh: 新分店乘坐公共交通很容易到达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，陪伴，伴随，附有
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, M, P, A, N, Y
entries.en: A detailed brochure will accompany each sample shipment.
entries.zh: 每批样品出货都会附上一份详细手册。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，完成，实现，达成
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, M, P, L, I, S, H
entries.en: The team accomplished all of its quarterly sales targets.
entries.zh: 该团队完成了所有季度销售目标。

entries.meaning: 负有责任的；应作说明的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，负有责任的，应作说明的
entries.spelling: A, C, C, O, U, N, T, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Managers are accountable for meeting the safety standards.
entries.zh: 经理们对达到安全标准负有责任。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，积累，积聚，堆积
entries.spelling: A, C, C, U, M, U, L, A, T, E
entries.en: Interest will accumulate on the unpaid balance each month.
entries.zh: 未付余额每月都会累积利息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，准确性，精确度
entries.spelling: A, C, C, U, R, A, C, Y
entries.en: Please double-check the figures for accuracy before submission.
entries.zh: 提交前请再次核对数字的准确性。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，激活，启用，使运作
entries.spelling: A, C, T, I, V, A, T, E
entries.en: You must activate your membership card within seven days.
entries.zh: 你必须在七天内激活会员卡。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，额外的，附加的，追加的
entries.spelling: A, D, D, I, T, I, O, N, A, L
entries.en: Guests may request an additional night at a discounted rate.
entries.zh: 客人可以优惠房价加订一晚。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，邻近的，毗连的
entries.spelling: A, D, J, A, C, E, N, T
entries.en: The conference room is adjacent to the main lobby.
entries.zh: 会议室紧邻主大厅。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，调整，调节，适应
entries.spelling: A, D, J, U, S, T
entries.en: We may need to adjust the delivery date if the shipment is delayed.
entries.zh: 如果货运延误，我们可能需要调整交货日期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，管理，执行，施行
entries.spelling: A, D, M, I, N, I, S, T, E, R
entries.en: The HR department will administer the annual employee survey.
entries.zh: 人力资源部将负责实施年度员工调查。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，准许进入，入场费，承认
entries.spelling: A, D, M, I, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Admission to the trade show is free for registered buyers.
entries.zh: 注册采购商可免费进入该贸易展。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，采用，采纳，收养
entries.spelling: A, D, O, P, T
entries.en: The company will adopt a flexible work schedule starting in May.
entries.zh: 公司将从五月起采用弹性工作制。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，推进，提前，预付款
entries.spelling: A, D, V, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Please pay a 30 percent deposit in advance to reserve the venue.
entries.zh: 请提前支付百分之三十的定金以预订场地。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，优势，有利条件，好处
entries.spelling: A, D, V, A, N, T, A, G, E
entries.en: Our local warehouses give us a clear advantage over online-only rivals.
entries.zh: 本地仓库使我们相对纯线上对手具有明显优势。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，不利的，负面的，有害的
entries.spelling: A, D, V, E, R, S, E
entries.en: The delay was caused by adverse weather at the destination airport.
entries.zh: 延误是由目的地机场的恶劣天气造成的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，做广告，宣传，征聘启事
entries.spelling: A, D, V, E, R, T, I, S, E
entries.en: We plan to advertise the new service on social media this month.
entries.zh: 我们计划本月在社交媒体上宣传这项新服务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，建议，劝告，通知
entries.spelling: A, D, V, I, S, E
entries.en: We advise all travelers to arrive two hours before departure.
entries.zh: 我们建议所有旅客在出发前两小时到达。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，拥护，提倡，倡导者
entries.spelling: A, D, V, O, C, A, T, E
entries.en: The CEO advocates for greater investment in employee training.
entries.zh: 首席执行官主张加大对员工培训的投入。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，申明，确认，肯定
entries.spelling: A, F, F, I, R, M
entries.en: The spokesperson affirmed that the merger talks were still ongoing.
entries.zh: 发言人确认并购谈判仍在进行中。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，负担得起，提供，给予
entries.spelling: A, F, F, O, R, D
entries.en: Small firms cannot afford to ignore online customer reviews.
entries.zh: 小企业忽视网上客户评价的代价太大。

entries.meaning: 代理机构；中介；政府部门
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，代理机构，中介，政府部门
entries.spelling: A, G, E, N, C, Y
entries.en: She booked the corporate retreat through a local travel agency.
entries.zh: 她通过当地旅行社预订了公司团建行程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，代理人，经纪人，特工
entries.spelling: A, G, E, N, T
entries.en: Please contact our booking agent to change your reservation.
entries.zh: 如需更改预订，请联系我们的订票代理。

entries.meaning: 积极进取的；侵略性的；激烈的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，积极进取的，侵略性的，激烈的
entries.spelling: A, G, G, R, E, S, S, I, V, E
entries.en: The firm launched an aggressive campaign to win market share.
entries.zh: 该公司发起了积极的宣传活动以争夺市场份额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，协议，同意，一致
entries.spelling: A, G, R, E, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Both parties signed a three-year supply agreement yesterday.
entries.zh: 双方昨天签署了一份为期三年的供应协议。

entries.meaning: 过道；通道；（超市）货架通道
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，过道，通道，（超市）货架通道
entries.spelling: A, I, S, L, E
entries.en: Please keep your luggage out of the aisle during the flight.
entries.zh: 飞行途中请勿将行李放在过道上。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词或名词，警觉的，提醒，警报
entries.spelling: A, L, E, R, T
entries.en: The system will alert managers to any unusual spending.
entries.zh: 系统会提醒经理注意任何异常支出。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，联盟，结盟，合作关系
entries.spelling: A, L, L, I, A, N, C, E
entries.en: The two firms formed a strategic alliance to expand overseas.
entries.zh: 两家公司结成战略联盟以拓展海外市场。

entries.meaning: 分配；拨给（时间、资金、任务）
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，分配，拨给（时间、资金、任务）
entries.spelling: A, L, L, O, T
entries.en: Each department was allotted two weeks to complete the audit.
entries.zh: 每个部门被分配两周时间完成审计。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，改变，修改，变更
entries.spelling: A, L, T, E, R
entries.en: We may need to alter the delivery date if the shipment is delayed.
entries.zh: 若货运延误，我们可能需要更改交货日期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，抱负，雄心，志向
entries.spelling: A, M, B, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Her ambition is to become the regional sales director within five years.
entries.zh: 她的抱负是在五年内成为区域销售总监。

entries.meaning: 有雄心的；宏大的；费力的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有雄心的，宏大的，费力的
entries.spelling: A, M, B, I, T, I, O, U, S
entries.en: The company set an ambitious sales target for the next quarter.
entries.zh: 公司为下季度设定了宏大的销售目标。

entries.meaning: 便利设施；舒适；生活福利
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，便利设施，舒适，生活福利
entries.spelling: A, M, E, N, I, T, Y
entries.en: The conference hotel offers free Wi-Fi and other useful amenities.
entries.zh: 这家会议酒店提供免费无线网络及其他实用设施。

entries.meaning: 充足的；宽敞的；绰绰有余的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，充足的，宽敞的，绰绰有余的
entries.spelling: A, M, P, L, E
entries.en: Please arrive early so that you have ample time for registration.
entries.zh: 请提前到达，以便有充足时间办理登记。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，周年纪念日，周年庆
entries.spelling: A, N, N, I, V, E, R, S, A, R, Y
entries.en: The firm will host a dinner to mark its twentieth anniversary.
entries.zh: 公司将举办晚宴庆祝成立二十周年。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，道歉，致歉，辩解
entries.spelling: A, P, O, L, O, G, Y
entries.en: We sent a formal apology to the client for the delayed shipment.
entries.zh: 我们因货运延误向客户发出正式致歉。

entries.meaning: 明显的；表面上的；显而易见的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，明显的，表面上的，显而易见的
entries.spelling: A, P, P, A, R, E, N, T
entries.en: It soon became apparent that the proposal needed major revisions.
entries.zh: 很快就很明显，该提案需要大幅修改。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，上诉，吸引力，呼吁
entries.spelling: A, P, P, E, A, L
entries.en: The redesigned packaging has greater appeal to younger buyers.
entries.zh: 重新设计的包装对年轻买家更有吸引力。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，适用的，可应用的
entries.spelling: A, P, P, L, I, C, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Please complete all sections of the form where applicable.
entries.zh: 请填写表格中所有适用的部分。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，申请，应用，适用
entries.spelling: A, P, P, L, Y
entries.en: Candidates must apply for the internship online by Friday.
entries.zh: 申请者须在周五前在线申请该实习职位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，预约，约会，任命
entries.spelling: A, P, P, O, I, N, T, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Please call the receptionist to schedule an appointment with the consultant.
entries.zh: 请致电前台预约与顾问会面。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，大约的，近似的，接近
entries.spelling: A, P, P, R, O, X, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: The approximate cost of renovating the lobby is $50,000.
entries.zh: 翻新大堂的大约费用为五万美元。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，任意的，武断的，专断的
entries.spelling: A, R, B, I, T, R, A, R, Y
entries.en: Staff complained that the new dress code seemed arbitrary and unclear.
entries.zh: 员工抱怨新的着装规定显得武断且不清晰。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，档案，归档，存档
entries.spelling: A, R, C, H, I, V, E
entries.en: Please archive last year's invoices after the audit is complete.
entries.zh: 审计完成后请将去年的发票归档。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，争论，主张，论证
entries.spelling: A, R, G, U, E
entries.en: Several board members argued against cutting the training budget.
entries.zh: 几位董事主张反对削减培训预算。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，出现，产生，起身
entries.spelling: A, R, I, S, E
entries.en: Please contact HR if any concerns arise during the probation period.
entries.zh: 试用期内如有任何疑虑，请联系人力资源部。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，文章，条款，物品
entries.spelling: A, R, T, I, C, L, E
entries.en: Please review Article 5 of the contract before signing.
entries.zh: 签署前请审阅合同第五条。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，方面，层面，外观
entries.spelling: A, S, P, E, C, T
entries.en: We need to consider every aspect of the merger before proceeding.
entries.zh: 在推进之前，我们需要考虑并购的各个方面。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，断言，主张，维护（权利）
entries.spelling: A, S, S, E, R, T
entries.en: The supplier asserted that the goods met all quality standards.
entries.zh: 供应商断言货物符合所有质量标准。

entries.meaning: 资产；有价值的人/物；优点
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资产，有价值的人/物，优点
entries.spelling: A, S, S, E, T
entries.en: Experienced staff are the company's most valuable asset.
entries.zh: 有经验的员工是公司最宝贵的资产。

entries.meaning: 各式各样；分类；组合套装
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，各式各样，分类，组合套装
entries.spelling: A, S, S, O, R, T, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The gift shop sells an assortment of souvenirs and office supplies.
entries.zh: 礼品店出售各种纪念品和办公用品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，尝试，企图，努力
entries.spelling: A, T, T, E, M, P, T
entries.en: The team will attempt to finish the prototype before the deadline.
entries.zh: 团队将尝试在截止日期前完成原型。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，态度，看法，姿势
entries.spelling: A, T, T, I, T, U, D, E
entries.en: A positive attitude toward feedback helps employees grow faster.
entries.zh: 对反馈持积极态度有助于员工更快成长。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，吸引，引起（注意、兴趣）
entries.spelling: A, T, T, R, A, C, T
entries.en: The new campaign is designed to attract younger customers.
entries.zh: 新营销活动旨在吸引更年轻的客户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，观众，听众，受众
entries.spelling: A, U, D, I, E, N, C, E
entries.en: The presentation was tailored to a business audience.
entries.zh: 该演示是针对商务受众定制的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，真实的，正宗的，可靠的
entries.spelling: A, U, T, H, E, N, T, I, C
entries.en: Customers prefer authentic leather goods over synthetic alternatives.
entries.zh: 顾客更偏好正宗皮革制品，而非合成替代品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，自动化，自动操作
entries.spelling: A, U, T, O, M, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The warehouse introduced automation to speed up order fulfillment.
entries.zh: 仓库引入自动化以加快订单履约速度。

entries.meaning: 自主的；自治的；独立运作的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，自主的，自治的，独立运作的
entries.spelling: A, U, T, O, N, O, M, O, U, S
entries.en: Each regional office remains largely autonomous in hiring decisions.
entries.zh: 各区域办事处在招聘决策上大体保持自主。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，可用性，有空，供应情况
entries.spelling: A, V, A, I, L, A, B, I, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: Please confirm room availability before booking the conference venue.
entries.zh: 预订会议场地前请先确认房间是否有空。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，避免，防止，转移（目光等）
entries.spelling: A, V, E, R, T
entries.en: Quick negotiations helped avert a costly supply disruption.
entries.zh: 迅速谈判帮助避免了代价高昂的供应中断。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，等候，期待，即将发生
entries.spelling: A, W, A, I, T
entries.en: We await your confirmation before shipping the order.
entries.zh: 在发货前，我们等候您的确认。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，支持，资助，后盾
entries.spelling: B, A, C, K, I, N, G
entries.en: The startup secured backing from two venture capital firms.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司获得了两家风投公司的资金支持。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，行李，（比喻）包袱
entries.spelling: B, A, G, G, A, G, E
entries.en: Please collect your baggage at carousel number three.
entries.zh: 请到三号行李转盘提取行李。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，宴会，盛宴
entries.spelling: B, A, N, Q, U, E, T
entries.en: The annual awards banquet will be held at the Grand Hotel.
entries.zh: 年度颁奖宴会将在大酒店举行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，条形码
entries.spelling: B, A, R, C, O, D, E
entries.en: Each package is labeled with a unique barcode for tracking.
entries.zh: 每个包裹都贴有唯一条形码以便追踪。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，基线，基准，起点水平
entries.spelling: B, A, S, E, L, I, N, E
entries.en: We will use last year's sales as a baseline for the forecast.
entries.zh: 我们将以去年销售额作为预测的基线。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，一批，一批次（生产/处理）
entries.spelling: B, A, T, C, H
entries.en: The factory will ship the next batch of parts on Friday.
entries.zh: 工厂将于周五发出下一批零件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 副词，事先，提前
entries.spelling: B, E, F, O, R, E, H, A, N, D
entries.en: Please submit the expense forms beforehand so payroll can process them.
entries.zh: 请事先提交报销单，以便薪资部门处理。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，饮料（尤指非水类）
entries.spelling: B, E, V, E, R, A, G, E
entries.en: Complimentary beverages will be served during the networking break.
entries.zh: 交流茶歇期间将提供免费饮料。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，偏见，偏向，使有偏见
entries.spelling: B, I, A, S
entries.en: The hiring panel received training to reduce unconscious bias.
entries.zh: 招聘委员会接受了减少无意识偏见的培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，双边的，双方的
entries.spelling: B, I, L, A, T, E, R, A, L
entries.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement last month.
entries.zh: 两国上个月签署了双边贸易协定。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，蓝图，详细计划，设计图
entries.spelling: B, L, U, E, P, R, I, N, T
entries.en: Management presented a blueprint for expanding into Asian markets.
entries.zh: 管理层提出了进军亚洲市场的蓝图。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，簿记，记账
entries.spelling: B, O, O, K, K, E, E, P, I, N, G
entries.en: Accurate bookkeeping is essential for the annual tax audit.
entries.zh: 准确的簿记对年度税务审计至关重要。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，展位，摊位，隔间
entries.spelling: B, O, O, T, H
entries.en: Our company reserved a booth at the international trade fair.
entries.zh: 本公司在国际贸展上预订了一个展位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，瓶颈，卡点，制约因素
entries.spelling: B, O, T, T, L, E, N, E, C, K
entries.en: Customs clearance has become a bottleneck for overseas shipments.
entries.zh: 清关已成为海外发货的瓶颈。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，弹回，（支票）遭拒付，反弹
entries.spelling: B, O, U, N, C, E
entries.en: The payment failed because the customer's check bounced.
entries.zh: 由于客户支票遭拒付，这笔付款失败了。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，分支，分行，分公司
entries.spelling: B, R, A, N, C, H
entries.en: The bank plans to open a new branch near the business district.
entries.zh: 该银行计划在商业区附近开设一家新分行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，违反，破坏，缺口
entries.spelling: B, R, E, A, C, H
entries.en: Late delivery may constitute a breach of contract.
entries.zh: 延迟交货可能构成违约。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，故障，明细，崩溃
entries.spelling: B, R, E, A, K, D, O, W, N
entries.en: Please send a cost breakdown for each phase of the project.
entries.zh: 请发送项目各阶段的费用明细。

entries.meaning: 经纪人；中间人；促成（交易）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，经纪人，中间人，促成（交易）
entries.spelling: B, R, O, K, E, R
entries.en: An insurance broker helped us compare coverage options.
entries.zh: 一位保险经纪人帮我们比较了保障方案。

entries.meaning: 预算的；财政预算方面的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，预算的，财政预算方面的
entries.spelling: B, U, D, G, E, T, A, R, Y
entries.en: Hiring was delayed due to strict budgetary constraints.
entries.zh: 由于严格的预算限制，招聘被推迟了。

entries.meaning: 官僚作风；官僚机构；繁文缛节
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，官僚作风，官僚机构，繁文缛节
entries.spelling: B, U, R, E, A, U, C, R, A, C, Y
entries.en: Excessive bureaucracy slowed down the permit application.
entries.zh: 过度的官僚作风拖慢了许可证申请。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，买方，采购员，买家
entries.spelling: B, U, Y, E, R
entries.en: Our sales team will meet with key buyers at the trade show.
entries.zh: 我们的销售团队将在展会上会见主要采购商。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，绕过，避开，旁路
entries.spelling: B, Y, P, A, S, S
entries.en: Do not bypass the approval procedure for large purchases.
entries.zh: 大额采购请勿绕过审批程序。

entries.meaning: 活页夹；装订物；（保险）暂保单
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，活页夹，装订物，（保险）暂保单
entries.spelling: B, I, N, D, E, R
entries.en: Please file the signed contracts in the blue binder.
entries.zh: 请将已签署的合同放入蓝色活页夹。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，自助食堂，员工餐厅
entries.spelling: C, A, F, E, T, E, R, I, A
entries.en: The new headquarters includes a spacious staff cafeteria on the second floor.
entries.zh: 新总部二楼设有宽敞的员工食堂。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，日历，日程表，活动安排
entries.spelling: C, A, L, E, N, D, A, R
entries.en: Please check your calendar before we schedule the next board meeting.
entries.zh: 安排下次董事会会议前，请先查看你的日程。

entries.meaning: 有能力的；能干的；能胜任的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，有能力的，能干的，能胜任的
entries.spelling: C, A, P, A, B, L, E
entries.en: She is capable of managing multiple client accounts at once.
entries.zh: 她能够同时管理多个客户账户。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，职业，生涯，事业
entries.spelling: C, A, R, E, E, R
entries.en: The mentoring program helps junior staff plan a clear career path.
entries.zh: 导师计划帮助初级员工规划清晰的职业路径。

entries.meaning: 承运人；运输公司；航空公司；载体
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，承运人，运输公司，航空公司
entries.spelling: C, A, R, R, I, E, R
entries.en: We switched to a more reliable shipping carrier to reduce delays.
entries.zh: 我们改用更可靠的货运承运商以减少延误。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，纸箱，纸板盒
entries.spelling: C, A, R, T, O, N
entries.en: Each carton must be labeled with the destination warehouse code.
entries.zh: 每个纸箱都必须标注目的仓库代码。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，现金，现款
entries.spelling: C, A, S, H
entries.en: Positive cash flow is essential for covering short-term operating costs.
entries.zh: 正现金流对覆盖短期运营成本至关重要。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，类别，分类，范畴
entries.spelling: C, A, T, E, G, O, R, Y
entries.en: This item belongs in the electronics product category.
entries.zh: 该商品属于电子产品类别。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，天花板，上限，最高限度
entries.spelling: C, E, I, L, I, N, G
entries.en: Regulators imposed a price ceiling on essential medicines.
entries.zh: 监管机构对基本药品设定了价格上限。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，庆祝，庆贺，颂扬
entries.spelling: C, E, L, E, B, R, A, T, E
entries.en: The team gathered to celebrate a record quarter in sales.
entries.zh: 团队聚在一起庆祝创纪录的销售季度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，典礼，仪式，礼节
entries.spelling: C, E, R, E, M, O, N, Y
entries.en: The CEO will speak at the opening ceremony of the new plant.
entries.zh: 首席执行官将在新工厂开幕式上致辞。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，链条，连锁店，一连串
entries.spelling: C, H, A, I, N
entries.en: A disruption in the supply chain delayed several product launches.
entries.zh: 供应链中断推迟了多个产品发布。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，渠道，通道，频道
entries.spelling: C, H, A, N, N, E, L
entries.en: Online sales have become our strongest distribution channel.
entries.zh: 线上销售已成为我们最强的分销渠道。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，章节，分会，阶段
entries.spelling: C, H, A, P, T, E, R
entries.en: The merger marked a new chapter in the company's history.
entries.zh: 此次合并标志着公司历史上的新篇章。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，图表，海图，绘制
entries.spelling: C, H, A, R, T
entries.en: The presentation included a bar chart comparing quarterly revenue.
entries.zh: 演示文稿中包含一张比较季度营收的柱状图。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，核对清单，检查表
entries.spelling: C, H, E, C, K, L, I, S, T
entries.en: Use this checklist to confirm every document is ready for the audit.
entries.zh: 请用这份清单确认审计所需文件均已备齐。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，结账，退房，检出
entries.spelling: C, H, E, C, K, O, U, T
entries.en: Guests must complete hotel checkout by noon to avoid an extra charge.
entries.zh: 住客须在中午前完成退房，以免产生额外费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，情况，环境，境况（常复数）
entries.spelling: C, I, R, C, U, M, S, T, A, N, C, E
entries.en: The contract may be revised under exceptional circumstances.
entries.zh: 在特殊情况下，合同可以修订。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，引用，列举，传唤
entries.spelling: C, I, T, E
entries.en: The analyst cited rising demand as the main reason for the forecast upgrade.
entries.zh: 分析师将需求上升列为上调预测的主要理由。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分类，归类，级别
entries.spelling: C, L, A, S, S, I, F, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: HR updated the job classification system to reflect new roles.
entries.zh: 人力资源部门更新了职位分类体系以反映新岗位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，职员，文书，店员
entries.spelling: C, L, E, R, K
entries.en: The office clerk filed the invoices in chronological order.
entries.zh: 办公室文员按时间顺序归档了发票。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，气候，氛围，环境
entries.spelling: C, L, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: Investors are watching the business climate before expanding overseas.
entries.zh: 投资者在海外扩张前正关注当地商业环境。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，关闭，停业，结束
entries.spelling: C, L, O, S, U, R, E
entries.en: The company announced the temporary closure of two underperforming stores.
entries.zh: 公司宣布暂时关闭两家业绩不佳的门店。

entries.meaning: 教练；辅导；长途客车；指导
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，教练，辅导，长途客车
entries.spelling: C, O, A, C, H
entries.en: Managers are trained to coach employees through performance reviews.
entries.zh: 管理人员接受培训，以便在绩效面谈中辅导员工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，代码，法规，准则
entries.spelling: C, O, D, E
entries.en: All visitors must follow the building's security code of conduct.
entries.zh: 所有访客必须遵守大楼的安保行为准则。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，同事，同僚
entries.spelling: C, O, L, L, E, A, G, U, E
entries.en: Please copy your colleagues on the email so everyone stays informed.
entries.zh: 请把同事抄送到邮件中，以便大家及时知情。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，收集，收取，领取
entries.spelling: C, O, L, L, E, C, T
entries.en: The accounting team will collect payment within thirty days of invoicing.
entries.zh: 会计团队将在开票后三十天内收款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，强迫，迫使，使不得不
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, E, L
entries.en: Safety regulations compel all workers to wear protective equipment.
entries.zh: 安全法规迫使所有工人佩戴防护装备。

entries.meaning: 胜任的；有能力的；合格的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，胜任的，有能力的，合格的
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, E, T, E, N, T
entries.en: We need competent staff who can handle complex client inquiries.
entries.zh: 我们需要能处理复杂客户问询的胜任员工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，汇编，编纂，编译
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, I, L, E
entries.en: Please compile a list of vendors who met the quality standards.
entries.zh: 请编制一份符合质量标准的供应商清单。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，组成部分，元件，成分
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, O, N, E, N, T
entries.en: Training is a key component of our onboarding program.
entries.zh: 培训是我们入职计划的关键组成部分。

entries.meaning: 具体的；实在的；混凝土的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，具体的，实在的，混凝土的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, R, E, T, E
entries.en: Please submit a concrete proposal with timelines and costs.
entries.zh: 请提交一份附有时间表和成本的具体提案。

entries.meaning: 同时发生的；并发的；并存的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，同时发生的，并发的，并存的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, C, U, R, R, E, N, T
entries.en: The two workshops will run concurrently in adjacent rooms.
entries.zh: 两场工作坊将在相邻会议室同时进行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，条件，状况，条款
entries.spelling: C, O, N, D, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Shipment will proceed under the condition that payment clears first.
entries.zh: 在款项先结清的条件下，货物才会发运。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，冲突，矛盾，争执
entries.spelling: C, O, N, F, L, I, C, T
entries.en: Please check for a schedule conflict before booking the conference room.
entries.zh: 预订会议室前请先确认有无日程冲突。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，结果，后果，重要性
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, E, Q, U, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Missing the deadline may have serious consequences for the contract.
entries.zh: 错过截止日期可能给合同带来严重后果。

entries.meaning: 一致的；连贯的；始终如一的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，一致的，连贯的，始终如一的
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, I, S, T, E, N, T
entries.en: Our messaging must remain consistent across all marketing channels.
entries.zh: 我们的文案必须在所有营销渠道上保持一致。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，建造，构建，构思
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, T, R, U, C, T
entries.en: The team will construct a detailed rollout plan before launch.
entries.zh: 团队将在上线前制定详细的推介计划。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，惯例，公约，大型会议
entries.spelling: C, O, N, V, E, N, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Our sales team will attend the annual industry convention in Chicago.
entries.zh: 我们的销售团队将参加在芝加哥举行的年度行业大会。

entries.meaning: 对应的人；对等职位；对应物
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，对应的人，对等职位，对应物
entries.spelling: C, O, U, N, T, E, R, P, A, R, T
entries.en: Please coordinate the schedule with your counterpart in the Tokyo office.
entries.zh: 请与东京办公室的对口同事协调日程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，合规，遵守，顺从
entries.spelling: C, O, M, P, L, I, A, N, C, E
entries.en: All vendors must operate in compliance with local labor laws.
entries.zh: 所有供应商必须遵守当地劳动法。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，限制，约束，制约因素
entries.spelling: C, O, N, S, T, R, A, I, N, T
entries.en: We redesigned the campaign under tight budget constraints.
entries.zh: 我们在严格的预算限制下重新设计了营销活动。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，承包商，承包人，合同工
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, R, A, C, T, O, R
entries.en: The general contractor will submit progress reports every Friday.
entries.zh: 总承包商将于每周五提交进度报告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，争议，争论，论战
entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, R, O, V, E, R, S, Y
entries.en: The advertising slogan sparked controversy among local customers.
entries.zh: 这句广告语在当地客户中引发了争议。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，合作，协作，配合
entries.spelling: C, O, O, P, E, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The launch was completed in cooperation with our regional partners.
entries.zh: 本次发布是在与区域合作伙伴的协作下完成的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，创造力，创意，独创性
entries.spelling: C, R, E, A, T, I, V, I, T, Y
entries.en: The workshop aims to foster creativity among junior designers.
entries.zh: 该工作坊旨在培养初级设计师的创造力。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，债权人，贷方
entries.spelling: C, R, E, D, I, T, O, R
entries.en: The company agreed to pay its major creditors within 30 days.
entries.zh: 公司同意在 30 天内偿还主要债权人。

entries.meaning: 课程；课程体系；教学大纲
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，课程，课程体系，教学大纲
entries.spelling: C, U, R, R, I, C, U, L, U, M
entries.en: HR is revising the training curriculum for new managers.
entries.zh: 人力资源部正在修订新任经理的培训课程。

entries.meaning: 网络安全；信息安全防护
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，网络安全，信息安全防护
entries.spelling: C, Y, B, E, R, S, E, C, U, R, I, T, Y
entries.en: All employees must complete cybersecurity training this quarter.
entries.zh: 所有员工本季度必须完成网络安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，借方，借记，扣款
entries.spelling: D, E, B, I, T
entries.en: The fee will appear as a debit on your corporate account.
entries.zh: 该费用将作为一笔扣款显示在您的公司账户上。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，违约，拖欠，默认值
entries.spelling: D, E, F, A, U, L, T
entries.en: The borrower was declared in default after missing three payments.
entries.zh: 借款人连续三期未付款后被宣布违约。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，延期，推迟，递延
entries.spelling: D, E, F, E, R, R, A, L
entries.en: The client requested a payment deferral until the next quarter.
entries.zh: 客户申请将付款延期至下一季度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，不足，缺陷，亏空
entries.spelling: D, E, F, I, C, I, E, N, C, Y
entries.en: The audit identified a deficiency in inventory controls.
entries.zh: 审计发现库存管控存在缺陷。

entries.meaning: 最终的；决定性的；权威的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，最终的，决定性的，权威的
entries.spelling: D, E, F, I, N, I, T, I, V, E
entries.en: We need a definitive answer from legal before signing the deal.
entries.zh: 签约前我们需要法务给出明确答复。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，代表团，授权，委派
entries.spelling: D, E, L, E, G, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: A trade delegation from Singapore will visit our factory next week.
entries.zh: 新加坡贸易代表团将于下周参观我们的工厂。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，降职，降级
entries.spelling: D, E, M, O, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Repeated policy violations may lead to demotion or dismissal.
entries.zh: 屡次违反政策可能导致降职或解雇。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，部署，调配，投放
entries.spelling: D, E, P, L, O, Y, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The software deployment is scheduled for this weekend.
entries.zh: 软件部署定于本周末进行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，放松管制，解除规制
entries.spelling: D, E, R, E, G, U, L, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Airline deregulation increased competition and lowered ticket prices.
entries.zh: 航空业放松管制加剧了竞争并降低了票价。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，指定，称谓，头衔
entries.spelling: D, E, S, I, G, N, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Please update your job designation on the internal directory.
entries.zh: 请在内部通讯录中更新你的职务名称。

entries.meaning: 威慑因素；抑制物；阻止手段
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，威慑因素，抑制物，阻止手段
entries.spelling: D, E, T, E, R, R, E, N, T
entries.en: Strict penalties serve as a deterrent to workplace fraud.
