entries.zh: 严厉处罚对职场欺诈起到威慑作用。

entries.meaning: 诊断；找出原因；判断问题
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，诊断，找出原因，判断问题
entries.spelling: D, I, A, G, N, O, S, E
entries.en: The IT team will diagnose the network outage before the morning briefing.
entries.zh: IT 团队将在早会前诊断网络中断原因。

entries.meaning: 勤奋的；认真细致的；尽职的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，勤奋的，认真细致的，尽职的
entries.spelling: D, I, L, I, G, E, N, T
entries.en: Her diligent preparation helped the audit finish ahead of schedule.
entries.zh: 她认真细致的准备让审计提前完成。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，指令，指示，官方规定
entries.spelling: D, I, R, E, C, T, I, V, E
entries.en: All branch managers must comply with the new safety directive.
entries.zh: 所有分公司经理必须遵守新的安全指令。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，免责声明，否认声明
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, L, A, I, M, E, R
entries.en: Please read the disclaimer at the bottom of the product brochure.
entries.zh: 请阅读产品手册底部的免责声明。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，披露，公开，透露
entries.spelling: D, I, S, C, L, O, S, U, R, E
entries.en: The contract requires full disclosure of any related-party transactions.
entries.zh: 合同要求充分披露任何关联方交易。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，处理，处置，清理
entries.spelling: D, I, S, P, O, S, A, L
entries.en: The factory updated its waste disposal procedures last quarter.
entries.zh: 工厂上季度更新了废物处理流程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，传播，散布，发布
entries.spelling: D, I, S, S, E, M, I, N, A, T, E
entries.en: HR will disseminate the updated leave policy to all staff tomorrow.
entries.zh: 人力资源部明天将向全体员工发布更新后的休假政策。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，部门，分部，划分
entries.spelling: D, I, V, I, S, I, O, N
entries.en: The marketing division will present its quarterly results on Friday.
entries.zh: 市场部将于周五汇报季度业绩。

entries.meaning: 停机时间；故障时间；停工
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，停机时间，故障时间，停工
entries.spelling: D, O, W, N, T, I, M, E
entries.en: We scheduled overnight downtime to upgrade the payment servers.
entries.zh: 我们安排了夜间停机以升级支付服务器。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，指定用途，拨出，预留
entries.spelling: E, A, R, M, A, R, K
entries.en: The board earmarked $200,000 for employee wellness programs.
entries.zh: 董事会拨出 20 万美元用于员工健康项目。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资格，合格条件，适宜性
entries.spelling: E, L, I, G, I, B, I, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: Please review the eligibility criteria before applying for the scholarship.
entries.zh: 申请奖学金前请先查看资格标准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，开始，着手，登船/登机
entries.spelling: E, M, B, A, R, K
entries.en: The firm will embark on a digital transformation next fiscal year.
entries.zh: 公司将在下一财年启动数字化转型。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，授权，赋能，使能够
entries.spelling: E, M, P, O, W, E, R
entries.en: Managers should empower frontline staff to resolve customer complaints.
entries.zh: 经理应授权一线员工处理客户投诉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，使能够，启用，促成
entries.spelling: E, N, A, B, L, E
entries.en: The new portal will enable clients to track shipments in real time.
entries.zh: 新门户将使客户能够实时追踪货运。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，包含，涵盖，环绕
entries.spelling: E, N, C, O, M, P, A, S, S
entries.en: The training program encompasses compliance, safety, and customer service.
entries.zh: 该培训项目涵盖合规、安全与客户服务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，丰富，充实，使更有价值
entries.spelling: E, N, R, I, C, H
entries.en: Cross-department rotations enrich employees' professional experience.
entries.zh: 跨部门轮岗能丰富员工的专业经验。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，需要，牵涉，导致必须
entries.spelling: E, N, T, A, I, L
entries.en: Expanding overseas will entail significant legal and logistics costs.
entries.zh: 拓展海外业务将涉及显著的法律与物流成本。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，列举，枚举，逐一说明
entries.spelling: E, N, U, M, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Please enumerate the main risks in your project proposal.
entries.zh: 请在项目提案中列举主要风险。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，设想，展望，构想
entries.spelling: E, N, V, I, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Leadership envisions a fully remote customer support team by next year.
entries.zh: 领导层设想明年建成一支全面远程的客服团队。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，公平，股本，权益
entries.spelling: E, Q, U, I, T, Y
entries.en: Investors acquired a 15% equity stake in the logistics startup.
entries.zh: 投资者获得了该物流初创公司 15% 的股权。

entries.meaning: 伦理；道德规范；职业道德
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，伦理，道德规范，职业道德
entries.spelling: E, T, H, I, C, S
entries.en: All new hires must complete business ethics training within 30 days.
entries.zh: 所有新员工须在 30 天内完成商业伦理培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，演变，发展，逐步进化
entries.spelling: E, V, O, L, V, E
entries.en: Our pricing model will evolve as we enter new overseas markets.
entries.zh: 随着进入新的海外市场，我们的定价模式将持续演变。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，擅长，出色，优于
entries.spelling: E, X, C, E, L
entries.en: She excelled at negotiating vendor contracts under tight deadlines.
entries.zh: 她在紧张期限内谈判供应商合同方面表现出色。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，例外，除外，破例
entries.spelling: E, X, C, E, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Refunds are not allowed, with the exception of defective products.
entries.zh: 除残次品外，一律不予退款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，摘录，节选，片段
entries.spelling: E, X, C, E, R, P, T
entries.en: The memo includes an excerpt from last month's customer survey.
entries.zh: 备忘录包含上月客户调查的一段摘录。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，排除，除外，不予纳入
entries.spelling: E, X, C, L, U, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Please note the exclusion clause covering natural disasters.
entries.zh: 请注意涵盖自然灾害的除外条款。

entries.meaning: 模范的；典范的；值得效仿的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，模范的，典范的，值得效仿的
entries.spelling: E, X, E, M, P, L, A, R, Y
entries.en: She received an award for exemplary customer service this quarter.
entries.zh: 她因本季度模范的客户服务而获奖。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，豁免，免税，免除
entries.spelling: E, X, E, M, P, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Nonprofits may qualify for a tax exemption on property purchases.
entries.zh: 非营利组织购买物业或可享受免税。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，期望，预期，指望
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, C, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The client said the delivery exceeded their expectations.
entries.zh: 客户表示交付成果超出了他们的期望。

entries.meaning: 权宜的；便利的；应急实用的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，权宜的，便利的，应急实用的
entries.spelling: E, X, P, E, D, I, E, N, T
entries.en: Hiring temporary staff was an expedient solution during peak season.
entries.zh: 旺季雇用临时工是一个权宜之计。

entries.meaning: 短途旅行；远足；（团体）参观游览
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，短途旅行，远足，（团体）参观游览
entries.spelling: E, X, C, U, R, S, I, O, N
entries.en: Conference attendees may sign up for an optional excursion to the harbor on Friday afternoon.
entries.zh: 与会者可报名参加周五下午前往港口的自选短途游。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，展览，展览会，展示
entries.spelling: E, X, H, I, B, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Our new product line will be on exhibition at the trade fair in Singapore next month.
entries.zh: 我们的新产品线下个月将在新加坡的贸易展上展出。

entries.meaning: 明确的；清楚的；直截了当的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，明确的，清楚的，直截了当的
entries.spelling: E, X, P, L, I, C, I, T
entries.en: The contract makes explicit that all changes must be approved in writing.
entries.zh: 合同明确规定，所有变更必须经书面批准。

entries.meaning: 广泛的；大量的；大规模的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，广泛的，大量的，大规模的
entries.spelling: E, X, T, E, N, S, I, V, E
entries.en: Candidates with extensive experience in supply chain management are encouraged to apply.
entries.zh: 欢迎具有丰富供应链管理经验的候选人申请。

entries.meaning: 提取；摘录；获得（信息、资金等）
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，提取，摘录，获得（信息、资金等）
entries.spelling: E, X, T, R, A, C, T
entries.en: The analyst extracted the sales figures from the quarterly report for the presentation.
entries.zh: 分析师从季度报告中提取了销售数据用于演示。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（大学）全体教员，院系，能力
entries.spelling: F, A, C, U, L, T, Y
entries.en: Faculty members will lead the evening workshops at the leadership training program.
entries.zh: 教职人员将在领导力培训项目中主持晚间工作坊。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，系牢，扣紧，固定
entries.spelling: F, A, S, T, E, N
entries.en: Passengers are asked to fasten their seat belts while the sign is illuminated.
entries.zh: 安全带指示灯亮起期间，请乘客系好安全带。

entries.meaning: 特色；功能；（报刊）专题 / 以……为特色；由……主演
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，特色，功能，（报刊）专题/以……为特色
entries.spelling: F, E, A, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The upgraded software features a simplified dashboard and faster reporting tools.
entries.zh: 升级后的软件具有更简洁的仪表板和更快的报表工具。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，最终确定，敲定，完成
entries.spelling: F, I, N, A, L, I, Z, E
entries.en: We need to finalize the event schedule by Thursday so the brochures can be printed.
entries.zh: 我们需要在周四前确定活动日程，以便印制宣传册。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，融资，资金筹措，贷款
entries.spelling: F, I, N, A, N, C, I, N, G
entries.en: The company secured financing from two banks to build its new distribution center.
entries.zh: 公司从两家银行获得融资，用于建造新的配送中心。

entries.meaning: 固定装置（如灯具、卫浴）；固定设施
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，固定装置（如灯具、卫浴），固定设施
entries.spelling: F, I, X, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The landlord agreed to replace the old light fixtures before the new tenants move in.
entries.zh: 房东同意在新租户入住前更换旧灯具。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，车队，船队，机队
entries.spelling: F, L, E, E, T
entries.en: The logistics firm plans to add twenty electric vans to its delivery fleet this year.
entries.zh: 这家物流公司计划今年为配送车队新增二十辆电动货车。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，（语言）流利的，流畅的
entries.spelling: F, L, U, E, N, T
entries.en: Applicants must be fluent in both English and Spanish to qualify for the position.
entries.zh: 申请者须精通英语和西班牙语方可符合该职位要求。

entries.meaning: （因违规）丧失；被没收 / 罚金；没收物
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，（因违规）丧失，被没收/罚金，没收物
entries.spelling: F, O, R, F, E, I, T
entries.en: Guests who cancel within 48 hours of arrival will forfeit their deposit.
entries.zh: 在入住前 48 小时内取消预订的客人将被没收订金。

entries.meaning: 手续；正式程序；拘泥形式
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，手续，正式程序，拘泥形式
entries.spelling: F, O, R, M, A, L, I, T, Y
entries.en: Please arrive early to complete the check-in formalities before the conference begins.
entries.zh: 请提前到场，在会议开始前办完报到手续。

entries.meaning: 格式；版式；形式 / 使格式化；排版
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，格式，版式，形式/使格式化
entries.spelling: F, O, R, M, A, T
entries.en: Please submit your expense report in PDF format by the end of the month.
entries.zh: 请在月底前以 PDF 格式提交费用报告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，转发，转寄，递送
entries.spelling: F, O, R, W, A, R, D
entries.en: Could you forward the client's message to everyone on the project team?
entries.zh: 你能把客户的消息转发给项目组的每个人吗？

entries.meaning: 特许经营权；连锁加盟店
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，特许经营权，连锁加盟店
entries.spelling: F, R, A, N, C, H, I, S, E
entries.en: The coffee chain is offering new franchise opportunities in three coastal cities.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡连锁店正在三个沿海城市提供新的加盟机会。

entries.meaning: 自由职业的；兼职接活的 / 做自由职业
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，自由职业的，兼职接活的/做自由职业
entries.spelling: F, R, E, E, L, A, N, C, E
entries.en: We hired a freelance graphic designer to create the logo for the product launch.
entries.zh: 我们聘请了一位自由平面设计师为产品发布设计标志。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，频繁的，经常的
entries.spelling: F, R, E, Q, U, E, N, T
entries.en: Members of our frequent flyer program receive free seat upgrades on long-haul flights.
entries.zh: 我们常旅客计划的会员可在长途航班上免费升舱。

entries.meaning: 边缘；外围 / 附加的；次要的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，边缘，外围/附加的，次要的
entries.spelling: F, R, I, N, G, E
entries.en: In addition to a competitive salary, the job offers generous fringe benefits.
entries.zh: 除了有竞争力的薪资，这份工作还提供丰厚的附加福利。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，募捐活动，筹款人
entries.spelling: F, U, N, D, R, A, I, S, E, R
entries.en: The hospital will hold a fundraiser dinner to support its new children's wing.
entries.zh: 医院将举办募捐晚宴，为新建的儿科病区筹款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，布置家具，提供，供应
entries.spelling: F, U, R, N, I, S, H
entries.en: Relocating employees will be provided with a fully furnished apartment for the first month.
entries.zh: 调任员工第一个月将获得一套家具齐全的公寓。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（一件）衣服，服装
entries.spelling: G, A, R, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The garment factory increased production to meet the holiday demand.
entries.zh: 服装厂为满足节日需求提高了产量。

entries.meaning: 小故障；小问题（尤指技术性的）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，小故障，小问题（尤指技术性的）
entries.spelling: G, L, I, T, C, H
entries.en: A technical glitch delayed the start of the online seminar by fifteen minutes.
entries.zh: 一个技术故障使线上研讨会推迟了十五分钟开始。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，善意，友好，（企业的）商誉
entries.spelling: G, O, O, D, W, I, L, L
entries.en: As a gesture of goodwill, the hotel offered the guest a free night's stay.
entries.zh: 作为善意的表示，酒店为该客人提供一晚免费住宿。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，员工人数，人数统计
entries.spelling: H, E, A, D, C, O, U, N, T
entries.en: The department plans to increase its headcount by ten percent next year.
entries.zh: 该部门计划明年将人员编制增加百分之十。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，忙乱的，繁忙的
entries.spelling: H, E, C, T, I, C
entries.en: Despite her hectic schedule, the director made time to meet each new employee.
entries.zh: 尽管日程繁忙，主管仍抽时间与每位新员工见面。

entries.meaning: 等级制度；层级；（组织的）上层
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，等级制度，层级，（组织的）上层
entries.spelling: H, I, E, R, A, R, C, H, Y
entries.en: The startup has a flat structure with very little hierarchy among its staff.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司采用扁平结构，员工之间几乎没有层级之分。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（给演讲者等的）酬金，谢礼
entries.spelling: H, O, N, O, R, A, R, I, U, M
entries.en: Each guest speaker will receive an honorarium and travel expenses.
entries.zh: 每位嘉宾演讲者将获得酬金及差旅费。

entries.meaning: 闲置的；空闲的；（机器）未运转的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，闲置的，空闲的，（机器）未运转的
entries.spelling: I, D, L, E
entries.en: The assembly line sat idle for two days while technicians replaced the faulty motor.
entries.zh: 技术人员更换故障电机期间，装配线停工闲置了两天。

entries.meaning: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，即将发生的，迫在眉睫的
entries.spelling: I, M, M, I, N, E, N, T
entries.en: Analysts believe an announcement about the merger is imminent.
entries.zh: 分析师认为有关合并的公告即将发布。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，公正的，不偏不倚的
entries.spelling: I, M, P, A, R, T, I, A, L
entries.en: An impartial panel will evaluate all design proposals submitted for the contest.
entries.zh: 一个公正的评审小组将评估所有参赛的设计方案。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（可能的）影响、后果，含意
entries.spelling: I, M, P, L, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The board discussed the financial implications of opening a second factory.
entries.zh: 董事会讨论了开设第二家工厂的财务影响。

entries.meaning: 附带的；次要的；（费用）杂项的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，附带的，次要的，（费用）杂项的
entries.spelling: I, N, C, I, D, E, N, T, A, L
entries.en: Hotel guests must leave a credit card deposit to cover incidental charges.
entries.zh: 酒店住客须以信用卡押金支付杂项费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，（天气）恶劣的，严酷的
entries.spelling: I, N, C, L, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: In case of inclement weather, the company picnic will be moved indoors.
entries.zh: 如遇恶劣天气，公司野餐将改在室内举行。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，赔偿（金），保障，免责
entries.spelling: I, N, D, E, M, N, I, T, Y
entries.en: The contract includes an indemnity clause protecting the client against third-party claims.
entries.zh: 合同中含有一项赔偿条款，保护客户免受第三方索赔。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，指标，指示物，迹象
entries.spelling: I, N, D, I, C, A, T, O, R
entries.en: Customer retention is a key indicator of how well our support team is performing.
entries.zh: 客户留存率是衡量支持团队表现的关键指标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，大量涌入，流入
entries.spelling: I, N, F, L, U, X
entries.en: Local hotels are preparing for an influx of visitors during the trade fair.
entries.zh: 本地酒店正在为展会期间的游客涌入做准备。

entries.meaning: 提供有用信息的；增长见识的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，提供有用信息的，增长见识的
entries.spelling: I, N, F, O, R, M, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: Participants found the workshop on tax regulations highly informative.
entries.zh: 学员们认为税务法规研讨会内容非常充实。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，抑制，阻碍，限制
entries.spelling: I, N, H, I, B, I, T
entries.en: High shipping costs may inhibit the growth of our overseas sales.
entries.zh: 高昂的运费可能会抑制我们海外销售的增长。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（新）计划、举措，主动性
entries.spelling: I, N, I, T, I, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The company launched a new initiative to reduce paper use in all branch offices.
entries.zh: 公司推出一项新举措，减少所有分公司的纸张使用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，创新的，革新的
entries.spelling: I, N, N, O, V, A, T, I, V, E
entries.en: The firm won an award for its innovative approach to energy-efficient packaging.
entries.zh: 该公司因其节能包装的创新方法而获奖。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，洞察（力），深刻见解
entries.spelling: I, N, S, I, G, H, T
entries.en: The survey gave us valuable insight into what customers expect from our app.
entries.zh: 这项调查让我们深入了解了顾客对我们应用程序的期望。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，检查，视察，检验
entries.spelling: I, N, S, P, E, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The warehouse will close early on Friday for its annual safety inspection.
entries.zh: 仓库周五将提前关闭，进行年度安全检查。

entries.meaning: 起重要作用的；有帮助的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，起重要作用的，有帮助的
entries.spelling: I, N, S, T, R, U, M, E, N, T, A, L
entries.en: Ms. Patel was instrumental in securing the contract with our largest client.
entries.zh: 帕特尔女士在拿下与最大客户的合同中发挥了关键作用。

entries.meaning: 摄入量；（人员）招收数量；吸入
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，摄入量，（人员）招收数量，吸入
entries.spelling: I, N, T, A, K, E
entries.en: This year's graduate intake is the largest in the company's history.
entries.zh: 今年招收的毕业生人数是公司历史上最多的。

entries.meaning: 不可或缺的；构成整体所必需的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，不可或缺的，构成整体所必需的
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, G, R, A, L
entries.en: Clear communication is an integral part of every successful project.
entries.zh: 清晰的沟通是每个成功项目不可或缺的部分。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，密集的，强化的，集中的
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, N, S, I, V, E
entries.en: New sales staff complete a two-week intensive training program before meeting clients.
entries.zh: 新销售人员在接触客户前需完成为期两周的强化培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，中级的，中间的
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, R, M, E, D, I, A, T, E
entries.en: The Spanish class is designed for employees with an intermediate level of proficiency.
entries.zh: 这门西班牙语课程是为具备中级水平的员工设计的。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，口译员，解释者
entries.spelling: I, N, T, E, R, P, R, E, T, E, R
entries.en: An interpreter will be available for delegates who do not speak English.
entries.zh: 会为不会说英语的代表们提供口译员。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，逐项列出，分项记载
entries.spelling: I, T, E, M, I, Z, E
entries.en: Please attach an itemized receipt to each expense report you submit.
entries.zh: 请在每份报销单上附上明细收据。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，期刊，日志，日记
entries.spelling: J, O, U, R, N, A, L
entries.en: Dr. Lin's findings were published in a leading medical journal last month.
entries.zh: 林博士的研究结果上个月发表在一份权威医学期刊上。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，判断（力），看法，判决
entries.spelling: J, U, D, G, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Shift supervisors are expected to use their judgment when handling customer complaints.
entries.zh: 值班主管在处理客户投诉时需自行做出判断。

entries.meaning: 管辖权；司法权；管辖范围
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，管辖权，司法权，管辖范围
entries.spelling: J, U, R, I, S, D, I, C, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Building permits in this area fall under the jurisdiction of the city planning office.
entries.zh: 该地区的建筑许可归市规划办公室管辖。

entries.meaning: （自助）服务终端机；售货亭；报刊亭
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（自助）服务终端机，售货亭，报刊亭
entries.spelling: K, I, O, S, K
entries.en: Passengers can print their boarding passes at any of the check-in kiosks.
entries.zh: 乘客可以在任意一台自助值机机上打印登机牌。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，合法的，正当的，合理的
entries.spelling: L, E, G, I, T, I, M, A, T, E
entries.en: Employees who raise legitimate concerns about safety will not face any penalty.
entries.zh: 提出合理安全担忧的员工不会受到任何处罚。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，（v.）充分利用，（n.）影响力，杠杆作用
entries.spelling: L, E, V, E, R, A, G, E
entries.en: We plan to leverage our existing client network to promote the new service.
entries.zh: 我们计划利用现有客户网络推广这项新服务。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，联络人，联络，协作
entries.spelling: L, I, A, I, S, O, N
entries.en: Mr. Ortiz will act as a liaison between the design team and the client.
entries.zh: 奥尔蒂斯先生将担任设计团队与客户之间的联络人。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，诉讼，打官司
entries.spelling: L, I, T, I, G, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Both companies agreed to settle the dispute privately to avoid costly litigation.
entries.zh: 两家公司同意私下解决纠纷，以避免代价高昂的诉讼。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，落后，滞后，时间差
entries.spelling: L, A, G
entries.en: Our online sales continue to lag behind those of our main competitor.
entries.zh: 我们的线上销售额仍落后于主要竞争对手。

entries.meaning: 地标；里程碑；具有里程碑意义的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，地标，里程碑，具有里程碑意义的
entries.spelling: L, A, N, D, M, A, R, K
entries.en: The hotel is within walking distance of several famous landmarks.
entries.zh: 这家酒店步行即可到达几处著名地标。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，（字迹）清晰可辨的，易读的
entries.spelling: L, E, G, I, B, L, E
entries.en: Please make sure your signature on the form is legible.
entries.zh: 请确保您在表格上的签名清晰可辨。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，贷款人，放贷机构
entries.spelling: L, E, N, D, E, R
entries.en: The company is negotiating new loan terms with its lender.
entries.zh: 公司正与贷款机构协商新的贷款条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，可能性
entries.spelling: L, I, K, E, L, I, H, O, O, D
entries.en: Booking early reduces the likelihood of paying higher fares.
entries.zh: 提早预订可以降低支付更高票价的可能性。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，限制，局限
entries.spelling: L, I, M, I, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Due to space limitations, only registered guests may attend the seminar.
entries.zh: 由于场地有限，只有已登记的来宾才能参加研讨会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，（资产）流动性，变现能力
entries.spelling: L, I, Q, U, I, D, I, T, Y
entries.en: The firm sold some assets to improve its liquidity.
entries.zh: 公司出售部分资产以改善资金流动性。

entries.meaning: 清单中的条目；（房产/招聘）登载信息；上市
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，清单中的条目，（房产/招聘）登载信息
entries.spelling: L, I, S, T, I, N, G
entries.en: Check the company website for current job listings.
entries.zh: 请查看公司官网了解当前的招聘信息。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，授权，命令，强制要求
entries.spelling: M, A, N, D, A, T, E
entries.en: New regulations mandate that all employees complete safety training annually.
entries.zh: 新规定要求所有员工每年完成安全培训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，手稿，原稿
entries.spelling: M, A, N, U, S, C, R, I, P, T
entries.en: Authors must submit their manuscripts by the end of the month.
entries.zh: 作者须在月底前提交稿件。

entries.meaning: 市场；商业竞争领域；交易平台
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，市场，商业竞争领域，交易平台
entries.spelling: M, A, R, K, E, T, P, L, A, C, E
entries.en: To stay competitive in today's marketplace, we must innovate constantly.
entries.zh: 要在当今市场保持竞争力，我们必须不断创新。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，调解，斡旋
entries.spelling: M, E, D, I, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Both parties agreed to settle the dispute through mediation.
entries.zh: 双方同意通过调解解决纠纷。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，放错地方，一时找不到
entries.spelling: M, I, S, P, L, A, C, E
entries.en: I seem to have misplaced my security badge; could you let me in?
entries.zh: 我好像把门禁卡放错地方了，你能帮我开下门吗？

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，减轻，缓和（风险、影响）
entries.spelling: M, I, T, I, G, A, T, E
entries.en: The new backup system will help mitigate the risk of data loss.
entries.zh: 新的备份系统将有助于降低数据丢失的风险。

entries.meaning: 适度的；中等的；主持（讨论）
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或动词，适度的，中等的，主持（讨论）
entries.spelling: M, O, D, E, R, A, T, E
entries.en: Dr. Chen will moderate the panel discussion on supply chain trends.
entries.zh: 陈博士将主持关于供应链趋势的小组讨论。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，势头，动力
entries.spelling: M, O, M, E, N, T, U, M
entries.en: The campaign gained momentum after it was featured on social media.
entries.zh: 该推广活动在社交媒体上被推荐后势头大增。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，货币的，金钱的
entries.spelling: M, O, N, E, T, A, R, Y
entries.en: Employees who submit useful suggestions receive a small monetary reward.
entries.zh: 提出有用建议的员工可获得一小笔奖金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，市政的，市立的
entries.spelling: M, U, N, I, C, I, P, A, L
entries.en: The renovation requires approval from the municipal building department.
entries.zh: 此次翻修须获得市政建筑部门的批准。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，相互的，共同的
entries.spelling: M, U, T, U, A, L
entries.en: The contract can be extended by mutual agreement of both parties.
entries.zh: 经双方同意，合同可以延期。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，疏忽，过失
entries.spelling: N, E, G, L, I, G, E, N, C, E
entries.en: The supplier was held responsible for the damage caused by its negligence.
entries.zh: 供应商须为其疏忽造成的损失承担责任。

entries.meaning: 细分市场；适合的位置；小众的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，细分市场，适合的位置，小众的
entries.spelling: N, I, C, H, E
entries.en: The startup has found a profitable niche in eco-friendly packaging.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司在环保包装领域找到了盈利的细分市场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，（费用）象征性的，名义上的
entries.spelling: N, O, M, I, N, A, L
entries.en: Members can rent the meeting room for a nominal fee.
entries.zh: 会员只需支付少量费用即可租用会议室。

entries.meaning: 新员工入职培训；入职流程
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，新员工入职培训，入职流程
entries.spelling: O, N, B, O, A, R, D, I, N, G
entries.en: All new hires will attend a two-day onboarding session next week.
entries.zh: 所有新员工下周将参加为期两天的入职培训。

entries.meaning: 运营的；可使用的；投入运行的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，运营的，可使用的，投入运行的
entries.spelling: O, P, E, R, A, T, I, O, N, A, L
entries.en: The new warehouse is expected to be fully operational by March.
entries.zh: 新仓库预计将于 3 月全面投入运营。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，优化，使最优化
entries.spelling: O, P, T, I, M, I, Z, E
entries.en: We redesigned the checkout page to optimize it for mobile users.
entries.zh: 我们重新设计了结账页面，以优化移动端用户体验。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，停电，（服务）中断
entries.spelling: O, U, T, A, G, E
entries.en: A brief power outage interrupted production this morning.
entries.zh: 今天上午的短暂停电打断了生产。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，开始，开端
entries.spelling: O, U, T, S, E, T
entries.en: It was clear from the outset that the project would need more staff.
entries.zh: 从一开始就很明显，该项目需要更多人手。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，全面检修，彻底改革
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, H, A, U, L
entries.en: Management plans to overhaul the company's travel reimbursement policy.
entries.zh: 管理层计划全面修订公司的差旅报销制度。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，疏忽，监督
entries.spelling: O, V, E, R, S, I, G, H, T
entries.en: Due to an oversight, your invoice was sent to the wrong address.
entries.zh: 由于疏忽，您的发票被寄到了错误的地址。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，文书工作，书面材料
entries.spelling: P, A, P, E, R, W, O, R, K
entries.en: Please complete the paperwork before your first day of work.
entries.zh: 请在入职第一天之前填好相关文件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，复印件，复印
entries.spelling: P, H, O, T, O, C, O, P, Y
entries.en: Please bring a photocopy of your passport to the registration desk.
entries.zh: 请将护照复印件带到登记台。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词或形容词，飞行员，试点，试行
entries.spelling: P, I, L, O, T
entries.en: The company will pilot a flexible-work policy in two regional offices.
entries.zh: 公司将在两个区域办事处试行弹性工作政策。

entries.meaning: 安置；岗位安排；分班/分位
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，安置，岗位安排，分班/分位
entries.spelling: P, L, A, C, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The career center offers job placement assistance to recent graduates.
entries.zh: 就业中心为应届毕业生提供就业安置协助。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，骤降，暴跌
entries.spelling: P, L, U, M, M, E, T
entries.en: Share prices plummeted after the firm announced weaker quarterly earnings.
entries.zh: 公司公布季度业绩疲软后，股价暴跌。

entries.meaning: 先决条件；必修的；作为前提的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，先决条件，必修的，作为前提的
entries.spelling: P, R, E, R, E, Q, U, I, S, I, T, E
entries.en: Two years of sales experience is a prerequisite for this managerial role.
entries.zh: 两年销售经验是担任该管理职位的先决条件。

entries.meaning: 招股说明书；简介手册；招生简章
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，招股说明书，简介手册，招生简章
entries.spelling: P, R, O, S, P, E, C, T, U, S
entries.en: Investors should carefully review the prospectus before buying the shares.
entries.zh: 投资者在购买股份前应仔细阅读招股说明书。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，协议，规程，外交礼仪
entries.spelling: P, R, O, T, O, C, O, L
entries.en: All visitors must follow the building's security protocol.
entries.zh: 所有访客必须遵守大楼的安保规程。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，接近，邻近
entries.spelling: P, R, O, X, I, M, I, T, Y
entries.en: The hotel's proximity to the convention center is a major advantage.
entries.zh: 酒店紧邻会议中心是其一大优势。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，宣传，知名度，媒体关注
entries.spelling: P, U, B, L, I, C, I, T, Y
entries.en: The product launch received extensive publicity in the business press.
entries.zh: 该产品发布在商业媒体上获得了广泛宣传。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资格，资历，学历条件
entries.spelling: Q, U, A, L, I, F, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Applicants must list their relevant qualifications on the form.
entries.zh: 申请人必须在表格上列出相关资格。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，报价，引文，行情
entries.spelling: Q, U, O, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: We asked three suppliers for a quotation on office furniture.
entries.zh: 我们向三家供应商索取了办公家具报价。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，反弹，集会，重整
entries.spelling: R, A, L, L, Y
entries.en: Tech stocks rallied after the positive earnings announcements.
entries.zh: 科技股在正面财报公布后出现反弹。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，改组，重组
entries.spelling: R, E, O, R, G, A, N, I, Z, E
entries.en: Management plans to reorganize the sales division next quarter.
entries.zh: 管理层计划下季度改组销售部门。

entries.meaning: 竞争对手；与……匹敌；竞争的
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词或形容词，竞争对手，与……匹敌，竞争的
entries.spelling: R, I, V, A, L
entries.en: Our main rival has lowered prices to win market share.
entries.zh: 我们的主要竞争对手已降价以争夺市场份额。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，值班表，花名册，阵容
entries.spelling: R, O, S, T, E, R
entries.en: Please check the duty roster before requesting time off.
entries.zh: 请假前请先查看值班表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，样品，样本，抽样
entries.spelling: S, A, M, P, L, E
entries.en: The sales team distributed free samples at the trade fair.
entries.zh: 销售团队在展会上发放了免费样品。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，计划，方案，体制
entries.spelling: S, C, H, E, M, E
entries.en: The company introduced a bonus scheme to reward top performers.
entries.zh: 公司推出奖金方案以奖励表现优异者。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，范围，余地，视野
entries.spelling: S, C, O, P, E
entries.en: Travel expenses are outside the scope of this reimbursement policy.
entries.zh: 差旅费不在本报销政策的范围内。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，行业，部门，领域
entries.spelling: S, E, C, T, O, R
entries.en: Job growth has been strongest in the technology sector this year.
entries.zh: 今年就业增长在科技行业最为强劲。

entries.meaning: 一场（会议/培训）；会期；时段
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，一场（会议/培训），会期，时段
entries.spelling: S, E, S, S, I, O, N
entries.en: The workshop will include a brief Q&A session at the end.
entries.zh: 研讨会结束时将安排简短的问答环节。

entries.meaning: 班车；穿梭运输；往返运送
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，班车，穿梭运输，往返运送
entries.spelling: S, H, U, T, T, L, E
entries.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the exhibition hall.
entries.zh: 酒店与展馆之间有免费班车往返。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，专家，专科人员
entries.spelling: S, P, E, C, I, A, L, I, S, T
entries.en: We hired a tax specialist to review the new compliance rules.
entries.zh: 我们聘请了一位税务专家来审核新的合规规定。

entries.meaning: 停滞的；不景气的；不流动的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，停滞的，不景气的，不流动的
entries.spelling: S, T, A, G, N, A, N, T
entries.en: Demand remained stagnant despite aggressive discount campaigns.
entries.zh: 尽管大力折扣促销，需求仍停滞不前。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，统计数据，统计学
entries.spelling: S, T, A, T, I, S, T, I, C, S
entries.en: The latest statistics show a rise in online bookings.
entries.zh: 最新统计显示在线预订有所上升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，目标，指标，以……为目标
entries.spelling: T, A, R, G, E, T
entries.en: The team exceeded its quarterly sales target by 12 percent.
entries.zh: 该团队超额完成季度销售目标 12%。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，技术员，技师
entries.spelling: T, E, C, H, N, I, C, I, A, N
entries.en: A technician will arrive tomorrow to repair the photocopier.
entries.zh: 技术员明天将来维修复印机。

entries.meaning: 风险企业；商业冒险；敢于做
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，风险企业，商业冒险，敢于做
entries.spelling: V, E, N, T, U, R, E
entries.en: The two firms formed a joint venture to enter the Asian market.
entries.zh: 两家公司成立合资企业以进入亚洲市场。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，口头的，言语的
entries.spelling: V, E, R, B, A, L
entries.en: We reached a verbal agreement and will sign the contract next week.
entries.zh: 我们达成了口头协议，并将于下周签署合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，工作量，负荷
entries.spelling: W, O, R, K, L, O, A, D
entries.en: Hiring two assistants should ease the team's heavy workload.
entries.zh: 招聘两名助理应能减轻团队的繁重工作量。

entries.meaning: 波动剧烈的；不稳定的；易变的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，波动剧烈的，不稳定的，易变的
entries.spelling: V, O, L, A, T, I, L, E
entries.en: Investors remain cautious because of the volatile currency market.
entries.zh: 由于汇市波动剧烈，投资者仍保持谨慎。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，弃权书，豁免，放弃（权利）
entries.spelling: W, A, I, V, E, R
entries.en: All participants must sign a liability waiver before joining the outdoor training.
entries.zh: 所有参加者在参加户外培训前必须签署责任豁免书。

entries.meaning: 演练；逐步讲解；现场查看
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，演练，逐步讲解，现场查看
entries.spelling: W, A, L, K, T, H, R, O, U, G, H
entries.en: The project manager scheduled a walkthrough of the new office layout.
entries.zh: 项目经理安排了对新办公室布局的现场勘察。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，网络研讨会，线上讲座
entries.spelling: W, E, B, I, N, A, R
entries.en: The marketing team will host a webinar to introduce the new software features.
entries.zh: 市场团队将主办一场网络研讨会，介绍新软件功能。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，身心健康，福祉，安康
entries.spelling: W, E, L, L, B, E, I, N, G
entries.en: The company invested in a wellbeing program to reduce employee burnout.
entries.zh: 公司投入健康关怀计划以减少员工倦怠。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，举报人，吹哨人
entries.spelling: W, H, I, S, T, L, E, B, L, O, W, E, R
entries.en: The firm updated its whistleblower policy to encourage confidential reporting.
entries.zh: 公司更新了举报政策，以鼓励匿名保密举报。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，白板，白板讨论
entries.spelling: W, H, I, T, E, B, O, A, R, D
entries.en: During the brainstorming meeting, ideas were sketched on the whiteboard.
entries.zh: 头脑风暴会上，想法被画在白板上。

entries.meaning: 变通办法；临时解决方案
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，变通办法，临时解决方案
entries.spelling: W, O, R, K, A, R, O, U, N, D
entries.en: Until the bug is fixed, the IT team has provided a temporary workaround.
entries.zh: 在漏洞修复前，IT 团队提供了临时变通办法。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，工作站，工位，专用电脑
entries.spelling: W, O, R, K, S, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Each new hire receives an ergonomic workstation on the first day.
entries.zh: 每位新员工入职第一天都会配到符合人体工学的工位。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，注销，坏账核销，报废
entries.spelling: W, R, I, T, E, hyphen, O, F, F
entries.en: The finance department approved a write-off of the uncollectible invoice.
entries.zh: 财务部门批准核销那笔无法收回的发票。

entries.meaning: 年终的；年末；年度结算期
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，年终的，年末，年度结算期
entries.spelling: Y, E, A, R, hyphen, E, N, D
entries.en: Managers must submit year-end performance reviews by December 15.
entries.zh: 经理须在 12 月 15 日前提交年终绩效评估。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分区规划，用途分区
entries.spelling: Z, O, N, I, N, G
entries.en: The developer applied for a change in zoning to build a retail complex.
entries.zh: 开发商申请变更分区规划以建造零售综合体。

entries.meaning: 认证；资格认定；委派认可
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，认证，资格认定，委派认可
entries.spelling: A, C, C, R, E, D, I, T, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: The training center received accreditation from an international standards body.
entries.zh: 该培训中心获得了国际标准机构的认证。

entries.meaning: 附录；补充条款；附加说明
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，附录，补充条款，附加说明
entries.spelling: A, D, D, E, N, D, U, M
entries.en: The parties signed an addendum clarifying the delivery schedule.
entries.zh: 双方签署了一份澄清交货时间表的补充条款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，摊销，分期偿还
entries.spelling: A, M, O, R, T, I, Z, E
entries.en: The firm will amortize the equipment cost over seven years.
entries.zh: 公司将把设备成本分七年摊销。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，年金，年金保险
entries.spelling: A, N, N, U, I, T, Y
entries.en: She invested part of her savings in a retirement annuity.
entries.zh: 她把部分积蓄投入了退休年金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，反垄断的，反托拉斯的
entries.spelling: A, N, T, I, T, R, U, S, T
entries.en: The merger is under review for possible antitrust concerns.
entries.zh: 该并购正因可能的反垄断问题接受审查。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，自然减员，流失，磨损
entries.spelling: A, T, T, R, I, T, I, O, N
entries.en: High attrition in the sales team prompted a review of compensation.
entries.zh: 销售团队的高流失率促使公司重新审视薪酬。

entries.meaning: 缺货待发订单；延期交货；使延期供货
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，缺货待发订单，延期交货，使延期供货
entries.spelling: B, A, C, K, O, R, D, E, R
entries.en: The popular model is currently on backorder until next month.
entries.zh: 这款热门型号目前缺货，要到下个月才能发货。

entries.meaning: 可计费的；可向客户开票的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，可计费的，可向客户开票的
entries.spelling: B, I, L, L, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Consultants must record all billable hours in the time-tracking system.
entries.zh: 顾问须在工时系统中记录全部计费工时。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，盈亏平衡的，保本点
entries.spelling: B, R, E, A, K, hyphen, E, V, E, N
entries.en: The startup expects to reach its break-even point within eighteen months.
entries.zh: 该初创公司预计在十八个月内达到盈亏平衡点。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，收购，买断，收购股权
entries.spelling: B, U, Y, O, U, T
entries.en: The executives proposed a management buyout of the family-owned firm.
entries.zh: 高管们提议对这家家族企业进行管理层收购。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，还价，反要约，提出还价
entries.spelling: C, O, U, N, T, E, R, O, F, F, E, R
entries.en: The candidate made a counteroffer asking for a higher signing bonus.
entries.zh: 候选人提出还价，要求更高的签约奖金。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，削减，缩减，裁减
entries.spelling: C, U, T, B, A, C, K
entries.en: Facing lower demand, the factory announced production cutbacks.
entries.zh: 面对需求下降，工厂宣布削减产量。

entries.meaning: 任务后汇报；复盘；听取汇报
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，任务后汇报，复盘，听取汇报
entries.spelling: D, E, B, R, I, E, F
entries.en: After the product launch, the team held a debrief to capture lessons learned.
entries.zh: 产品发布后，团队召开复盘会以总结经验教训。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，拖欠，逾期，失职
entries.spelling: D, E, L, I, N, Q, U, E, N, C, Y
entries.en: The bank reported a slight rise in credit-card delinquency last quarter.
entries.zh: 该银行报告上季度信用卡逾期率略有上升。

entries.meaning: 数字化；转换成数字格式
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，数字化，转换成数字格式
entries.spelling: D, I, G, I, T, I, Z, E
entries.en: HR plans to digitize all employee files by the end of the year.
entries.zh: 人力资源部计划在年底前将全部员工档案数字化。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分销商，经销商，配送者
entries.spelling: D, I, S, T, R, I, B, U, T, O, R
entries.en: The manufacturer appointed a new distributor for the Southeast Asian market.
entries.zh: 制造商为东南亚市场指定了一家新分销商。

entries.meaning: 提取（贷款/资金）；回撤；削减
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，提取（贷款/资金），回撤，削减
entries.spelling: D, R, A, W, D, O, W, N
entries.en: The borrower requested a drawdown of the remaining credit facility.
entries.zh: 借款人申请提取剩余的信贷额度。

entries.meaning: 升级；事态扩大；价格上调
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，升级，事态扩大，价格上调
entries.spelling: E, S, C, A, L, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Customer complaints that remain unresolved go to the next escalation level.
entries.zh: 未解决的客户投诉将进入下一级升级处理。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，推出，铺开，正式发布
entries.spelling: R, O, L, L, O, U, T
entries.en: The company announced a phased rollout of the new payment system.
entries.zh: 公司宣布分阶段推出新的支付系统。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，遣散费，解雇补偿，切断
entries.spelling: S, E, V, E, R, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Employees laid off in the restructuring will receive six months of severance pay.
entries.zh: 因重组被裁的员工将获得六个月的遣散费。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，利益相关方，干系人
entries.spelling: S, T, A, K, E, H, O, L, D, E, R
entries.en: The project lead invited all key stakeholders to review the launch timeline.
entries.zh: 项目负责人邀请所有关键干系人审阅上线时间表。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，补贴，补助金，津贴
entries.spelling: S, U, B, S, I, D, Y
entries.en: Small farms may apply for an energy subsidy to install solar panels.
entries.zh: 小型农场可申请能源补贴以安装太阳能板。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，终止，解雇，期满结束
entries.spelling: T, E, R, M, I, N, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Either party may request early termination with thirty days' written notice.
entries.zh: 任何一方可提前三十天书面通知要求提前终止合同。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，吞吐量，产能，处理量
entries.spelling: T, H, R, O, U, G, H, P, U, T
entries.en: The new conveyor system increased warehouse throughput by twenty percent.
entries.zh: 新传送带系统将仓库吞吐量提高了百分之二十。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，层级，档次，等级
entries.spelling: T, I, E, R
entries.en: The SaaS plan uses tiered pricing based on the number of active users.
entries.zh: 该软件即服务方案按活跃用户数采用分级定价。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，时间表，进度线，时间轴
entries.spelling: T, I, M, E, L, I, N, E
entries.en: Please share an updated timeline before Friday's steering committee.
entries.zh: 请在周五指导委员会会议前分享更新后的时间表。

entries.meaning: 承保；包销（证券）；担保资助
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，承保，包销（证券），担保资助
entries.spelling: U, N, D, E, R, W, R, I, T, E
entries.en: The bank refused to underwrite the loan without additional collateral.
entries.zh: 银行在没有额外抵押的情况下拒绝承保这笔贷款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或副词，预付的，事先的，坦率的
entries.spelling: U, P, F, R, O, N, T
entries.en: The vendor requires a thirty percent upfront payment before production begins.
entries.zh: 供应商要求在开工前支付百分之三十的预付款。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或副词，上游的，逆向的，源头端
entries.spelling: U, P, S, T, R, E, A, M
entries.en: Quality issues must be fixed upstream to avoid costly rework later.
entries.zh: 质量问题必须在上游解决，以免日后昂贵的返工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，核实，验证，核验
entries.spelling: V, E, R, I, F, I, C, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Account access is locked until identity verification is complete.
entries.zh: 在身份核验完成前，账户访问将被锁定。

entries.meaning: 垂直的；纵向的；（行业）垂直领域
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，垂直的，纵向的，（行业）垂直领域
entries.spelling: V, E, R, T, I, C, A, L
entries.en: The startup focuses on one vertical: healthcare logistics software.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司专注于一个垂直领域：医疗物流软件。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，签证
entries.spelling: V, I, S, A
entries.en: Staff traveling to the regional office must renew their work visas in advance.
entries.zh: 前往区域办事处的员工必须提前续签工作签证。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，抵押品，担保物，附属的
entries.spelling: C, O, L, L, A, T, E, R, A, L
entries.en: The borrower offered commercial property as collateral for the expansion loan.
entries.zh: 借款人以商业地产作为扩建贷款的抵押。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，背书，认可，代言
entries.spelling: E, N, D, O, R, S, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: The campaign features a celebrity endorsement of the new skincare line.
entries.zh: 该营销活动以明星代言新品护肤系列为亮点。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，应付的，应付款
entries.spelling: P, A, Y, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Please send all supplier invoices to accounts payable by month-end.
entries.zh: 请在月底前将所有供应商发票寄至应付账款部门。

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，应收的，应收账款
entries.spelling: R, E, C, E, I, V, A, B, L, E
entries.en: Cash flow improved after the team accelerated collection of overdue receivables.
entries.zh: 团队加快催收逾期应收款后，现金流有所改善。

entries.meaning: 聘用定金；顾问费；保持器
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，聘用定金，顾问费，保持器
entries.spelling: R, E, T, A, I, N, E, R
entries.en: The firm keeps a tax attorney on retainer for quarterly compliance reviews.
entries.zh: 公司常年聘用税务律师做季度合规审查。

entries.meaning: 版税；特许权使用费；皇室
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，版税，特许权使用费，皇室
entries.spelling: R, O, Y, A, L, T, Y
entries.en: Authors earn royalties based on each copy sold through the publisher.
entries.zh: 作者按出版商售出的每册书获得版税。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，仲裁，公断
entries.spelling: A, R, B, I, T, R, A, T, I, O, N
entries.en: Disputes under this contract must first go to binding arbitration.
entries.zh: 本合同项下争议须首先进入有约束力的仲裁。

entries.meaning: 公司章程细则；内部规章
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，公司章程细则，内部规章
entries.spelling: B, Y, L, A, W, S
entries.en: The board voted to amend the bylaws on director term limits.
entries.zh: 董事会表决修订了有关董事任期限制的章程细则。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，契约条款，承诺，立约
entries.spelling: C, O, V, E, N, A, N, T
entries.en: Failing to meet the debt covenant could trigger an immediate repayment demand.
entries.zh: 未能满足债务契约条款可能触发立即还款要求。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，赔偿，使免受损失，保障
entries.spelling: I, N, D, E, M, N, I, F, Y
entries.en: The contractor agreed to indemnify the client against third-party claims.
entries.zh: 承包商同意就第三方索赔向客户作出赔偿。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，宣誓书，书面证词
entries.spelling: A, F, F, I, D, A, V, I, T
entries.en: HR asked the employee to sign an affidavit confirming the expense report.
entries.zh: 人力资源部要求该员工签署宣誓书以确认费用报销单。

entries.meaning: 简报；情况通报；行前说明
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，简报，情况通报，行前说明
entries.spelling: B, R, I, E, F, I, N, G
entries.en: The CEO will give a short briefing on Q4 priorities at 9 a.m.
entries.zh: 首席执行官将在上午九时就第四季度重点做简短通报。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，主持人，协调人，版主
entries.spelling: M, O, D, E, R, A, T, O, R
entries.en: Please introduce yourselves briefly when the moderator calls on you.
entries.zh: 当主持人点到你时，请简短自我介绍。

entries.meaning: 法定人数；开会最低出席人数
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，法定人数，开会最低出席人数
entries.spelling: Q, U, O, R, U, M
entries.en: The vote was postponed because the board lacked a quorum.
entries.zh: 因董事会未达法定人数，表决被推迟。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词，重新召开，再集会
entries.spelling: R, E, C, O, N, V, E, N, E
entries.en: We will recess for fifteen minutes and reconvene at 2:30.
entries.zh: 我们将休会十五分钟，并在两点半复会。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，发言人，代言人
entries.spelling: S, P, O, K, E, S, P, E, R, S, O, N
entries.en: A company spokesperson declined to comment on the merger talks.
entries.zh: 公司发言人拒绝对并购谈判置评。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，电话会议，远程会议
entries.spelling: T, E, L, E, C, O, N, F, E, R, E, N, C, E
entries.en: Regional managers will join the weekly teleconference from their branch offices.
entries.zh: 区域经理将从各自分公司加入每周电话会议。

entries.meaning: 旷工；缺勤率；经常性缺席
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，旷工，缺勤率，经常性缺席
entries.spelling: A, B, S, E, N, T, E, E, I, S, M
entries.en: The HR team launched a wellness program to reduce absenteeism across all departments.
entries.zh: 人力资源团队推出健康计划，以降低各部门的缺勤率。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分配额，配额，拨出份额
entries.spelling: A, L, L, O, T, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Each department received a travel allotment for the annual conference.
entries.zh: 每个部门都获得了参加年度会议的差旅配额。

entries.meaning: 欠款；拖欠款项；逾期未付款
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，欠款，拖欠款项，逾期未付款
entries.spelling: A, R, R, E, A, R, S
entries.en: The tenant paid three months of rent arrears before renewing the lease.
entries.zh: 租户在续租前结清了三个月的租金欠款。

entries.meaning: 强制休假；临时停薪留职；准假
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，强制休假，临时停薪留职，准假
entries.spelling: F, U, R, L, O, U, G, H
entries.en: Due to the seasonal downturn, the factory placed 200 workers on unpaid furlough.
entries.zh: 因季节性业务下滑，工厂安排 200 名工人无薪强制休假。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，投诉，不满，劳资申诉
entries.spelling: G, R, I, E, V, A, N, C, E
entries.en: Employees who feel unfairly treated may file a formal grievance with HR.
entries.zh: 觉得受到不公对待的员工可向人力资源部门提出正式申诉。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，交接，移交，职责转交
entries.spelling: H, A, N, D, O, V, E, R
entries.en: The outgoing manager prepared detailed handover notes for her successor.
entries.zh: 即将离任的经理为继任者准备了详细的交接备注。

entries.meaning: 再就业安置服务；裁员辅导；转职协助
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，再就业安置服务，裁员辅导，转职协助
entries.spelling: O, U, T, P, L, A, C, E, M, E, N, T
entries.en: Laid-off staff were offered six months of outplacement services at no cost.
entries.zh: 被裁员工可免费获得六个月的再就业安置服务。

entries.meaning: 管道；项目储备；待推进事项流
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，管道，项目储备，待推进事项流
entries.spelling: P, I, P, E, L, I, N, E
entries.en: Several promising deals are still in the sales pipeline for next quarter.
entries.zh: 下个季度仍有几笔有前景的交易处于销售储备中。

entries.meaning: 阻力；反对意见；推回/抵制
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，阻力，反对意见，推回/抵制
entries.spelling: P, U, S, H, B, A, C, K
entries.en: The pricing proposal faced strong pushback from regional sales managers.
entries.zh: 该定价提案遭到区域销售经理的强烈反对。

entries.meaning: 品牌重塑；更换品牌形象；再品牌化
entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，品牌重塑，更换品牌形象，再品牌化
entries.spelling: R, E, B, R, A, N, D
entries.en: The company plans to rebrand its budget line as a premium lifestyle brand.
entries.zh: 该公司计划将平价产品线重塑为高端生活方式品牌。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，重新雇用，返聘，再聘用
entries.spelling: R, E, H, I, R, E
entries.en: After the busy season returned, the store was able to rehire several seasonal workers.
entries.zh: 旺季回暖后，该店得以返聘数名季节性员工。

entries.meaning: 入围名单；候选短名单；列入终选
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，入围名单，候选短名单，列入终选
entries.spelling: S, H, O, R, T, L, I, S, T
entries.en: Only five applicants made the shortlist for the regional director role.
entries.zh: 只有五位申请人进入了区域总监职位的入围名单。

entries.meaning: 分拆公司；衍生业务；剥离出的实体
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，分拆公司，衍生业务，剥离出的实体
entries.spelling: S, P, I, N, hyphen, O, F, F
entries.en: The board approved a spin-off of the logistics unit into a separate company.
entries.zh: 董事会批准将物流部门分拆为独立公司。

entries.meaning: 权宜之计；临时替代方案；应急措施
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，权宜之计，临时替代方案，应急措施
entries.spelling: S, T, O, P, G, A, P
entries.en: Hiring freelancers was only a stopgap until permanent staff could be recruited.
entries.zh: 雇用自由职业者只是权宜之计，直到能招到正式员工。

entries.spoken_meaning: 动词或名词，分包，转包，分包合同
entries.spelling: S, U, B, C, O, N, T, R, A, C, T
entries.en: The general contractor decided to subcontract the electrical work to a specialist firm.
entries.zh: 总承包商决定将电气工程分包给一家专业公司。

entries.meaning: 工时表；考勤表；工作时间记录单
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，工时表，考勤表，工作时间记录单
entries.spelling: T, I, M, E, S, H, E, E, T
entries.en: Please submit your weekly timesheet by Friday so payroll can process overtime.
entries.zh: 请在周五前提交周工时表，以便薪资部门处理加班费。

entries.meaning: 接触点；客户触点；互动节点
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，接触点，客户触点，互动节点
entries.spelling: T, O, U, C, H, P, O, I, N, T
entries.en: The brand aims to deliver a consistent message across every customer touchpoint.
entries.zh: 该品牌力求在每一个客户接触点传递一致的信息。

entries.meaning: 交钥匙的；一站式交付；整包就绪的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，交钥匙的，一站式交付，整包就绪的
entries.spelling: T, U, R, N, K, E, Y
entries.en: The vendor offered a turnkey solution that included installation and staff training.
entries.zh: 该供应商提供包含安装与员工培训的一站式解决方案。

entries.meaning: 人手不足的；编制短缺的；缺员的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，人手不足的，编制短缺的，缺员的
entries.spelling: U, N, D, E, R, S, T, A, F, F, E, D
entries.en: Customer service remains understaffed after three agents resigned last month.
entries.zh: 自上月三名客服离职后，客服部门仍人手不足。

entries.meaning: 技能提升；再培训；能力升级
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，技能提升，再培训，能力升级
entries.spelling: U, P, S, K, I, L, L, I, N, G
entries.en: The firm invested heavily in digital upskilling to prepare staff for automation.
entries.zh: 公司大力投资数字化技能提升，为员工适应自动化做准备。

entries.meaning: 售后市场；配件市场；二级市场
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，售后市场，配件市场，二级市场
entries.spelling: A, F, T, E, R, M, A, R, K, E, T
entries.en: Profit margins on aftermarket parts are often higher than on new vehicles.
entries.zh: 售后配件的利润率往往高于新车销售。

entries.meaning: 售后的；销售后的；售后服务相关的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，售后的，销售后的，售后服务相关的
entries.spelling: A, F, T, E, R, hyphen, S, A, L, E, S
entries.en: Strong after-sales service helped the retailer retain customers year after year.
entries.zh: 优质的售后服务帮助该零售商年复一年留住客户。

entries.meaning: 空运货物；航空货运；以空运运送
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，空运货物，航空货运，以空运运送
entries.spelling: A, I, R, F, R, E, I, G, H, T
entries.en: The samples will be sent by airfreight so they arrive before the trade show.
entries.zh: 样品将以空运发出，以便在展会前送达。

entries.meaning: 后台；后勤支持部门；非前台业务
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，后台，后勤支持部门，非前台业务
entries.spelling: B, A, C, K, hyphen, O, F, F, I, C, E
entries.en: Automating invoices freed back-office staff to focus on exception handling.
entries.zh: 发票自动化让后台人员得以专注处理异常情况。

entries.meaning: 同类最佳的；业内顶尖的；标杆级的
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词，同类最佳的，业内顶尖的，标杆级的
entries.spelling: B, E, S, T, hyphen, I, N, hyphen, C, L, A, S, S
entries.en: Our goal is to deliver best-in-class customer support within 24 hours.
entries.zh: 我们的目标是在 24 小时内提供同类最佳的客户支持。

entries.meaning: 蓝筹的；绩优的；稳健优质（公司/股票）
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，蓝筹的，绩优的，稳健优质（公司/股票）
entries.spelling: B, L, U, E, hyphen, C, H, I, P
entries.en: Investors shifted funds into blue-chip stocks during the market downturn.
entries.zh: 市场下行期间，投资者将资金转向蓝筹股。

entries.meaning: 分会场讨论；突破；突围式会议
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，分会场讨论，突破，突围式会议
entries.spelling: B, R, E, A, K, O, U, T
entries.en: After the keynote, attendees moved into smaller breakout sessions by industry.
entries.zh: 主旨演讲结束后，与会者按行业进入较小的分组讨论会。

entries.meaning: 烧钱速度；现金消耗率；资金燃尽速率
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，烧钱速度，现金消耗率，资金燃尽速率
entries.spelling: B, U, R, N, hyphen, R, A, T, E
entries.en: With a high burn-rate, the startup has only eight months of runway left.
entries.zh: 以目前的高烧钱速度，这家初创公司只剩八个月的资金跑道。

entries.meaning: 认同与支持；买入参与；共识认可
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，认同与支持，买入参与，共识认可
entries.spelling: B, U, Y, hyphen, I, N
entries.en: The project cannot move forward without buy-in from senior leadership.
entries.zh: 没有高层领导的认同与支持，该项目无法推进。

entries.meaning: 呼叫中心；客服中心；电话服务中心
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，呼叫中心，客服中心，电话服务中心
entries.spelling: C, A, L, L, hyphen, C, E, N, T, E, R
entries.en: The company expanded its call-center hours to cover late-night customer inquiries.
entries.zh: 公司延长了呼叫中心的服务时间，以覆盖深夜客户咨询。

entries.meaning: 中途停留；转机停留；中转停留时间
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，中途停留，转机停留，中转停留时间
entries.spelling: L, A, Y, O, V, E, R
entries.en: Our flight has a two-hour layover in Singapore before continuing to Sydney.
entries.zh: 我们的航班在继续飞往悉尼之前，会在新加坡转机停留两小时。

entries.meaning: 海关；海关检查；关税部门
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，海关，海关检查，关税部门
entries.spelling: C, U, S, T, O, M, S
entries.en: All passengers must go through customs before exiting the international terminal.
entries.zh: 所有乘客在离开国际航站楼前都必须过海关。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，候补，待机，候补登机
entries.spelling: S, T, A, N, D, B, Y
entries.en: If the flight is full, you may still get a seat by flying standby.
entries.zh: 如果航班已满，你仍可能通过候补登机获得座位。

entries.meaning: 中途停留；经停；过境停留（可过夜）
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，中途停留，经停，过境停留（可过夜）
entries.spelling: S, T, O, P, O, V, E, R
entries.en: The ticket includes a free one-night stopover in Dubai.
entries.zh: 该机票包含在迪拜免费过夜经停一晚。

entries.meaning: 隔间办公位；小隔间；工位隔间
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，隔间办公位，小隔间，工位隔间
entries.spelling: C, U, B, I, C, L, E
entries.en: New hires are assigned a cubicle on the third floor until private offices are available.
entries.zh: 新员工会被分配到三楼的隔间工位，直到有独立办公室可用。

entries.meaning: 共享工位制；热桌办公；非固定座位办公
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，共享工位制，热桌办公，非固定座位办公
entries.spelling: H, O, T, hyphen, D, E, S, K, I, N, G
entries.en: The firm introduced hot-desking to cut real-estate costs and free up unused desks.
entries.zh: 公司推行共享工位制，以降低不动产成本并腾出闲置工位。

entries.meaning: 语音信箱；语音留言；留言系统
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，语音信箱，语音留言，留言系统
entries.spelling: V, O, I, C, E, M, A, I, L
entries.en: If I miss your call, please leave a voicemail with your callback number.
entries.zh: 如果我没接到电话，请在语音信箱留言并留下回电号码。

entries.meaning: 信头纸；印有抬头的公文纸；公司信笺抬头
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，信头纸，印有抬头的公文纸，公司信笺抬头
entries.spelling: L, E, T, T, E, R, H, E, A, D
entries.en: Please submit the complaint on company letterhead so we can verify the sender.
entries.zh: 请将投诉写在公司信头纸上提交，以便我们核实发件方。
